1.55.s:
sanantana uvāca
mūrddhāsyabāhuhṛtkroḍāntarbastivyañjasonakhaḥ /
jānujaṅghāṅghniyugalaṃ kālāṅgāni kriyādayaḥ //
1.55.d:
सनन्तन उवाच
मूर्द्धास्यबाहुहृत्क्रोडान्तर्बस्तिव्यञ्जसोनखः ।
जानुजङ्घाङ्घ्नियुगलं कालाङ्गानि क्रियादयः ॥
1.55.m: Sanatkumāra said: / The head, mouth, arms, heart, belly, groin, private parts, anus, / knees, shanks, and pair of feet are the bodily limbs of Time, [signified by] Aries (Kriya) and the rest.

1.55.s:
bhaumāsphujibudhenduśca ravisaumyasitāḥ kujaḥ /
gurumandārkiguravo meṣādīnāmadhīśvarāḥ //
1.55.d:
भौमास्फुजिबुधेन्दुश्च रविसौम्यसिताः कुजः ।
गुरुमन्दार्किगुरवो मेषादीनामधीश्वराः ॥
1.55.m: Mars, Venus, Mercury, the Moon, the Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, / Jupiter, Saturn, Saturn, and Jupiter are the lords of Aries and the other signs.

1.55.s:
hore viṣamabherkedoḥ samaye śaśisūryayoḥ /
ādipañcanavādhīśādreṣkāṇeśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
1.55.d:
होरे विषमभेर्केदोः समये शशिसूर्ययोः ।
आदिपञ्चनवाधीशाद्रेष्काणेशाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
1.55.m: In an odd sign, the two horas belong to the Sun and the Moon; in an even sign, to the Moon and the Sun. / The lords of the first, fifth, and ninth signs are taught to be the lords of the drekkāṇas.

1.55.s:
pañceṣṭāṣṭādripañcāṃśā kujārkījyajñaśukragāḥ /
oje viparyayādyugme triśāṃśeśāḥ samīritāḥ //
1.55.d:
पञ्चेष्टाष्टाद्रिपञ्चांशा कुजार्कीज्यज्ञशुक्रगाः ।
ओजे विपर्ययाद्युग्मे त्रिशांशेशाः समीरिताः ॥
1.55.m: In an odd sign, portions of five, five, eight, seven, and five degrees / belong to Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus; in an even sign, in reverse order: these are declared the lords of the triṃśāṃśas.

1.55.s:
kriyaṇataulikarkādyā meṣādiṣu navāṃśakāḥ /
svabhāddvādaśabhāgeśāḥ ṣarḍgaṃ rāśipūrvakam //
1.55.d:
क्रियणतौलिकर्काद्या मेषादिषु नवांशकाः ।
स्वभाद्द्वादशभागेशाः षर्ड्गं राशिपूर्वकम् ॥
1.55.m: Beginning with Aries, Libra, Capricorn, and Cancer are the navāṃśakas in Aries and the rest. / The lords of the dvādaśāṃśas begin with the sign itself. Thus is the sixfold division (ṣaḍvarga) beginning with the rāśi.

1.55.s:
gojāśca karkayugmena rātryākhyā pṛṣṭakodayāḥ /
śeṣā dinākhyāstūbhayaṃ timiḥ krūraḥ saumyaḥ pumān //
1.55.d:
गोजाश्च कर्कयुग्मेन रात्र्याख्या पृष्टकोदयाः ।
शेषा दिनाख्यास्तूभयं तिमिः क्रूरः सौम्यः पुमान् ॥
1.55.m: Taurus, Aries, Cancer, and Gemini are nocturnal signs and rise by the rear. / The rest are diurnal, Pisces is both, cruel, benefic, and masculine.

1.55.s:
pumān srī ca klībaścarasthiradviḥsvabhāvakāḥ /
meṣādyāḥ pūrvatodiksthāḥ svasvasthānacarāstathā //
1.55.d:
पुमान् स्री च क्लीबश्चरस्थिरद्विःस्वभावकाः ।
मेषाद्याः पूर्वतोदिक्स्थाः स्वस्वस्थानचरास्तथा ॥
1.55.m: Male, female, and hermaphrodite; movable, fixed, and dual in nature; / Aries and the rest are situated in the eastern and other directions, moving in their respective places.

1.55.s:
ajokṣeṇāṅganākīṭajhaṣajūkā ināditaḥ /
uccāni dvitrimanuyuktithīṣubhanakhāṃśakaiḥ //
1.55.d:
अजोक्षेणाङ्गनाकीटझषजूका इनादितः ।
उच्चानि द्वित्रिमनुयुक्तिथीषुभनखांशकैः ॥
1.55.m: Aries, Taurus, Capricorn, Virgo, Scorpio, Pisces, and Libra, starting from the Sun, / are the exaltation signs, at the tenth, third, twenty-eighth, fifteenth, twenty-seventh, and twentieth degrees.

1.55.s:
tattatsaptamanīcāni prāṅmadhyāntyāṃśakāḥ kramāt /
vargottamāścarādheṣu bhāvāddvādaśa mūrtimān //
1.55.d:
तत्तत्सप्तमनीचानि प्राङ्मध्यान्त्यांशकाः क्रमात् ।
वर्गोत्तमाश्चराधेषु भावाद्द्वादश मूर्तिमान् ॥
1.55.m: Their seventh signs are the debilitations. The first, middle, and last ninths, respectively, / are vargottama in movable, [fixed, and dual signs]. From the ascendant, the twelve houses have bodily form.

1.55.s:
siṃhokṣāvisraścatau likubhāḥ sūryātrikoṇabham /
caturasraṃ tūryamṛtyutrikoṇaṃ navapañcamam //
1.55.d:
सिंहोक्षाविस्रश्चतौ लिकुभाः सूर्यात्रिकोणभम् ।
चतुरस्रं तूर्यमृत्युत्रिकोणं नवपञ्चमम् ॥
1.55.m: Leo, Taurus, Aries, Virgo, Libra, and Aquarius are the mūlatrikoṇa signs of the planets beginning with the Sun. / The caturasra is the fourth and eighth houses; the trikoṇa is the ninth and fifth.

1.55.s:
riḥphaāṣṭaṣaṭkaṃ trikabhaṃ kendraṃ prākturyasaptakham /
nṛpādaḥ kīṭapaśavo balāḍhyāḥ kendragāḥ kramāt //
1.55.d:
रिःफआष्टषट्कं त्रिकभं केन्द्रं प्राक्तुर्यसप्तखम् ।
नृपादः कीटपशवो बलाढ्याः केन्द्रगाः क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: The twelfth, eighth, and sixth houses are the trika houses. The kendra is the first, fourth, seventh, and tenth. / Humans, quadrupeds, scorpions, and animals are strong when situated in the kendras, in order.

1.55.s:
kendrātparaṃ paṇapharamāpoklimamataḥ param /
raktaḥ śvetaḥ śukanibhaḥ pāṭalo dhūmrapāṇḍurau //
1.55.d:
केन्द्रात्परं पणफरमापोक्लिममतः परम् ।
रक्तः श्वेतः शुकनिभः पाटलो धूम्रपाण्डुरौ ॥
1.55.m: Succeeding the kendras are the paṇapharas, and after that are the āpoklimas. / Red, white, parrot-colored, pale red, smoky, pale yellow,

1.55.s:
citraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pītapiṅgau babhruḥ svacchaḥ prabhākriyāt /
sāmyāśākhyaplavatvaṃ syāddvitīye vaśirarkabhāt //
1.55.d:
चित्रः कृष्णः पीतपिङ्गौ बभ्रुः स्वच्छः प्रभाक्रियात् ।
साम्याशाख्यप्लवत्वं स्याद्द्वितीये वशिरर्कभात् ॥
1.55.m: variegated, black, yellow-tawny, brown, and clear are their hues, from Aries onward. / A vessel is named after its equal direction; in the second from the Sun's sign is the vaśi yoga.

1.55.s:
kālātmārke manaścadraḥ kujaḥ satvaṃ vacobudhaḥ /
jīvo jñānaṃ sukhaṃ śukraḥ kāmo duḥkhaṃ dineśajaḥ //
1.55.d:
कालात्मार्के मनश्चद्रः कुजः सत्वं वचोबुधः ।
जीवो ज्ञानं सुखं शुक्रः कामो दुःखं दिनेशजः ॥
1.55.m: The Sun is the soul of Time, the Moon is the mind, Mars is strength, Mercury is speech, / Jupiter is knowledge, Venus is pleasure, passion [is Mars], and the son of the Sun (Saturn) is sorrow.

1.55.s:
nṛpau ravīndū netāsṛk kumāro jñaḥ kavījyakau /
sacivo sūryajaḥ preṣyo mato jyotirvidāṃ varaiḥ //
1.55.d:
नृपौ रवीन्दू नेतासृक् कुमारो ज्ञः कवीज्यकौ ।
सचिवो सूर्यजः प्रेष्यो मतो ज्योतिर्विदां वरैः ॥
1.55.m: The Sun and the Moon are kings; Mars is the army chief; Mercury is the crown prince; Venus and Jupiter / are ministers; and the son of the Sun is a servant: thus it is considered by the best of astronomers.

1.55.s:
tāmraśuklaraktaharitpītacitrāsitā raveḥ /
varṇā va avyahaharīdrā śacīkaudhipāraveḥ //
1.55.d:
ताम्रशुक्लरक्तहरित्पीतचित्रासिता रवेः ।
वर्णा व अव्यहहरीद्रा शचीकौधिपारवेः ॥
1.55.m: Copper-colored, white, blood-red, green, yellow, variegated, and dark are the Sun's [and others'] / colors; their presiding deities are Fire, Water, Skanda, Viṣṇu, Indra, Śacī, and Yama.

1.55.s:
raviśukrārarāhvarkenduvidījyā digīśvarāḥ /
kṣīṇendvarkāraravijāḥ pāpā pāpayuto budhaḥ //
1.55.d:
रविशुक्रारराह्वर्केन्दुविदीज्या दिगीश्वराः ।
क्षीणेन्द्वर्काररविजाः पापा पापयुतो बुधः ॥
1.55.m: The Sun, Venus, Mars, Rāhu, Saturn, the Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter are the lords of the directions. / The waning Moon, the Sun, Mars, and Saturn are malefics; Mercury conjoined with a malefic is malefic.

1.55.s:
klibau budhārkī śukrendū sriyau śeṣā narāḥ smṛtāḥ /
śikhibhūmipayovārivāsino bhūsutādayaḥ //
1.55.d:
क्लिबौ बुधार्की शुक्रेन्दू स्रियौ शेषा नराः स्मृताः ।
शिखिभूमिपयोवारिवासिनो भूसुतादयः ॥
1.55.m: Mercury and Saturn are hermaphrodites; Venus and the Moon are females; the rest are considered males. / The sons of the Earth and the others dwell in fire, earth, water, and wind.

1.55.s:
kavījyau kujasūryauṃ ca vedo jño varṇapāḥ kramāt /
saurāeṃ'tyajādhipaḥ prokto rāhurmlecchādhipastathā //
1.55.d:
कवीज्यौ कुजसूर्यौं च वेदो ज्ञो वर्णपाः क्रमात् ।
सौराएंऽत्यजाधिपः प्रोक्तो राहुर्म्लेच्छाधिपस्तथा ॥
1.55.m: Venus and Jupiter, Mars and the Sun, the Moon, and Mercury are the lords of the four castes in order. / Saturn is declared the lord of the outcastes, and Rāhu the lord of the barbarians (mlecchas).

1.55.s:
candrārkajīvājñasitau kujārkī sāttvikādikāḥ /
devatendvagniraivalābhūkosakhāyoparādhipāḥ //
1.55.d:
चन्द्रार्कजीवाज्ञसितौ कुजार्की सात्त्विकादिकाः ।
देवतेन्द्वग्निरैवलाभूकोसखायोपराधिपाः ॥
1.55.m: The Moon, Sun, and Jupiter; Mercury and Venus; Mars and Saturn are sattvic and so forth. / Their deities are the Moon, Fire, Rudra, Viṣṇu, Earth, Indra, and Brahmā as lords of clothes and the like.

1.55.s:
vasraṃ sthalaṃ navaṃ vahnikahataṃ madyadaṃ tathā /
sphuṭitaṃ ravitastāṃmraṃ tāre tāmrapunistathā //
1.55.d:
वस्रं स्थलं नवं वह्निकहतं मद्यदं तथा ।
स्फुटितं रवितस्तांम्रं तारे ताम्रपुनिस्तथा ॥
1.55.m: Coarse cloth, new cloth, burnt by fire, soaked in wine, / torn cloth from the Sun [and others]; copper, bell-metal, and copper again,

1.55.s:
hemakāṃsyāyasī tryaṃśaiḥśiśirādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
sauraśukrāracandrajñaguruṣūdyatsu ca kramāt //
1.55.d:
हेमकांस्यायसी त्र्यंशैःशिशिराद्याः प्रकीर्तिताः ।
सौरशुक्रारचन्द्रज्ञगुरुषूद्यत्सु च क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: gold, brass, and iron are declared by third-parts, with winter and the other seasons, / in order when Saturn, Venus, Mars, the Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter are rising.

1.55.s:
tryāśatrikoṇaturyāṣṭasaptamānyena vṛddhitaḥ /
saurejyārāpare pūrṇe kramātpaśyanti nārada //
1.55.d:
त्र्याशत्रिकोणतुर्याष्टसप्तमान्येन वृद्धितः ।
सौरेज्यारापरे पूर्णे क्रमात्पश्यन्ति नारद ॥
1.55.m: By one-third, trikoṇa, fourth and eighth, and the seventh, with increasing strength, / Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars cast their full aspects, in order, O Nārada.

1.55.s:
ayanakṣaṇaghasrartumāsārddhaśarado raveḥ /
kaṭutiktakṣāramiśramadhurāmlakaṣāyakāḥ //
1.55.d:
अयनक्षणघस्रर्तुमासार्द्धशरदो रवेः ।
कटुतिक्तक्षारमिश्रमधुराम्लकषायकाः ॥
1.55.m: Solstice, muhūrta, day, season, half-month, and year belong to the Sun and the others; / pungent, bitter, saline, mixed, sweet, sour, and astringent are their tastes.

1.55.s:
trikoṇātsāṃtyadhādharmāyuḥ sukhakhodyapaḥ suhṛt /
jīvo jīvajñau sitajñau vyarkā vyārāḥ kramādamī //
1.55.d:
त्रिकोणात्सांत्यधाधर्मायुः सुखखोद्यपः सुहृत् ।
जीवो जीवज्ञौ सितज्ञौ व्यर्का व्याराः क्रमादमी ॥
1.55.m: The lord of the ninth, eighth, fourth, and tenth houses from the mūlatrikoṇa is a friend; / Jupiter, Jupiter and Mercury, Venus and Mercury, those without the Sun, those without Mars, in order,

1.55.s:
vīndvarkā vikujendvarkāḥ suhṛdo 'nyeraverdhṛtāḥ /
mithodhanavyayāyatribandhuvyāpāragaḥ suhṛt //
1.55.d:
वीन्द्वर्का विकुजेन्द्वर्काः सुहृदो ऽन्येरवेर्धृताः ।
मिथोधनव्ययायत्रिबन्धुव्यापारगः सुहृत् ॥
1.55.m: those without the Moon and Sun, those without Mars, the Moon, and the Sun: these are the friends of the Sun and the rest. / One situated mutually in the second, twelfth, eleventh, third, fourth, or tenth is a friend.

1.55.s:
dhyekānubhaktā mayān jñātvā miśrīdītsahajānmune /
matkālodhisuhṛnmitrapūrvakānkalpayetpunaḥ //
1.55.d:
ध्येकानुभक्ता मयान् ज्ञात्वा मिश्रीदीत्सहजान्मुने ।
मत्कालोधिसुहृन्मित्रपूर्वकान्कल्पयेत्पुनः ॥
1.55.m: Having known them, divided by two and combined together, O sage, / one should calculate again the friends, neutrals, and enemies of the present time.

1.55.s:
svoccatrikoṇagehā pranavāṃśaisthānajaṃ balam /
dikṣu saumyejyayoḥ sūryārayoḥ saure sitābjayoḥ //
1.55.d:
स्वोच्चत्रिकोणगेहा प्रनवांशैस्थानजं बलम् ।
दिक्षु सौम्येज्ययोः सूर्यारयोः सौरे सिताब्जयोः ॥
1.55.m: Positional strength comes from one's exaltation, trikoṇa, own house, and friendly navāṃśaka; / directional strength belongs to Mercury and Jupiter [in the east], the Sun and Mars [in the south], Saturn [in the west], Venus and the Moon [in the north].

1.55.s:
ravāhṛtūdaganenye tu vakri ca samāgame /
uttarasthā dīptakarāśceṣṭā vīryayutā matāḥ //
1.55.d:
रवाहृतूदगनेन्ये तु वक्रि च समागमे ।
उत्तरस्था दीप्तकराश्चेष्टा वीर्ययुता मताः ॥
1.55.m: Those with northward courses, retrograde, or in planetary conjunction with the Sun, / situated in the north, possessing bright rays, are considered endowed with motional strength.

1.55.s:
niśīndukujasaurāśca sarvadā kṣohni cāpare /
krūrāḥ kṛṣṇe site saumyāḥ mataṃ kālabalaṃ budhaiḥ //
1.55.d:
निशीन्दुकुजसौराश्च सर्वदा क्षोह्नि चापरे ।
क्रूराः कृष्णे सिते सौम्याः मतं कालबलं बुधैः ॥
1.55.m: By night the Moon, Mars, and Saturn, and by day the others; / the malefics in the dark fortnight, the benefics in the bright: this is considered temporal strength by the wise.

1.55.s:
saurārajñejyaśukrendusūryādhikyaṃ parasparam /
pāpāstu balinaḥ saumyā vivakṣāḥ kaṇṭakopage //
1.55.d:
सौरारज्ञेज्यशुक्रेन्दुसूर्याधिक्यं परस्परम् ।
पापास्तु बलिनः सौम्या विवक्षाः कण्टकोपगे ॥
1.55.m: Saturn, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, the Moon, and the Sun increase progressively in strength. / Malefics are strong, and benefics are weak when situated in the angles.

1.55.s:
klībe tadūśanādvāpi candrārkāṃśasamaṃ januḥ /
svāṃśe pāpāḥ parāṃśasthāḥ saumyālagnaṃ viyonijam //
1.55.d:
क्लीबे तदूशनाद्वापि चन्द्रार्कांशसमं जनुः ।
स्वांशे पापाः परांशस्थाः सौम्यालग्नं वियोनिजम् ॥
1.55.m: When a hermaphrodite is aspected by Venus, or equal to the Moon and Sun's degree, birth occurs; / when malefics are in their own navāṃśas and benefics are in other navāṃśas, the ascendant is non-human.

1.55.s:
nirbalaṃ ca tadādeśyaṃ viyonerjanma paṇḍitaiḥ /
śīrṣaṃ vakragale pādāvaṃsau pṛṣṭamurastathā //
1.55.d:
निर्बलं च तदादेश्यं वियोनेर्जन्म पण्डितैः ।
शीर्षं वक्रगले पादावंसौ पृष्टमुरस्तथा ॥
1.55.m: When it is devoid of strength, a non-human birth is to be declared by the learned. / The head, face, neck, feet, shoulders, back, and chest

1.55.s:
pārśve kukṣī tvapānāṅghrī meḍhramuṣkau tathā sphijau /
pucchaṃ catuṣpadāṅgeṣu meṣādyā rāśayaḥ smṛtāḥ //
1.55.d:
पार्श्वे कुक्षी त्वपानाङ्घ्री मेढ्रमुष्कौ तथा स्फिजौ ।
पुच्छं चतुष्पदाङ्गेषु मेषाद्या राशयः स्मृताः ॥
1.55.m: The ribs, belly, anus and feet, penis and testicles, and likewise the buttocks / and tail—among the limbs of four-footed beasts, the signs starting with Aries are considered [to represent these].

1.55.s:
lagnāṃśādgrahayugdṛṣṭvā varṇānbalayutādvadet /
dṛksamānapramāṇāṃśca iṣṭe rekhāṃ smarasthitaiḥ //
1.55.d:
लग्नांशाद्ग्रहयुग्दृष्ट्वा वर्णान्बलयुताद्वदेत् ।
दृक्समानप्रमाणांश्च इष्टे रेखां स्मरस्थितैः ॥
1.55.m: From the degree of the ascendant and from planets conjoined or aspecting, when endowed with strength, one should declare the colors; / and [one should declare] forms conforming to those aspects, and lines on desired [limbs] by planets standing in the seventh house.

1.55.s:
khagatryaṃśe balāgnege caramāṃśe grahānvite /
vāṃśe sthalāṃbujaḥ saurerdvīkṣāyogabhavā dvijāḥ //
1.55.d:
खगत्र्यंशे बलाग्नेगे चरमांशे ग्रहान्विते ।
वांशे स्थलांबुजः सौरेर्द्वीक्षायोगभवा द्विजाः ॥
1.55.m: When a decanate is in an airy sign, endowed with strength, or in a movable degree conjoined with a planet, / or in its own degree, [the creature is] terrestrial or aquatic; from Saturn's aspect and conjunction, twice-born [birds or reptiles] arise.

1.55.s:
vipralaistanujacandrejyārkaistarūṇāṃ janiṃ vadet /
sthalāṃbubhendośakṛtaścetareṣāmudāhṛtaḥ //
1.55.d:
विप्रलैस्तनुजचन्द्रेज्यार्कैस्तरूणां जनिं वदेत् ।
स्थलांबुभेन्दोशकृतश्चेतरेषामुदाहृतः ॥
1.55.m: Through planets devoid of strength, or through the son of the bodily [ruler], the Moon, Jupiter, and the Sun, one should declare the birth of trees; / and it is taught to be terrestrial or aquatic according to the signs and degrees of the Moon and others.

1.55.s:
sthalāṃbu ca patiḥ kheṭo lagnādyāvanmite gṛhe /
tāvanta eva takhaḥ sthalajā jalajāstathā //
1.55.d:
स्थलांबु च पतिः खेटो लग्नाद्यावन्मिते गृहे ।
तावन्त एव तखः स्थलजा जलजास्तथा ॥
1.55.m: As far as the planetary lord of land and water is situated in a house counting from the ascendant, / just so many are the trees born on land and born in water.

1.55.s:
antaḥsārā ravau saure durbhagāḥ kṣīriṇo vidhau /
bhaume kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā ījye jñe saphalāphalau //
1.55.d:
अन्तःसारा रवौ सौरे दुर्भगाः क्षीरिणो विधौ ।
भौमे कण्टकिनो वृक्षा ईज्ये ज्ञे सफलाफलौ ॥
1.55.m: Trees are heartwood-rich under the Sun, deformed and sapless under Saturn, milky under the Moon, / thorny under Mars, fruitful under Jupiter, and fruitless under Mercury.

1.55.s:
puṣpitā bhārgave snigdhāścandre 'tha kaṭukāḥ kuje /
aśubharkṣe śubhaḥ kheṭaḥ śubhaṃ vṛkṣaṃ kubhūmijam //
1.55.d:
पुष्पिता भार्गवे स्निग्धाश्चन्द्रे ऽथ कटुकाः कुजे ।
अशुभर्क्षे शुभः खेटः शुभं वृक्षं कुभूमिजम् ॥
1.55.m: Under Venus they are flowering and glossy; then under Mars they are bitter. / A benefic planet in a malefic sign produces an auspicious tree grown in poor soil;

1.55.s:
kuryādvilomago vāpi svāṃśoktaparagaiḥ samam /
kujenduhetukaṃ srīṇāṃ pratimāsamihārtavam //
1.55.d:
कुर्याद्विलोमगो वापि स्वांशोक्तपरगैः समम् ।
कुजेन्दुहेतुकं स्रीणां प्रतिमासमिहार्तवम् ॥
1.55.m: or when retrograde, it acts similarly to planets in another's sign with degrees of their own. / The monthly menstruation of women here is caused by Mars and the Moon.

1.55.s:
neṣṭasthejye 'nyathāste srīyuṅktāsannarekṣite /
pāpayuktekṣite dyūne ruṣā prītyā śubhagrahaiḥ //
1.55.d:
नेष्टस्थेज्ये ऽन्यथास्ते स्रीयुङ्क्तासन्नरेक्षिते ।
पापयुक्तेक्षिते द्यूने रुषा प्रीत्या शुभग्रहैः ॥
1.55.m: If Jupiter is in the seventh house, it is unfavorable; otherwise, if the Moon is in the seventh house, aspected by a man, [conception occurs]; / if the seventh house is conjoined or aspected by malefics, it occurs through anger, and through love if by benefic planets.

1.55.s:
śukrārkendujaiḥ svāṃśasthairījya cāṅgatrikoṇage /
bhavedapatyaṃ viprendra puṃsāṃ sadvīryaśālinām //
1.55.d:
शुक्रार्केन्दुजैः स्वांशस्थैरीज्य चाङ्गत्रिकोणगे ।
भवेदपत्यं विप्रेन्द्र पुंसां सद्वीर्यशालिनाम् ॥
1.55.m: When Venus, the Sun, and Mercury occupy their own navāṃśas and Jupiter is in the ascendant or a trine, / an offspring is born, O foremost of Brahmins, to men endowed with good virility.

1.55.s:
asrer'kendo kujārkī cetpuṃsriyorāmayapradau /
vyayakhago yuktau caikadṛṣṭyā nṛtyupradau tayoḥ //
1.55.d:
अस्रेर्ऽकेन्दो कुजार्की चेत्पुंस्रियोरामयप्रदौ ।
व्ययखगो युक्तौ चैकदृष्ट्या नृत्युप्रदौ तयोः ॥
1.55.m: If Mars and the Sun occupy the places of the Moon and the Sun, they bring disease to the man and woman; / and if they occupy the twelfth house together with a single aspect, they bring death to both.

1.55.s:
śukrārkrau mātṛpitarau divā naktaṃ śaśīnajau /
mātṛṣvasṛpitṛvyākhyau vā padmeji same śubhau //
1.55.d:
शुक्रार्क्रौ मातृपितरौ दिवा नक्तं शशीनजौ ।
मातृष्वसृपितृव्याख्यौ वा पद्मेजि समे शुभौ ॥
1.55.m: Venus and the Sun are mother and father by day, and the Moon and Saturn by night; / or Venus and Jupiter are called maternal aunt and paternal uncle, being auspicious in even signs.

1.55.s:
pāpadṛṣṭe śubhe kṣīṇe tuṅge vā lagnageyame /
kṣīṇendukujasaṃdṛṣṭe mṛtyumetya gatā dhruvam //
1.55.d:
पापदृष्टे शुभे क्षीणे तुङ्गे वा लग्नगेयमे ।
क्षीणेन्दुकुजसंदृष्टे मृत्युमेत्य गता ध्रुवम् ॥
1.55.m: If a benefic is aspected by a malefic and waning, or if Saturn is in exaltation in the ascendant, / aspected by the waning Moon and Mars, she surely meets with death and passes away.

1.55.s:
yugapadvā pṛthaksasthau lagnendū pāpamadhyagau /
yadā tadā garbhayutā nārī mṛtyumavāpnuyāt //
1.55.d:
युगपद्वा पृथक्सस्थौ लग्नेन्दू पापमध्यगौ ।
यदा तदा गर्भयुता नारी मृत्युमवाप्नुयात् ॥
1.55.m: Or when the ascendant and the Moon together or separately are hemmed between malefics, / then the pregnant woman meets her death.

1.55.s:
lagnāṃñcadrācca turyasthaiḥ pāpairnidhanage kuje /
naṣṭendau kujaravyośca bandhuriṣpagayormṛtiḥ //
1.55.d:
लग्नांञ्चद्राच्च तुर्यस्थैः पापैर्निधनगे कुजे ।
नष्टेन्दौ कुजरव्योश्च बन्धुरिष्पगयोर्मृतिः ॥
1.55.m: When malefics are in the fourth from the ascendant and from the Moon, and Mars is in the eighth, / or when the Moon is vanished, and Mars and the Sun are in the fourth and twelfth, death ensues.

1.55.s:
tanvastasaṃsthayorbhauṃmaravyoḥ śasrabhavaḥ kṣayaḥ /
yanmāsādhipatirnaṣṭastanmāsaṃ saṃsrave tyajet //
1.55.d:
तन्वस्तसंस्थयोर्भौंमरव्योः शस्रभवः क्षयः ।
यन्मासाधिपतिर्नष्टस्तन्मासं संस्रवे त्यजेत् ॥
1.55.m: When Mars and the Sun occupy the ascendant and the seventh, destruction occurs through weapons. / When the lord of a month is lost, one should avoid that month during miscarriage.

1.55.s:
lagnendugaiḥ śubhaiḥ kheṭaisrikoṇārthāstabhūkhagaiḥ /
pāpaisriṣaṣṭalābhasthaiḥ sukhī garbho ravīkṣitaḥ //
1.55.d:
लग्नेन्दुगैः शुभैः खेटैस्रिकोणार्थास्तभूखगैः ।
पापैस्रिषष्टलाभस्थैः सुखी गर्भो रवीक्षितः ॥
1.55.m: When benefics are in the ascendant and Moon, and planets are in the trine, second, seventh, and tenth houses, / and malefics are in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses aspected by the Sun, the fetus remains happy.

1.55.s:
ojabhe puruṣāṃśer'kejyendulagnairbalānvitaiḥ /
gurvakārai viṣamasthau vā yuñjanma pravadettadā //
1.55.d:
ओजभे पुरुषांशेर्ऽकेज्येन्दुलग्नैर्बलान्वितैः ।
गुर्वकारै विषमस्थौ वा युञ्जन्म प्रवदेत्तदा ॥
1.55.m: In an odd sign, when the Sun, Jupiter, the Moon, and the ascendant are in masculine degrees and endowed with strength, / or when Jupiter and the Sun are in odd signs, one should then declare the birth of a boy.

1.55.s:
yugmabhāṃśasthitaistaistu vakrendubhṛgubhistathā /
yāmasthānagatairvācyaṃ sriyo janma manīṣibhiḥ //
1.55.d:
युग्मभांशस्थितैस्तैस्तु वक्रेन्दुभृगुभिस्तथा ।
यामस्थानगतैर्वाच्यं स्रियो जन्म मनीषिभिः ॥
1.55.m: Through those situated in even signs and degrees, and likewise through Mars, the Moon, and Venus / situated in even houses, the birth of a female should be declared by the wise.

1.55.s:
dvyaṅgasthā budhasaṃdṛṣṭāḥ svapakṣeya malaṅkarāḥ /
lagnaṃ vinaujabhāvasthaḥ sauraḥ puñjanmakṛttathā //
1.55.d:
द्व्यङ्गस्था बुधसंदृष्टाः स्वपक्षेय मलङ्कराः ।
लग्नं विनौजभावस्थः सौरः पुञ्जन्मकृत्तथा ॥
1.55.m: Situated in dual signs and aspected by Mercury, they adorn their own side; / and Saturn situated in an odd house other than the ascendant likewise causes the birth of a boy.

1.55.s:
mitho ravīndūrjñārkī vā paśyataḥ samagaṃ raviḥ /
vakro vāṅgavidhū oje jajñau yugmaujasaṃsthitau //
1.55.d:
मिथो रवीन्दूर्ज्ञार्की वा पश्यतः समगं रविः ।
वक्रो वाङ्गविधू ओजे जज्ञौ युग्मौजसंस्थितौ ॥
1.55.m: The Sun and the Moon or Mercury and Saturn mutually aspect; or the Sun is in an even sign; / or Mars aspects the ascendant and the Moon in an odd sign—twins are born in even and odd positions.

1.55.s:
kujekṣitepumāṃśeduhitā klība janmadā /
same sitendū ojasthā jñārāṅgojyā nṛvīkṣitau //
1.55.d:
कुजेक्षितेपुमांशेदुहिता क्लीब जन्मदा ।
समे सितेन्दू ओजस्था ज्ञाराङ्गोज्या नृवीक्षितौ ॥
1.55.m: If aspected by Mars in a masculine degree, a daughter is born; or it causes the birth of a hermaphrodite. / If Venus and the Moon are in an even sign, and Mercury, Mars, the ascendant, and Jupiter are in an odd sign aspected by a male;

1.55.s:
lagnendusamagau yugmasthāne vā yamalaṅkarāḥ /
grahodayasthāndyaṅgāṃśānpaśyati jñe svabhāgage //
1.55.d:
लग्नेन्दुसमगौ युग्मस्थाने वा यमलङ्कराः ।
ग्रहोदयस्थान्द्यङ्गांशान्पश्यति ज्ञे स्वभागगे ॥
1.55.m: or if the ascendant and the Moon are in an even sign, or in an even place, they produce twins. / When Mercury, situated in its own degree, aspects the dual navāṃśas rising in the ascendant,

1.55.s:
tritayaṃ jñāṃśakādyugmamamiśraiḥ samamādiśet /
lagne cāpāntyabhāgasthe tadaṃśasthabaligrahaiḥ //
1.55.d:
त्रितयं ज्ञांशकाद्युग्मममिश्रैः सममादिशेत् ।
लग्ने चापान्त्यभागस्थे तदंशस्थबलिग्रहैः ॥
1.55.m: one should predict triplets from Mercury's degree, twins from unmixed signs, and parity accordingly. / When the ascendant is in the last degree of Sagittarius with strong planets in that degree,

1.55.s:
vīryāḍhyajñārkisadṛṣṭaiḥ kośasthāvahavoginaḥ /
sitārejyārkacandrārkijñāṅgeśorkendavo 'dhipāḥ //
1.55.d:
वीर्याढ्यज्ञार्किसदृष्टैः कोशस्थावहवोगिनः ।
सितारेज्यार्कचन्द्रार्किज्ञाङ्गेशोर्केन्दवो ऽधिपाः ॥
1.55.m: aspected by strong Mercury and Saturn, triplets are born within the membrane. / Venus, Mars, Jupiter, the Sun, the Moon, Saturn, Mercury, the lord of the ascendant, the Sun, and the Moon are the lords

1.55.s:
māsānāṃ tatsamaṃ vācyaṃ garbagasthasya śubhāśubham /
trikome jñe parairnaṣṭairdvimukhāhnikapānvitaḥ //
1.55.d:
मासानां तत्समं वाच्यं गर्बगस्थस्य शुभाशुभम् ।
त्रिकोमे ज्ञे परैर्नष्टैर्द्विमुखाह्निकपान्वितः ॥
1.55.m: of the months; good or bad for the one in the womb should be declared in accordance with them. / When Mercury is in a trine while the others are lost, [the child] has two faces or holds a day-ruler's nature.

1.55.s:
avāgāvāṭāvaśubhairbhasaṃdhisthaiḥ prajāyate /
vīrānsagīścadaṣṭedhvaṣṭārkātabhasaṃhitāḥ //
1.55.d:
अवागावाटावशुभैर्भसंधिस्थैः प्रजायते ।
वीरान्सगीश्चदष्टेध्वष्टार्कातभसंहिताः ॥
1.55.m: One is born speechless or blind through malefics situated in sign-junctions, / or deformed with teeth destroyed when conjoined with signs afflicted by the Sun.

1.55.s:
ārārkī cejyabhāṃśasthau sadantogarbhakastadāḥ /
kharbheje bhuvimandāradṛṣṭe kubjastu garbhagaḥ /
pargurmīne yamedvārairdaṣṭethāṅgebhaghasaṃdhige //
1.55.d:
आरार्की चेज्यभांशस्थौ सदन्तोगर्भकस्तदाः ।
खर्भेजे भुविमन्दारदृष्टे कुब्जस्तु गर्भगः ।
पर्गुर्मीने यमेद्वारैर्दष्टेथाङ्गेभघसंधिगे ॥
1.55.m: If Mars and Saturn occupy a degree of Jupiter, then the child in the womb has teeth. / If in Aries or a sign of the Earth aspected by Saturn and Mars, the fetus is a hunchback; / or if Pisces is the ascendant and Saturn occupies a door and is aspected by malefics, or the ascendant is in a sign-junction,

1.55.s:
pāpairjaḍo vidhau garbhaḥ śubhadṛṣṭivivarjite /
mṛgāntyage vāmanakaḥ sauredrarkanirīkṣite /
dhīnayodapagaistryaṃśaiḥ pāpāstairasirohradāḥ //
1.55.d:
पापैर्जडो विधौ गर्भः शुभदृष्टिविवर्जिते ।
मृगान्त्यगे वामनकः सौरेद्रर्कनिरीक्षिते ।
धीनयोदपगैस्त्र्यंशैः पापास्तैरसिरोह्रदाः ॥
1.55.m: the fetus is dull-witted through malefics when the Moon is devoid of the aspect of benefics. / If in the end of Capricorn, aspected by Saturn and the Sun, [the child is] a dwarf; / by malefics occupying decanates of the fifth or watery signs, [they are born] headless or lacking limbs.

1.55.s:
ravīnduyukte siṃheṅge māheyārkinirīkṣite /
netrahīnā miśrakheṭairdṛṣṭe buddhudalocanāḥ /
vyayejo vāmanayanaṃ dakṣaṃ sūryo vināśayet //
1.55.d:
रवीन्दुयुक्ते सिंहेङ्गे माहेयार्किनिरीक्षिते ।
नेत्रहीना मिश्रखेटैर्दृष्टे बुद्धुदलोचनाः ।
व्ययेजो वामनयनं दक्षं सूर्यो विनाशयेत् ॥
1.55.m: When Leo is the ascendant conjoined with the Sun and Moon and aspected by Mars and Saturn, / [the child is] blind; if aspected by mixed planets, they have bubble-like eyes. / Jupiter in the twelfth destroys the left eye, and the Sun destroys the right.

1.55.s:
neṣṭā yogāḥ śubhairdṛṣṭāḥ pāpāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ /
mande 'ste mandabhāṃśeṅge niṣaikebdatraye janiḥ //
1.55.d:
नेष्टा योगाः शुभैर्दृष्टाः पापाः स्युर्नात्र संशयः ।
मन्दे ऽस्ते मन्दभांशेङ्गे निषैकेब्दत्रये जनिः ॥
1.55.m: Inauspicious combinations aspected by benefics become auspicious; of this there is no doubt. / When Saturn is in the seventh house and the ascendant is in Saturn's degree, birth occurs three years after conception;

1.55.s: dvādaśābde śaśinyevaṃ sutāvapi vicintayet //
1.55.d: द्वादशाब्दे शशिन्येवं सुतावपि विचिन्तयेत् ॥
1.55.m: in the twelfth year if the Moon is likewise situated: so one should consider concerning the child.

1.55.s: ādhānendudvādaśāṃśā pāpāstadrāśibhiḥ puraḥ //
1.55.d: आधानेन्दुद्वादशांशा पापास्तद्राशिभिः पुरः ॥
1.55.m: Malefics in the dvādaśāṃśa of the Moon at conception, preceded by those signs,

1.55.s: śaśāṅke janmabhāgādidvi ghnamiṣṭakalāḥ smṛtāḥ //
1.55.d: शशाङ्के जन्मभागादिद्वि घ्नमिष्टकलाः स्मृताः ॥
1.55.m: when the Moon is in the birth degree doubled, are known as the desired elapsed times.

1.55.s: pituḥ parokṣe janmasyādindau lagnamapaśyati //
1.55.d: पितुः परोक्षे जन्मस्यादिन्दौ लग्नमपश्यति ॥
1.55.m: Birth occurs in the absence of the father when the Moon does not aspect the ascendant.

1.55.s:
madhyādbhraṣṭerke videśasthe janane nārijanma vai /
mandeṅgasthe kujeste ca jñosphuji madhyage vidhau //
1.55.d:
मध्याद्भ्रष्टेर्के विदेशस्थे जनने नारिजन्म वै ।
मन्देङ्गस्थे कुजेस्ते च ज्ञोस्फुजि मध्यगे विधौ ॥
1.55.m: When the Sun has fallen from the meridian, the father is in a foreign land; when it is in the seventh, indeed, birth occurs away from the woman. / When Saturn is in the ascendant, Mars in the seventh, and Mercury and Venus are in the meridian with the Moon,

1.55.s:
pāpāṅgebje tribhāge lau svāyagaiḥ sadbhirudgataḥ /
sūryastaddṛṣṭigo vāpi jñeyo jyotirvidāṃ varaiḥ //
1.55.d:
पापाङ्गेब्जे त्रिभागे लौ स्वायगैः सद्भिरुद्गतः ।
सूर्यस्तद्दृष्टिगो वापि ज्ञेयो ज्योतिर्विदां वरैः ॥
1.55.m: or when malefics are in the ascendant, or the Moon is in a decanate with benefics occupying their own or eleventh houses, / the Sun has risen or is in their aspect—this should be known by the best of astrologers.

1.55.s:
catuṣpadarkṣage bhānau śerṣaibalayutaiḥ khagaiḥ /
kośādatau tu yamalau jāyete munisattama //
1.55.d:
चतुष्पदर्क्षगे भानौ शेर्षैबलयुतैः खगैः ।
कोशादतौ तु यमलौ जायेते मुनिसत्तम ॥
1.55.m: When the Sun is in a quadruped sign and the other planets are endowed with strength, / two twins are born from the womb, O best of sages.

1.55.s:
sārkyārasiṃhojñājāṃse bhāṃśatutyāṅganālayuk /
lagnaminduṃ ca sārkenduṃ na paśyati yadā guruḥ //
1.55.d:
सार्क्यारसिंहोज्ञाजांसे भांशतुत्याङ्गनालयुक् ।
लग्नमिन्दुं च सार्केन्दुं न पश्यति यदा गुरुः ॥
1.55.m: When the degree of the Sun, Mars, Leo, Mercury, or Aries is conjoined with an equal number of women, / and Jupiter does not aspect the ascendant, the Moon, or the Sun and Moon together,

1.55.s:
sapāpagor'ke jāyo vā paravīryaprasūtikṛt /
pāpabhasthau pāpakheṭaiḥ sūryārghānatrikoṇagau //
1.55.d:
सपापगोर्ऽके जायो वा परवीर्यप्रसूतिकृत् ।
पापभस्थौ पापखेटैः सूर्यार्घानत्रिकोणगौ ॥
1.55.m: or the Sun is conjoined with a malefic in the seventh, the birth is generated by another's seed. / When both are in malefic signs, and by malefic planets the Sun and Moon are placed in trines,

1.55.s:
videśagaḥ pitāvṛddhaḥ khevā rāśivaśātyaye /
pūrṇa iṇḍhau svabheśejñe śubhe muvyaṃvuje tanau //
1.55.d:
विदेशगः पितावृद्धः खेवा राशिवशात्यये ।
पूर्ण इण्ढौ स्वभेशेज्ञे शुभे मुव्यंवुजे तनौ ॥
1.55.m: the father has gone to a foreign land or is aged, or there is danger according to the nature of the sign. / When the Moon is full in its own sign, Mercury and benefics are in the ascendant or an aquatic sign,

1.55.s:
dyūnasthe vā vidhau yāteṅganā nārī prasūyate /
abdhāṅgamanbhagaḥ pūrṇe jyo vā paśyati nārada //
1.55.d:
द्यूनस्थे वा विधौ यातेङ्गना नारी प्रसूयते ।
अब्धाङ्गमन्भगः पूर्णे ज्यो वा पश्यति नारद ॥
1.55.m: or when the Moon is in the seventh house, a woman gives birth on a boat. / When the full Moon is in a watery sign or aspected by Jupiter, O Nārada,

1.55.s:
svabaṃlagnagaḥ sūtiḥ salile nātra saṃsayaḥ /
pāpadṛṣṭe yame gudyāṃ janmāṅgājavyayasthite //
1.55.d:
स्वबंलग्नगः सूतिः सलिले नात्र संसयः ।
पापदृष्टे यमे गुद्यां जन्माङ्गाजव्ययस्थिते ॥
1.55.m: and situated in its own ascendant, delivery takes place in water; there is no doubt about this. / When Saturn is aspected by malefics in a ditch, birth occurs in the ascendant or twelfth from Aries.

1.55.s:
karkātilagnageśaurevaṭe janmābjavīkṣite /
mande janmagate lagne budhasūryenduvīkṣite //
1.55.d:
कर्कातिलग्नगेशौरेवटे जन्माब्जवीक्षिते ।
मन्दे जन्मगते लग्ने बुधसूर्येन्दुवीक्षिते ॥
1.55.m: When Saturn is in Cancer or the ascendant aspected by the Moon, birth is under a banyan tree. / When Saturn is in the ascendant at birth, aspected by Mercury, the Sun, and the Moon,

1.55.s:
krīḍāsthāne devagehe pyūṣare ca kramājjaniḥ /
śmaśāne lagnadṛgasṛgrāmyasthānebjabhārgavau //
1.55.d:
क्रीडास्थाने देवगेहे प्यूषरे च क्रमाज्जनिः ।
श्मशाने लग्नदृगसृग्राम्यस्थानेब्जभार्गवौ ॥
1.55.m: birth occurs respectively in a pleasure-ground, a temple, or barren soil. / If Mars aspects the ascendant, it is in a cremation ground; if the Moon and Venus, in a pleasant village place;

1.55.s:
agnihotragṛhe jīvor'ke bhūṣābharaṇe gṛhe /
śilpālaye budho janma kuryādbalasamanvitaḥ //
1.55.d:
अग्निहोत्रगृहे जीवोर्ऽके भूषाभरणे गृहे ।
शिल्पालये बुधो जन्म कुर्याद्बलसमन्वितः ॥
1.55.m: under Jupiter, in a sacrificial house; under the Sun, in a decorated mansion; / and when endowed with strength, Mercury causes birth in an artisan's workshop.

1.55.s:
bhāsamāne sare mārge sthire svarkṣāṃśage gṛhe /
trikoṇagaja ārārkyoraste vā sṛjyate 'mbayā //
1.55.d:
भासमाने सरे मार्गे स्थिरे स्वर्क्षांशगे गृहे ।
त्रिकोणगज आरार्क्योरस्ते वा सृज्यते ऽम्बया ॥
1.55.m: In a movable sign it is on the road; in a fixed sign or its own sign and degree, in a house. / When Mars and Saturn are in trines or in the seventh, the child is abandoned by the mother.

1.55.s:
gurudṛṣṭe tu dīrghāyuḥ paraṃ ca prāpyate punaḥ /
pāpadṛṣṭe vidhaulagne 'stekuje tu vinaśyati //
1.55.d:
गुरुदृष्टे तु दीर्घायुः परं च प्राप्यते पुनः ।
पापदृष्टे विधौलग्ने ऽस्तेकुजे तु विनश्यति ॥
1.55.m: When aspected by Jupiter, however, there is long life and, furthermore, supreme [well-being] is obtained. / But when aspected by a malefic, with the Moon in the ascendant and Mars in the descendant, he perishes.

1.55.s:
bhave kujārkyoḥ saṃdṛṣṭe parahastagataḥ sukhī /
pāpedyatāyurbhavati māsaḥ sārthaiḥ parairapi //
1.55.d:
भवे कुजार्क्योः संदृष्टे परहस्तगतः सुखी ।
पापेद्यतायुर्भवति मासः सार्थैः परैरपि ॥
1.55.m: If it is aspected by Mars and Saturn in the eleventh house, he goes into another's hands [yet] is happy. / When malefics aspect, the lifespan becomes [a matter of] months, or with other [factors] alongside.

1.55.s:
pitṛmātṛgehe janma tadadhīśabalānmune /
tarugehe śubhe nīce naikasthadṛṣṭau lagnenduḥ //
1.55.d:
पितृमातृगेहे जन्म तदधीशबलान्मुने ।
तरुगेहे शुभे नीचे नैकस्थदृष्टौ लग्नेन्दुः ॥
1.55.m: Birth takes place in the father's or mother's house depending on the strength of their lords, O sage; / in a wooden house if a benefic is debilitated, when the ascendant and the Moon are not aspected by multiple [planets].

1.55.s:
etallakṣaṇasaṃpannā prasītirvijane tadā /
mandarkṣāṃśe vidhau turye mandadṛṣṭe 'bjage 'pi vā //
1.55.d:
एतल्लक्षणसंपन्ना प्रसीतिर्विजने तदा ।
मन्दर्क्षांशे विधौ तुर्ये मन्ददृष्टे ऽब्जगे ऽपि वा ॥
1.55.m: Endowed with these characteristics, birth takes place in a solitary place then, / when the Moon is in the sign or navāṃśa of Saturn, in the fourth house, aspected by Saturn, or in a watery sign.

1.55.s:
mandārcane vā tamasi śayanaṃ nīcagebhuvi /
śīrṣe pṛṣṭodaye janma tadvadeva vinirdiśet //
1.55.d:
मन्दार्चने वा तमसि शयनं नीचगेभुवि ।
शीर्षे पृष्टोदये जन्म तद्वदेव विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
1.55.m: Or in the worship-place of Saturn, in darkness, the lying-down is on the ground if [the planet is] debilitated; / in a sign rising by head or back, the birth should be indicated in the very same way.

1.55.s:
candrāstasukhagaḥ pāpairmātuḥ pīḍāṃ samādiśet /
jīrṇoddhṛtaṃ gṛhaṃ mande sṛji dagdhaṃ na vā vidhau //
1.55.d:
चन्द्रास्तसुखगः पापैर्मातुः पीडां समादिशेत् ।
जीर्णोद्धृतं गृहं मन्दे सृजि दग्धं न वा विधौ ॥
1.55.m: Malefics in the seventh or fourth house from the Moon indicate affliction to the mother. / The house is dilapidated and rebuilt when Saturn [is there], burnt when Mars [is there], or [so] with the Moon.

1.55.s:
kāṣṭāḍhyamadṛḍhaṃ sūya bahuśilpayutaṃ budhe /
citrayuktaṃ navaṃ śukre dṛḍhe ramye gurau gṛham //
1.55.d:
काष्टाढ्यमदृढं सूय बहुशिल्पयुतं बुधे ।
चित्रयुक्तं नवं शुक्रे दृढे रम्ये गुरौ गृहम् ॥
1.55.m: With the Sun, the house is rich in wood and frail; with Mercury, it has many crafts; / with Venus, it is adorned with paintings and new; with Jupiter, it is firm and delightful.

1.55.s:
dhaṭājakarkyalighaṭe pūrve jñejyagṛhe hyudak /
vṛṣe paścānmṛge siṃhe dakṣiṇe vasatirbhavet //
1.55.d:
धटाजकर्क्यलिघटे पूर्वे ज्ञेज्यगृहे ह्युदक् ।
वृषे पश्चान्मृगे सिंहे दक्षिणे वसतिर्भवेत् ॥
1.55.m: In Libra, Aries, Cancer, Scorpio, and Aquarius, [the dwelling is] in the east; in the houses of Mercury and Jupiter, in the north; / in Taurus, in the west; in Capricorn and Leo, the dwelling is in the south.

1.55.s:
gṛhaprācyādigau dvau dvau vdyaṅgāḥ koṇeṣvajādayaḥ /
parthaṅke vāstuvatpādāsriṣadaṅkāntyarāśayaḥ //
1.55.d:
गृहप्राच्यादिगौ द्वौ द्वौ व्द्यङ्गाः कोणेष्वजादयः ।
पर्थङ्के वास्तुवत्पादास्रिषदङ्कान्त्यराशयः ॥
1.55.m: Two [signs] each belong to the east and the other directions of the house; the dual signs, Aries and the rest, are in the corners. / Separately, like the Vāstupuruṣa, the signs from the sixth to the twelfth represent the feet [and other body parts].

1.55.s:
candrāgāntaragaiḥ kheṭaiḥ sūtikāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ /
cakrāddhi bahirantaśca dṛśyādṛśyopare 'nyathā //
1.55.d:
चन्द्रागान्तरगैः खेटैः सूतिकाः समुदाहृताः ।
चक्राद्धि बहिरन्तश्च दृश्यादृश्योपरे ऽन्यथा ॥
1.55.m: By the planets situated between the Moon and the ascendant, the women attending the childbirth are declared: / outside and inside the zodiacal wheel, visible and invisible, and otherwise for the others.

1.55.s:
lagrāśayasamānāṅgobālikheṭaṃsamopi vā /
candranandāṃśavadvarṇaḥ śīrṣādyaṅgavibhāga yuk //
1.55.d:
लग्राशयसमानाङ्गोबालिखेटंसमोपि वा ।
चन्द्रनन्दांशवद्वर्णः शीर्षाद्यङ्गविभाग युक् ॥
1.55.m: His limbs correspond to the ascendant-sign, or are like the strongest planet; / his complexion is like the navāṃśa of the Moon, possessing divisions of limbs from the head onward.

1.55.s:
śīrṣakaṃ dakśrave nāsā kapolahanavo mukham /
kaṇṭhāṃsapārśvahṛddvoṣaḥ kroḍaṃnābhiśca bāstikāḥ //
1.55.d:
शीर्षकं दक्श्रवे नासा कपोलहनवो मुखम् ।
कण्ठांसपार्श्वहृद्द्वोषः क्रोडंनाभिश्च बास्तिकाः ॥
1.55.m: The head, right ear, nose, cheeks, jaw, and face; / neck, shoulders, flanks, chest, belly, and pelvis;

1.55.s:
śiṃśnāpāte ca vṛṣaṇau jaghane jānunī tathā /
jaṅghepādau cobhaghayatra tryaṃśaiḥ samuditairvadet //
1.55.d:
शिंश्नापाते च वृषणौ जघने जानुनी तथा ।
जङ्घेपादौ चोभघयत्र त्र्यंशैः समुदितैर्वदेत् ॥
1.55.m: the penis, anus, testicles, thighs, and knees, / and the shanks and feet on both sides—he should declare them by the combined decanates.

1.55.s:
pāpayukte vraṇastasminnaṅge lakṣma ca tadyute /
svarkṣāṃśe sthirayukte tu naija āgantuko 'nyathā //
1.55.d:
पापयुक्ते व्रणस्तस्मिन्नङ्गे लक्ष्म च तद्युते ।
स्वर्क्षांशे स्थिरयुक्ते तु नैज आगन्तुको ऽन्यथा ॥
1.55.m: On the limb connected with a malefic there is a wound; connected with a [benefic], a mark. / In its own sign or navāṃśa, or joined with a fixed [sign], it is innate; otherwise, acquired.

1.55.s:
mande 'nilāśmajo bhaume viṣaśasrāgnijo budhe /
bhujer'ke kāṣṭapaśujo jetuḥ śṛṅgyajayonijaḥ //
1.55.d:
मन्दे ऽनिलाश्मजो भौमे विषशस्राग्निजो बुधे ।
भुजेर्ऽके काष्टपशुजो जेतुः शृङ्ग्यजयोनिजः ॥
1.55.m: Under Saturn, it arises from wind or stone; under Mars, from poison, weapons, or fire; under Mercury, / from earth; under the Sun, from wood or cattle; under Jupiter, from horned animals, goats, or women.

1.55.s:
yasminsaṃjñāsrayaḥ kheṭā aṅgesyustatra niścitam /
vraṇośubhakṛtaḥ pṛṣṭetanau rāśisamāśrite //
1.55.d:
यस्मिन्संज्ञास्रयः खेटा अङ्गेस्युस्तत्र निश्चितम् ।
व्रणोशुभकृतः पृष्टेतनौ राशिसमाश्रिते ॥
1.55.m: On whichever limb the planets bearing the appellations are, certainly there / a wound caused by an inauspicious [planet] is placed on the body according to the sign.

1.55.s:
tilakṛnmasakṛdaṣṭasaumyairyuktaśca lakṣmavān /
caturasraḥ piṅgadṛk ca paittiko 'lpakaco raviḥ //
1.55.d:
तिलकृन्मसकृदष्टसौम्यैर्युक्तश्च लक्ष्मवान् ।
चतुरस्रः पिङ्गदृक् च पैत्तिको ऽल्पकचो रविः ॥
1.55.m: Joined with benefics in the eighth house, he produces moles and freckles, and possesses marks. / The Sun is square, has yellowish-brown eyes, is bilious, and has scanty hair.

1.55.s:
vṛto vātakaphī prājño mandavāk śubhadṛk śaśī /
krṛradṛktaruṇo bhaumaḥ paittikaścapalastathā //
1.55.d:
वृतो वातकफी प्राज्ञो मन्दवाक् शुभदृक् शशी ।
क्रृरदृक्तरुणो भौमः पैत्तिकश्चपलस्तथा ॥
1.55.m: The Moon is round, windy and phlegmatic, wise, of slow speech, and has auspicious eyes; / Mars has fierce eyes, is youthful, bilious, and fickle.

1.55.s:
tridhānupavṛtirhāsyarucijñaḥ śliṣṭavāktathā /
piṅgake ślakṣaṇo dīrghaḥ kaphīdhīmāngururmataḥ //
1.55.d:
त्रिधानुपवृतिर्हास्यरुचिज्ञः श्लिष्टवाक्तथा ।
पिङ्गके श्लक्षणो दीर्घः कफीधीमान्गुरुर्मतः ॥
1.55.m: Mercury has a threefold nature, delights in humor, and speaks equivocally; / Jupiter is considered to have yellowish hair, to be smooth, tall, phlegmatic, and intelligent.

1.55.s:
suvapurlocanaḥ kṛṣṇavakrakeśo bhṛguḥ sukhī /
dīrghaḥ kapiladṛḍbhando nilīkharakacolasaḥ //
1.55.d:
सुवपुर्लोचनः कृष्णवक्रकेशो भृगुः सुखी ।
दीर्घः कपिलदृड्भन्दो निलीखरकचोलसः ॥
1.55.m: Venus has a handsome body and eyes, black and curly hair, and is happy; / Saturn is tall, has dark brown eyes, is dark, with rough hair, and lazy.

1.55.s:
snāyvasthiraktatvakśukravasāmajjāstu dhātavaḥ /
mandārkacandrasomyāspujijjīvakubhuvaḥ kramāt //
1.55.d:
स्नाय्वस्थिरक्तत्वक्शुक्रवसामज्जास्तु धातवः ।
मन्दार्कचन्द्रसोम्यास्पुजिज्जीवकुभुवः क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: Sinews, bone, blood, skin, semen, fat, and marrow are the bodily constituents / of Saturn, the Sun, the Moon, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, and Mars respectively.

1.55.s:
candrāṅgapāpairbhāntyasthaiḥ seṃvupāpacatuṣṭayaiḥ /
cakrapūrvāpare pāpasaumyaiḥ kīṭatanau mṛtiḥ //
1.55.d:
चन्द्राङ्गपापैर्भान्त्यस्थैः सेंवुपापचतुष्टयैः ।
चक्रपूर्वापरे पापसौम्यैः कीटतनौ मृतिः ॥
1.55.m: When the Moon, the ascendant, and malefics are in the last degrees of signs, or when the four malefics are in watery [signs], / or when malefics and benefics occupy the eastern and western halves of the circle, death occurs if Scorpio is the ascendant.

1.55.s:
udayāstagatau pāpau candraḥ krūrayutaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
na ceddṛṣṭastadā mṛtyurjātasya bhavati dhruvam //
1.55.d:
उदयास्तगतौ पापौ चन्द्रः क्रूरयुतैः शुभैः ।
न चेद्दृष्टस्तदा मृत्युर्जातस्य भवति ध्रुवम् ॥
1.55.m: If malefics are in the ascendant and descendant, and the Moon is joined with cruel [planets] / and not aspected by benefics, then the child certainly dies.

1.55.s:
kṣīṇe 'bje vyayage pāpairlagnāṣṭasthaiḥ śubhā na cet /
kendreṣu vābjosaṃyuktaḥ smarāntyamṛtilagnagaḥ //
1.55.d:
क्षीणे ऽब्जे व्ययगे पापैर्लग्नाष्टस्थैः शुभा न चेत् ।
केन्द्रेषु वाब्जोसंयुक्तः स्मरान्त्यमृतिलग्नगः ॥
1.55.m: When the Moon is waning in the twelfth house and malefics are in the ascendant and eighth, if benefics do not [aspect], / or if the Moon is in the cardines, or combined in the seventh, twelfth, eighth, or ascendant,

1.55.s:
kendrādyā hasta sankheṭairadṛṣṭo mṛtyudastathā /
ṣaṣṭemebje 'sadṛṣṭesadyo mṛtyuḥ śubhekṣite //
1.55.d:
केन्द्राद्या हस्त सन्खेटैरदृष्टो मृत्युदस्तथा ।
षष्टेमेब्जे ऽसदृष्टेसद्यो मृत्युः शुभेक्षिते ॥
1.55.m: unseen by the planets from the cardines onward, it thus brings death. / When the Moon is in the sixth house and aspected by a malefic, there is immediate death; if aspected by a benefic,

1.55.s:
samāṣṭake miśrakheṭairdṛṣṭe mṛtiḥ śiśoḥ /
kṣīṇebjeṅge randhrakende pāpe pāpāntarasthite //
1.55.d:
समाष्टके मिश्रखेटैर्दृष्टे मृतिः शिशोः ।
क्षीणेब्जेङ्गे रन्ध्रकेन्दे पापे पापान्तरस्थिते ॥
1.55.m: in eight years, [or] if aspected by mixed planets, there is death of the infant. / When the waning Moon is in the ascendant, a malefic in the eighth or a cardine, or placed between malefics,

1.55.s:
bhūdyūnanidhane vābje lagne 'pyevaṃ śiśormṛtiḥ /
pāpaiścandrāstagairmātrā sārddhaṃ sadṛṣṭimantarā //
1.55.d:
भूद्यूननिधने वाब्जे लग्ने ऽप्येवं शिशोर्मृतिः ।
पापैश्चन्द्रास्तगैर्मात्रा सार्द्धं सदृष्टिमन्तरा ॥
1.55.m: or when the Moon is in the ascendant, seventh, or eighth, there is likewise death of the infant. / With malefics in the descendant from the Moon, without benefic aspect, [it dies] along with its mother.

1.55.s:
śubhādṛṣṭe bhāntyagebje trikoṇoparataiḥ khalaiḥ /
sagnasthe vā vidhaupāpairastasthairmṛtimāpnuyāt //
1.55.d:
शुभादृष्टे भान्त्यगेब्जे त्रिकोणोपरतैः खलैः ।
सग्नस्थे वा विधौपापैरस्तस्थैर्मृतिमाप्नुयात् ॥
1.55.m: When the Moon is at the end of a sign and not aspected by a benefic, while malefics are in the trines; / or when the Moon is in the ascendant and malefics are in the descendant, he meets death.

1.55.s:
graste 'bje 'sadbhiraṣṭasthai sṛjyavātmajayormṛtiḥ /
lagne ravau tu śasreṇa savīryāsadbhiraṣṭagaiḥ //
1.55.d:
ग्रस्ते ऽब्जे ऽसद्भिरष्टस्थै सृज्यवात्मजयोर्मृतिः ।
लग्ने रवौ तु शस्रेण सवीर्यासद्भिरष्टगैः ॥
1.55.m: When an eclipsed Moon is present and malefics are in the eighth, death of both the mother and the child [ensues]; / but with the Sun in the ascendant and strong malefics in the eighth, [death is] by a weapon.

1.55.s:
karkendvījyayute lagne kendre saumye ca bhārgave /
śaṣaistryarīśagairāyuramitaṃ bhavati dhruvam //
1.55.d:
कर्केन्द्वीज्ययुते लग्ने केन्द्रे सौम्ये च भार्गवे ।
शषैस्त्र्यरीशगैरायुरमितं भवति ध्रुवम् ॥
1.55.m: When the ascendant is Cancer joined with the Moon and Jupiter, Mercury and Venus in a cardine, / and the remaining [planets] in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses, the lifespan is certainly immeasurable.

1.55.s:
varṅgottame mīnalagne vṛṣe 'bje tattvalipsike /
svatuṅgastheṣvaśeṣeṣu paramāyuḥ prakīrtitam //
1.55.d:
वर्ङ्गोत्तमे मीनलग्ने वृषे ऽब्जे तत्त्वलिप्सिके ।
स्वतुङ्गस्थेष्वशेषेषु परमायुः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
1.55.m: With Pisces as the ascendant in a vargottama, the Moon in Taurus at twenty-five degrees, / and all the rest in their exaltations, the maximum lifespan is declared.

1.55.s:
śubhairdṛṣṭaḥ savīryoge kendrasthe cāyurarthadaḥ /
svaccobje svarkṣagaiḥ saumyaiḥ savīryeṅgādhipe tanau //
1.55.d:
शुभैर्दृष्टः सवीर्योगे केन्द्रस्थे चायुरर्थदः ।
स्वच्चोब्जे स्वर्क्षगैः सौम्यैः सवीर्येङ्गाधिपे तनौ ॥
1.55.m: Aspected by benefics, endowed with strength, and placed in a cardine, it bestows lifespan and wealth; / when the Moon is in its exaltation, benefics are in their own signs, and the lord of the ascendant is strong in the ascendant,

1.55.s:
ṣaṣṭyabdakendrasaumyebheṣṭaśuddhe saptatirgurau /
mūlatrikoṇagaiḥ saumyairguro svoccasamanvite //
1.55.d:
षष्ट्यब्दकेन्द्रसौम्येभेष्टशुद्धे सप्ततिर्गुरौ ।
मूलत्रिकोणगैः सौम्यैर्गुरो स्वोच्चसमन्विते ॥
1.55.m: [the life is] sixty years; with benefics in cardines, when affliction is removed, seventy under Jupiter; / with benefics in their mūlatrikoṇas and Jupiter joined with its exaltation,

1.55.s:
lagnādhipe balayutaśītyabdaṃ tvāyurīritam /
savīrye satsu kendreṣu triṃśacchuddhiyute 'ṣṭame //
1.55.d:
लग्नाधिपे बलयुतशीत्यब्दं त्वायुरीरितम् ।
सवीर्ये सत्सु केन्द्रेषु त्रिंशच्छुद्धियुते ऽष्टमे ॥
1.55.m: and the lord of the ascendant endowed with strength, a lifespan of eighty years is stated. / When the cardines have strong benefics and the eighth is cleared of thirty [degrees of affliction],

1.55.s:
layeśe dharmagejīveṣṭasthe krūrakṣite jitāḥ /
lagnāṣṭameśāvaṣṭasthau bhābdamāyuḥ karau matau //
1.55.d:
लयेशे धर्मगेजीवेष्टस्थे क्रूरक्षिते जिताः ।
लग्नाष्टमेशावष्टस्थौ भाब्दमायुः करौ मतौ ॥
1.55.m: when the lord of the twelfth is in the ninth, Jupiter in the eighth, and they are overcome by the aspect of malefics; / the lords of the ascendant and eighth placed in the eighth are considered to grant twenty-seven years of life.

1.55.s:
lagne 'śubhejyau glaudṛṣṭau mṛtyau kaścana cākṛtiḥ /
dharmāṅgastheśanau śukre kendre 'bje vyayadharmage //
1.55.d:
लग्ने ऽशुभेज्यौ ग्लौदृष्टौ मृत्यौ कश्चन चाकृतिः ।
धर्माङ्गस्थेशनौ शुक्रे केन्द्रे ऽब्जे व्ययधर्मगे ॥
1.55.m: If a malefic and Jupiter are in the ascendant, aspected by the Moon, in the house of death some form [of early demise occurs]. / With Saturn in the ninth or ascendant, Venus in a cardine, and the Moon in the twelfth or ninth,

1.55.s:
śatābdaṃ gīṣpatau karke kaṭakasthasitejyayoḥ /
layeśeṅge śubhairhīne 'ṣṭame ravābdhimitaṃ vayaḥ //
1.55.d:
शताब्दं गीष्पतौ कर्के कटकस्थसितेज्ययोः ।
लयेशेङ्गे शुभैर्हीने ऽष्टमे रवाब्धिमितं वयः ॥
1.55.m: [the lifespan is] one hundred years; with Jupiter in Cancer, and Venus and Jupiter in Cancer; / with the lord of the twelfth in the ascendant, and the eighth devoid of benefics, the age is measured at forty-four.

1.55.s:
lagne śeṣṭamageṣṭeśe tanusthe pañcavatsaram /
kavījyayoge saumyābjau lagne mṛtyau ca sveṣavaḥ //
1.55.d:
लग्ने शेष्टमगेष्टेशे तनुस्थे पञ्चवत्सरम् ।
कवीज्ययोगे सौम्याब्जौ लग्ने मृत्यौ च स्वेषवः ॥
1.55.m: When the lord of the ascendant is in the eighth and the lord of the eighth is in the ascendant, [the life is] five years; / in a conjunction of Venus and Jupiter, with Mercury and the Moon in the ascendant and eighth, [the life is] fifty.

1.55.s:
etadyogajamāyuḥ syādatha spaṣṭamudīyate /
sūryādhika bale paiṇḍaṃ nisargāñca vidhorbale //
1.55.d:
एतद्योगजमायुः स्यादथ स्पष्टमुदीयते ।
सूर्याधिक बले पैण्डं निसर्गाञ्च विधोर्बले ॥
1.55.m: This would be the lifespan produced by combinations; now it is proclaimed explicitly: / the paiṇḍa [lifespan] when the Sun has greater strength, the nisarga when the Moon is strong,

1.55.s:
aṃśāyuḥ sabale lagne tatsādhanamatho śṛṇu /
gobjāstattvatithī sūryāstithiḥ svargā nakhāḥ kramāt //
1.55.d:
अंशायुः सबले लग्ने तत्साधनमथो शृणु ।
गोब्जास्तत्त्वतिथी सूर्यास्तिथिः स्वर्गा नखाः क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: and the aṃśāyuḥ when the ascendant is strong. Now hear the calculation thereof: / nineteen, twenty-five, fifteen, fifteen, twelve, and twenty in order,

1.55.s: nakhā vidhurdvāvaṅkāśca dhṛtiḥ svākṣikhamārgaṇāḥ //
1.55.d: नखा विधुर्द्वावङ्काश्च धृतिः स्वाक्षिखमार्गणाः ॥
1.55.m: [and] twenty, one, two, nine, eighteen, and fifty-two.

1.55.s:
piṇḍe nisarge ravocce no grahaḥ ṣaṭbhālpako yadā /
cakraśuddhastadā grāhyesyāṃśā āyuṣisaṃmatāḥ //
1.55.d:
पिण्डे निसर्गे रवोच्चे नो ग्रहः षट्भाल्पको यदा ।
चक्रशुद्धस्तदा ग्राह्येस्यांशा आयुषिसंमताः ॥
1.55.m: In the piṇḍa and nisarga [systems], at the Sun's exaltation, when a planet is not less than six signs [away], / then the parts purified by the circle are to be taken as accepted for lifespan.

1.55.s:
aṃśonāḥ śantrubhe kāryā grahaṃ vakragatiṃ vinā /
mandaśuktau vinārddhonā grahasyāstaṅgatasya ca //
1.55.d:
अंशोनाः शन्त्रुभे कार्या ग्रहं वक्रगतिं विना ।
मन्दशुक्तौ विनार्द्धोना ग्रहस्यास्तङ्गतस्य च ॥
1.55.m: In an enemy's sign, portions are to be reduced, except for a planet in retrograde motion; / and reduced by half for a planet that is combust, except for Saturn and Venus.

1.55.s:
hānidvaye 'dhikāḥ kāryā yadā krūrastanau tadā /
vihāyārīnaṃśādyairhanyādāyurlavān bhajet //
1.55.d:
हानिद्वये ऽधिकाः कार्या यदा क्रूरस्तनौ तदा ।
विहायारीनंशाद्यैर्हन्यादायुर्लवान् भजेत् ॥
1.55.m: When there are two reductions, the greater is to be made. When a malefic is in the ascendant, / setting aside the enemies, one should multiply by the degrees and divide the lifespan by the fractions.

1.55.s:
bhagaṇāṃśairlabdhahīnāsteṣāṃ kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ /
pāpasyāṃśāḥ samagronā saumyasyārddhavivarjitāḥ //
1.55.d:
भगणांशैर्लब्धहीनास्तेषां कार्या विचक्षणैः ।
पापस्यांशाः समग्रोना सौम्यस्यार्द्धविवर्जिताः ॥
1.55.m: Those [portions] reduced by what is obtained from the degrees of the zodiac should be calculated by the wise: / the degrees of a malefic are entirely deducted, while those of a benefic are halved.

1.55.s:
spaṣṭāsteṃśāḥ khaṣaṭtryāsā guṇayitvā svakairgaṇaiḥ /
varṣāṇi śeṣamarkadhnaṃ hārātsaṃmāsakāḥ smṛtāḥ //
1.55.d:
स्पष्टास्तेंशाः खषट्त्र्यासा गुणयित्वा स्वकैर्गणैः ।
वर्षाणि शेषमर्कध्नं हारात्संमासकाः स्मृताः ॥
1.55.m: Those clarified degrees multiplied by three hundred and sixty by their respective groups / are the years; the remainder multiplied by twelve and [divided] by the divisor is known as the months.

1.55.s:
taccheṣaśca triguṇitaḥ tenaivāptaṃ dināni ca /
śeṣe ṣaṣṭyā hate bhakte hāreṇa ghaṭikādikam //
1.55.d:
तच्छेषश्च त्रिगुणितः तेनैवाप्तं दिनानि च ।
शेषे षष्ट्या हते भक्ते हारेण घटिकादिकम् ॥
1.55.m: And that remainder multiplied by thirty and divided by the same gives the days; / when the remainder is multiplied by sixty and divided by the divisor, ghaṭikās and the rest [are obtained].

1.55.s:
hitvā bhājyaṅgabhāgādīnkalīkṛtya khakhākṣibhiḥ /
bhajedvarṣāṇi śeṣe tu guṇite dvādaśādibhiḥ //
1.55.d:
हित्वा भाज्यङ्गभागादीन्कलीकृत्य खखाक्षिभिः ।
भजेद्वर्षाणि शेषे तु गुणिते द्वादशादिभिः ॥
1.55.m: Setting aside [the rest], converting the dividend's signs, degrees, and so forth into minutes, / one should divide by two hundred; and when the remainder is multiplied by twelve and so forth,

1.55.s:
dvisaptāṃśe ca māsādilagrāyurjāyate sphuṭam /
aśāyuṣī salagnānāṃ kheṭānāmaṃśakā hṛtāḥ //
1.55.d:
द्विसप्तांशे च मासादिलग्रायुर्जायते स्फुटम् ।
अशायुषी सलग्नानां खेटानामंशका हृताः ॥
1.55.m: in two-sevenths, months and so forth are clearly obtained as the lifespan from the ascendant. / In the aṃśāyur-method, the degrees of the planets together with the ascendant are divided;

1.55.s:
khayugairāyuraṃśāḥ syustatsaṃskāraṃ vadāmi te /
grahanalagnaṃ ṣaḍrātyaṃ cetsaṃskāro 'nyathā nahi //
1.55.d:
खयुगैरायुरंशाः स्युस्तत्संस्कारं वदामि ते ।
ग्रहनलग्नं षड्रात्यं चेत्संस्कारो ऽन्यथा नहि ॥
1.55.m: by twenty they become the lifespan degrees. I shall tell you their rectification: / if the planetary ascendant exceeds six signs, there is rectification, otherwise not.

1.55.s:
tadaṃśaḥ svāgnayo bhaktā labdhonobhūrguṇo bhavet /
yadaikālyaṃ tadāstāṃśāḥ svāgryāptonā ca bhūrguṇaḥ //
1.55.d:
तदंशः स्वाग्नयो भक्ता लब्धोनोभूर्गुणो भवेत् ।
यदैकाल्यं तदास्तांशाः स्वाग्र्याप्तोना च भूर्गुणः ॥
1.55.m: Dividing its degrees by three, the quotient subtracted from one becomes the multiplier; / when it has set, its setting degrees are divided by three and subtracted from one, yielding the multiplier.

1.55.s:
saumayasyārddhena pāpasya samagreṇeti niścayaḥ /
gumakadhnāścāyuraṃśāḥ saṃskāro 'yamudāhṛtaḥ //
1.55.d:
सौमयस्यार्द्धेन पापस्य समग्रेणेति निश्चयः ।
गुमकध्नाश्चायुरंशाः संस्कारो ऽयमुदाहृतः ॥
1.55.m: For a benefic, [the reduction is] by half; for a malefic, by the whole: this is certain. / The lifespan degrees are multiplied by the multiplier: this rectification has been proclaimed.

1.55.s:
āyuraṃśakalābhaktādviṃśatyābdā ināhatam /
śeṣaṃ dviśatabhaktaṃ syurmāsāḥ śeṣā dinādikam //
1.55.d:
आयुरंशकलाभक्ताद्विंशत्याब्दा इनाहतम् ।
शेषं द्विशतभक्तं स्युर्मासाः शेषा दिनादिकम् ॥
1.55.m: Dividing the minutes of lifespan degrees by twenty, [the quotient is] years; the remainder multiplied by twelve / and divided by two hundred gives the months; the remainder gives days and so forth.

1.55.s:
lagnāyuraṃśāstriguṇā digbhiktā syuḥ samāstataḥ /
śeṣer'kādiguṇe bhakte digbharmāsādikaṃ bhavet //
1.55.d:
लग्नायुरंशास्त्रिगुणा दिग्भिक्ता स्युः समास्ततः ।
शेषेर्ऽकादिगुणे भक्ते दिग्भर्मासादिकं भवेत् ॥
1.55.m: The span of life contributed by the ascendant, multiplied by three and divided by ten, gives the years. / The remainder multiplied by twelve and divided by ten yields the months and so on.

1.55.s:
sabaleṅgebhatulyābdairyutamāyurbhavetsphuṭam /
aṃśadvidhnamakṣāṃśaṃ māsāḥ khatryādisaṃguṇāt //
1.55.d:
सबलेङ्गेभतुल्याब्दैर्युतमायुर्भवेत्स्फुटम् ।
अंशद्विध्नमक्षांशं मासाः खत्र्यादिसंगुणात् ॥
1.55.m: When the ascendant is strong, the lifespan becomes correct when combined with years equal to eight [or the designated figure]. / One-fifth of the navāṃśa doubled yields the months; from the remainder multiplied by thirty and so forth,

1.55.s:
śeṣā dinādikaṃ yojyaṃ naitatpiṇḍanisargayoḥ /
lagnārkacandramadhye tu yo balī taddaśā purā //
1.55.d:
शेषा दिनादिकं योज्यं नैतत्पिण्डनिसर्गयोः ।
लग्नार्कचन्द्रमध्ये तु यो बली तद्दशा पुरा ॥
1.55.m: the days and so on are to be added; this does not apply to the Piṇḍa and Nisarga methods. / Among the ascendant, the Sun, and the Moon, whichever is strongest, its daśā comes first.

1.55.s:
tataḥ kendrādigānāṃ tu dvitryādau sabalasya ca /
bahvāyuryo vīryasāmyerkādyutasya prāk yācakaḥ //
1.55.d:
ततः केन्द्रादिगानां तु द्वित्र्यादौ सबलस्य च ।
बह्वायुर्यो वीर्यसाम्येर्काद्युतस्य प्राक् याचकः ॥
1.55.m: Then, among those situated in the kendras and following houses, the first period belongs to the strong planet in the second, third, and subsequent houses; / when strength is equal, the one that grants the longest life [rules first], or the one conjoined with the Sun as stated before.

1.55.s:
ṣaḍvargārddhasya triṃśasya trikoṇagaśca smaragaḥ /
saptamāsasya tūryasya caturasragatasya ca //
1.55.d:
षड्वर्गार्द्धस्य त्रिंशस्य त्रिकोणगश्च स्मरगः ।
सप्तमासस्य तूर्यस्य चतुरस्रगतस्य च ॥
1.55.m: For a planet in the half of the ṣaḍvarga, in the triṃśāṃśa, in a trine, or in the seventh house, / as well as in the seventh sign, in the fourth, or occupying a caturasra [fourth/eighth house],

1.55.s:
kramaḥ kendrādiko 'trāpi dvitryādau sabalasya ca /
pākapasyābdhināgāśca hyarṇavā sahagasya ca //
1.55.d:
क्रमः केन्द्रादिको ऽत्रापि द्वित्र्यादौ सबलस्य च ।
पाकपस्याब्धिनागाश्च ह्यर्णवा सहगस्य च ॥
1.55.m: the order here too begins with the kendras and so forth, among the strong planets in the second, third, and other houses. / For the ruler of the period, the multiplier is eighty-four, and four for one that accompanies it,

1.55.s:
trikoṇasthasya cāṣṭākṣisūryā dyūnagatasya ca /
turyāṣṭagasya tu svargā guṇakāḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
1.55.d:
त्रिकोणस्थस्य चाष्टाक्षिसूर्या द्यूनगतस्य च ।
तुर्याष्टगस्य तु स्वर्गा गुणकाः परिकीर्तिताः ॥
1.55.m: twenty-eight for one in a trine, twelve for one in the seventh house, / and twenty-one is declared as the multiplier for one in the fourth or eighth house.

1.55.s:
daśāguṇairhatā bhaktyā guṇaikyena samāgatāḥ /
śeṣer'kādihate bhakte māsādyaikyena nārada //
1.55.d:
दशागुणैर्हता भक्त्या गुणैक्येन समागताः ।
शेषेर्ऽकादिहते भक्ते मासाद्यैक्येन नारद ॥
1.55.m: The planetary periods multiplied by their multipliers, divided by the sum of the multipliers, yield the years. / When the remainder is multiplied by twelve and divided, months and so forth are obtained in total, O Nārada.

1.55.s:
antardaśāsu vidaśāstāsu copadaśāstathā /
daśeśamitrasvoccakṣaṅgobjobdhyekādrivṛddhigaḥ //
1.55.d:
अन्तर्दशासु विदशास्तासु चोपदशास्तथा ।
दशेशमित्रस्वोच्चक्षङ्गोब्जोब्ध्येकाद्रिवृद्धिगः ॥
1.55.m: Within the antardaśās there are vidaśās, and within them likewise upadaśās. / If a planet is in the house of a friend of the period-lord, in its own exaltation, in the ascendant, or in the eleventh, fourth, or seventh house, it brings growth.

1.55.s:
śubhago yadbhagastadbhisnvādisthena taddhikṛt /
proktetarasthānagatastattadbhāvakṣayaṃ karaḥ //
1.55.d:
शुभगो यद्भगस्तद्भिस्न्वादिस्थेन तद्धिकृत् ।
प्रोक्तेतरस्थानगतस्तत्तद्भावक्षयं करः ॥
1.55.m: Positioned in an auspicious sign, whatever sign it occupies, situated in the second or other houses, it enhances that bhāva; / situated in other houses than those stated, it causes the destruction of that respective bhāva.

1.55.s:
khagasya yadbhaveddravyaṃ bhāvabhe kṣaṇayogajam /
jīvikādiphalaṃ sarvaṃ daśāyāṃ tasya yojayet //
1.55.d:
खगस्य यद्भवेद्द्रव्यं भावभे क्षणयोगजम् ।
जीविकादिफलं सर्वं दशायां तस्य योजयेत् ॥
1.55.m: Whatever wealth, aspect, or conjunction arises from the bhāva and sign of a planet, / all the fruits such as livelihood should be assigned to its daśā.

1.55.s:
viśanyāpadaśāyāṃ yo vairidṛṣṭo vipattikṛt /
śubhamatrekṣitaśceṣṭasadvargasthaśca yo grahaḥ //
1.55.d:
विशन्यापदशायां यो वैरिदृष्टो विपत्तिकृत् ।
शुभमत्रेक्षितश्चेष्टसद्वर्गस्थश्च यो ग्रहः ॥
1.55.m: In an adverse sub-period, a planet aspected by an enemy causes disaster; / but a planet that is aspected by a benefic, or desirable and situated in a benefic varga,

1.55.s:
tatkāle balavānāpannāśakṛtsamudāhṛtaḥ /
yasyāṣṭavargajaṃ cāpi phalaṃ pūrṇaśubhaṃ bhavet //
1.55.d:
तत्काले बलवानापन्नाशकृत्समुदाहृतः ।
यस्याष्टवर्गजं चापि फलं पूर्णशुभं भवेत् ॥
1.55.m: and strong at that time, is declared to be a destroyer of misfortunes. / Also, that planet whose aṣṭakavarga yields completely auspicious fruit,

1.55.s:
yaśca mūrtitanuglāvo vṛddhigaḥ svoccabhasthitaḥ /
svatrikoṇasuhṛdbhasthastasya madhyamasatphalam //
1.55.d:
यश्च मूर्तितनुग्लावो वृद्धिगः स्वोच्चभस्थितः ।
स्वत्रिकोणसुहृद्भस्थस्तस्य मध्यमसत्फलम् ॥
1.55.m: and which has bright bodily radiance, is waxing, placed in its exaltation sign, / in its trine, or in a friend's sign, yields moderate or good fruit.

1.55.s:
śreṣṭhaṃ śubhataraṃ vācyaṃ viparītagatasya tu /
neṣṭamutkaṭamiṣṭaṃ tu svalpaṃ jñātvā balaṃ vadet //
1.55.d:
श्रेष्ठं शुभतरं वाच्यं विपरीतगतस्य तु ।
नेष्टमुत्कटमिष्टं तु स्वल्पं ज्ञात्वा बलं वदेत् ॥
1.55.m: Its result should be pronounced as excellent and very auspicious; but for one in the opposite state, / it is unfavorable. Discerning whether favorable strength is intense or slight, one should declare the result.

1.55.s:
care sanmadhyaduṣṭābhyāmaṅgabhaṅge viparyayāt /
sthire neṣṭaṣṭamadhyā ca horāyāstryaṃ śakaiḥ phalam //
1.55.d:
चरे सन्मध्यदुष्टाभ्यामङ्गभङ्गे विपर्ययात् ।
स्थिरे नेष्टष्टमध्या च होरायास्त्र्यं शकैः फलम् ॥
1.55.m: In a movable sign, the fruit is determined by good, medium, and bad parts of the body respectively; in reverse for a dual sign; / in a fixed sign, the fruit of the horā is unfavorable, bad, and middling according to its decanates.

1.55.s:
svāmījyajñayutā horā dṛṣṭā vā satpalāvahā /
vināśa dṛṣṭayuktā ca pāpāntaragatānyathā //
1.55.d:
स्वामीज्यज्ञयुता होरा दृष्टा वा सत्पलावहा ।
विनाश दृष्टयुक्ता च पापान्तरगतान्यथा ॥
1.55.m: The horā conjoined with or aspected by its lord, Jupiter, or Mercury brings good results; / otherwise, conjoined with or aspected by a malefic, or hemmed between malefics, it brings destruction.

1.55.s:
prāgdhvāṅkṣā bandhu mṛtyāya tayordyūne raviḥ svabhāt /
vakrātsvādivasāñcārke śukrādyūnāṃ tu ṣaḍrataḥ //
1.55.d:
प्राग्ध्वाङ्क्षा बन्धु मृत्याय तयोर्द्यूने रविः स्वभात् ।
वक्रात्स्वादिवसाञ्चार्के शुक्राद्यूनां तु षड्रतः ॥
1.55.m: The Sun from its own sign in the seventh brings death to relatives; / [similarly] from Mars, Mercury, and Venus in the designated places, auspicious points are reckoned.

1.55.s:
dharmadhyāyārigo jīvādikatryārigo vidhoḥ /
pṛdhyantyadhītapāḥ sujñā tatovṛddhyantyabandhurāḥ //
1.55.d:
धर्मध्यायारिगो जीवादिकत्र्यारिगो विधोः ।
पृध्यन्त्यधीतपाः सुज्ञा ततोवृद्ध्यन्त्यबन्धुराः ॥
1.55.m: In the ninth, eleventh, and sixth from Jupiter; in the third, eleventh, and sixth from the Moon; / the wise consider these places auspicious for learning and austerity, bringing prosperity to those who are fortunate.

1.55.s:
vṛddhigoṅgātsadhanaghītapaḥ svārācchaśī śubhaḥ /
svadūvṛdhyastādiṣu pṛdhātsasāṣṭau pañcayopagaḥ //
1.55.d:
वृद्धिगोङ्गात्सधनघीतपः स्वाराच्छशी शुभः ।
स्वदूवृध्यस्तादिषु पृधात्ससाष्टौ पञ्चयोपगः ॥
1.55.m: The Moon is auspicious in the eleventh from the ascendant, along with the second, ninth, and fifth; from Mars, / in its own houses, the eleventh, seventh, and fifth, it confers prosperity.

1.55.s:
ṣaṭtryāyadhīstho mandāñca jñāddvitryāyāṣṭakendragaḥ /
kendrāṣṭāyāntya ijyādvā jñajyāyāstatra sve kaveḥ //
1.55.d:
षट्त्र्यायधीस्थो मन्दाञ्च ज्ञाद्द्वित्र्यायाष्टकेन्द्रगः ।
केन्द्राष्टायान्त्य इज्याद्वा ज्ञज्यायास्तत्र स्वे कवेः ॥
1.55.m: In the sixth, third, eleventh, and fifth from Saturn; in the second, third, eleventh, eighth, and kendras from Mercury; / in the kendras, eighth, eleventh, and twelfth from Jupiter, and similarly in the own houses of Venus,

1.55.s:
vṛddhāvinātsādidhiyā maṅgā māyārigo vidhoḥ /
kendrāṣṭāpārthagaḥ svarkṣānmandādgoṣṭāyakendragaḥ //
1.55.d:
वृद्धाविनात्सादिधिया मङ्गा मायारिगो विधोः ।
केन्द्राष्टापार्थगः स्वर्क्षान्मन्दाद्गोष्टायकेन्द्रगः ॥
1.55.m: in the eleventh and fifth from the Sun; in the ascendant, eleventh, and sixth from the Moon; / in the kendras, eighth, and twelfth from its own sign; and in the ninth, eighth, eleventh, and kendras from Saturn,

1.55.s:
ṣaṭ tridhī bhavataḥ saumyātṣaḍvāṃśāṣṭago bhṛgoḥ /
karmāyavyayaṣaṣṭastho jīvādbhaumaḥ śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ //
1.55.d:
षट् त्रिधी भवतः सौम्यात्षड्वांशाष्टगो भृगोः ।
कर्मायव्ययषष्टस्थो जीवाद्भौमः शुभः स्मृतः ॥
1.55.m: in the sixth, third, and fifth from Mercury; in the sixth and eighth from Venus; / and situated in the tenth, eleventh, twelfth, and sixth from Jupiter, Mars is considered auspicious.

1.55.s:
kaverddhyāṣaṣṭamodhyāye sanjñomandānsadhītraye /
sākṣāste bhūmijājjīvādyayāribhavamṛtyugaḥ //
1.55.d:
कवेर्द्ध्याषष्टमोध्याये सन्ज्ञोमन्दान्सधीत्रये ।
साक्षास्ते भूमिजाज्जीवाद्ययारिभवमृत्युगः ॥
1.55.m: In the fifth and eighth from Venus; in the sixth, eleventh, fifth, and third from Saturn; / in the fifth and seventh from Mars; in the twelfth, sixth, eleventh, and eighth from Jupiter;

1.55.s:
dharmāyārisatāntyerkātsādyatrisvagatā svabhāt /
ṣaṭkhāyāṣṭābdhikhoṣvijyātsahādyeṣu vilagnataḥ //
1.55.d:
धर्मायारिसतान्त्येर्कात्साद्यत्रिस्वगता स्वभात् ।
षट्खायाष्टाब्धिखोष्विज्यात्सहाद्येषु विलग्नतः ॥
1.55.m: in the ninth, eleventh, sixth, fifth, and twelfth from the Sun; in the second, third, and fifth from its own sign; / in the sixth, tenth, eleventh, eighth, fourth, and twelfth from Jupiter; and in the third and ascendant from the lagna,

1.55.s:
dikvāṣṭādyastabandhyāye kujātkhātsatrike guruḥ /
sātryaṅke san raveḥ śukrāddhīkhago digbhavārigaḥ //
1.55.d:
दिक्वाष्टाद्यस्तबन्ध्याये कुजात्खात्सत्रिके गुरुः ।
सात्र्यङ्के सन् रवेः शुक्राद्धीखगो दिग्भवारिगः ॥
1.55.m: in the tenth, eighth, first, seventh, and fourth from Mars; and in the tenth, third, ninth, and first from the Sun, Jupiter is auspicious; from Venus in the fifth, tenth, eleventh, and sixth;

1.55.s:
candrādvīśārthagosteṣu mandāddhītriṣaḍantyagaḥ /
gobdhidhīṣaṭkhakhādyā ye jñātsadyūne vilagnataḥ //
1.55.d:
चन्द्राद्वीशार्थगोस्तेषु मन्दाद्धीत्रिषडन्त्यगः ।
गोब्धिधीषट्खखाद्या ये ज्ञात्सद्यूने विलग्नतः ॥
1.55.m: in the second, eleventh, and second from the Moon; in the fifth, third, sixth, and twelfth from Saturn; / in the ninth, fourth, fifth, sixth, tenth, and ascendant from Mercury; and in the seventh from the ascendant,

1.55.s:
āśu teśāṣṭagoṣvaṅgaḥtsāṃteṣvabjātsitaḥ śubhaḥ /
svātsajñeṣu tridhīgobdhī dikchidrāsigatorkajāt //
1.55.d:
आशु तेशाष्टगोष्वङ्गःत्सांतेष्वब्जात्सितः शुभः ।
स्वात्सज्ञेषु त्रिधीगोब्धी दिक्छिद्रासिगतोर्कजात् ॥
1.55.m: Venus is auspicious in these places; in the eighth from itself, and in the designated houses from the Moon; / in the second, fifth, third, ninth, fourth, tenth, and eighth from Saturn;

1.55.s:
randhrāyavyacagaḥ sūryādoṣṭadhīkhe sagorguro /
jñābdhitryāyārigorātriṣaṭdhyadhyāntyagoṣu ca //
1.55.d:
रन्ध्रायव्यचगः सूर्यादोष्टधीखे सगोर्गुरो ।
ज्ञाब्धित्र्यायारिगोरात्रिषट्ध्यध्यान्त्यगोषु च ॥
1.55.m: in the eighth, eleventh, and twelfth from the Sun; in the eighth, fifth, and tenth from Jupiter; / in the fourth, third, eleventh, and sixth from Mercury; and in the sixth, fifth, and twelfth from the Moon,

1.55.s:
tridhīśāriṣu mandaḥ khātsākṣāntyeṣu śubho sṛjaḥ /
kendrāyāṣṭadhaneṣvarkā lagnādvṛddhyādyabandhuṣu //
1.55.d:
त्रिधीशारिषु मन्दः खात्साक्षान्त्येषु शुभो सृजः ।
केन्द्रायाष्टधनेष्वर्का लग्नाद्वृद्ध्याद्यबन्धुषु ॥
1.55.m: Saturn is auspicious in the third, fifth, eleventh, and sixth; from Mars in the tenth, fifth, and twelfth; / from the Sun in the kendras, eleventh, eighth, and second; and from the ascendant in the eleventh, first, and fourth;

1.55.s:
godhvaṣṭāpārikhāntyejñāccandrāllābhatriṣadbhataḥ /
ṣaḍaṣṭāntyagataḥ śukrādgurīrdvīśāntyaśatruṣu //
1.55.d:
गोध्वष्टापारिखान्त्येज्ञाच्चन्द्राल्लाभत्रिषद्भतः ।
षडष्टान्त्यगतः शुक्राद्गुरीर्द्वीशान्त्यशत्रुषु ॥
1.55.m: in the ninth, eighth, twelfth, sixth, tenth, and twelfth from Mercury; in the eleventh, third, and sixth from the Moon; / in the sixth, eighth, and twelfth from Venus; and in the second, eleventh, twelfth, and sixth from Jupiter.

1.55.s:
uktasthāneṣu rekhādo hyanukteṣu tu bindudāḥ /
janmabhādvadvimitroccasvabhedhiṣṭaṃ pareṣvasat //
1.55.d:
उक्तस्थानेषु रेखादो ह्यनुक्तेषु तु बिन्दुदाः ।
जन्मभाद्वद्विमित्रोच्चस्वभेधिष्टं परेष्वसत् ॥
1.55.m: In the mentioned places they give lines (rekhā), while in the unmentioned places they give dots (bindu). / In friendly, exalted, and own signs from the natal sign, results are desirable; in others, they are adverse.

1.55.s:
kaṣṭamarthakṣayaḥ kleśaḥ samatārthasukhāgamaḥ /
dhanāptiḥ sukhamiṣṭāptiriti rekhāphalaṃ kramāt //
1.55.d:
कष्टमर्थक्षयः क्लेशः समतार्थसुखागमः ।
धनाप्तिः सुखमिष्टाप्तिरिति रेखाफलं क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: Misfortune, loss of wealth, anguish, mediocrity, gain of wealth and happiness, / acquisition of money, comfort, and fulfillment of desires—such is the fruit of the lines in order.

1.55.s:
pitṛmātṛdviṣanmitrabhrātṛstrībhṛtakādraveḥ /
svāmilagrājayoḥ svasthādbhedarkasvayaśośayāt //
1.55.d:
पितृमातृद्विषन्मित्रभ्रातृस्त्रीभृतकाद्रवेः ।
स्वामिलग्राजयोः स्वस्थाद्भेदर्कस्वयशोशयात् ॥
1.55.m: From the Sun and other planets respectively, livelihood is discerned concerning father, mother, enemy, friend, brother, wife, and servant, / or from the lord of the tenth house, according to their place and the glory of the Sun.

1.55.s:
tṛṇasvarṇāśvadhoraṇādyairarkāṃśe vṛttimādiśet /
kṛṣyaṃbujasrībhyobjāṃśe kauje dhātvasrasāhasaiḥ //
1.55.d:
तृणस्वर्णाश्वधोरणाद्यैरर्कांशे वृत्तिमादिशेत् ।
कृष्यंबुजस्रीभ्योब्जांशे कौजे धात्वस्रसाहसैः ॥
1.55.m: In the Sun's navāṃśa, one should predict a livelihood by grass, gold, horses, and carriages; / in the Moon's navāṃśa, through agriculture, aquatic products, and women; in Mars's navāṃśa, through minerals, weapons, and daring deeds;

1.55.s:
kāvyaśilpādibhirbodhe jave devadvijākaraiḥ /
śaukre rajatagoratnairmānde hiṃsaśramādhamaiḥ //
1.55.d:
काव्यशिल्पादिभिर्बोधे जवे देवद्विजाकरैः ।
शौक्रे रजतगोरत्नैर्मान्दे हिंसश्रमाधमैः ॥
1.55.m: in Mercury's navāṃśa, through poetry, arts, and crafts; in Jupiter's navāṃśa, through gods, brāhmaṇas, and mines; / in Venus's navāṃśa, through silver, cows, and gems; in Saturn's navāṃśa, through violence, heavy labor, and base trades.

1.55.s:
svoñceṣvārkī tathā jyārairuktaikāṅge nṛ pādhipāḥ /
lagre vargottame 'bje vā caturādigrahekṣite //
1.55.d:
स्वोञ्चेष्वार्की तथा ज्यारैरुक्तैकाङ्गे नृ पाधिपाः ।
लग्रे वर्गोत्तमे ऽब्जे वा चतुरादिग्रहेक्षिते ॥
1.55.m: When Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars are in their respective exaltations in the mentioned single limb, they become lords of kings. / If the ascendant or the Moon is in vargottama and aspected by four or more planets,

1.55.s:
dvāviṃśabhūpāstuṅgesṛkcāperkendūyamastanau /
bhūpakṛttuṅgagorkegestesājārkekhabhe gurau //
1.55.d:
द्वाविंशभूपास्तुङ्गेसृक्चापेर्केन्दूयमस्तनौ ।
भूपकृत्तुङ्गगोर्केगेस्तेसाजार्केखभे गुरौ ॥
1.55.m: kings numbering twenty-two [are produced]; when Mars is in exaltation, the Sun and Moon in Sagittarius, and Saturn in the ascendant, / it makes a king; or when the Sun is in exaltation and Jupiter is in the tenth house,

1.55.s:
yamendutuṅgagau lagne ṣaṣṭer'kajñau tulājagau /
sitāsṛjo gurau karke sārāje lagnage nṛpāḥ //
1.55.d:
यमेन्दुतुङ्गगौ लग्ने षष्टेर्ऽकज्ञौ तुलाजगौ ।
सितासृजो गुरौ कर्के साराजे लग्नगे नृपाः ॥
1.55.m: when Saturn and the Moon are in exaltation in the ascendant, the Sun and Mercury in the sixth house in Libra and Aries, / or Venus and Mars with Jupiter in Cancer, and Mars in Aries in the ascendant, kings are born.

1.55.s:
vṛṣegebjerkejyasauraiḥ suhṛjjāyākhagairnṛpaḥ /
mande mṛgāṅgetryaryakāṃśasthairajādibhirnṛpa //
1.55.d:
वृषेगेब्जेर्केज्यसौरैः सुहृज्जायाखगैर्नृपः ।
मन्दे मृगाङ्गेत्र्यर्यकांशस्थैरजादिभिर्नृप ॥
1.55.m: When the Moon is in Taurus, and the Sun, Jupiter, and Saturn are in friendly signs, in the seventh, or in the tenth, a king is born. / When Saturn is in Capricorn, and planets from Aries onward are in their navāṃśas, a king is born.

1.55.s:
sejyājeśve mṛgamukhe kuje tuṅgerkṣabhāgevau /
lagne 'tha sejyakarkeṅge jñājaśukrairbhavopagaiḥ //
1.55.d:
सेज्याजेश्वे मृगमुखे कुजे तुङ्गेर्क्षभागेवौ ।
लग्ने ऽथ सेज्यकर्केङ्गे ज्ञाजशुक्रैर्भवोपगैः ॥
1.55.m: With Jupiter in Aries and Mars in Capricorn, if the Sun is in its exalted navāṃśa in the ascendant; / or with Jupiter in Cancer in the ascendant, and Mercury, the Sun, and Venus occupying the eleventh house,

1.55.s:
meṣe 'rke bhūmipāseṃdau eṣe ṣāṅgrerkapapāsṛjaḥ /
siṃhakuṃbhamṛgasthāścedbhūpaḥ sāretanāvaje //
1.55.d:
मेषे ऽर्के भूमिपासेंदौ एषे षाङ्ग्रेर्कपपासृजः ।
सिंहकुंभमृगस्थाश्चेद्भूपः सारेतनावजे ॥
1.55.m: with the Sun in Aries, kings are born; or when the Moon is in Taurus, and the Sun, Saturn, and Mars / are placed in Leo, Aquarius, and Capricorn, and Mars is in the ascendant in Aries, a king is born.

1.55.s:
ārkejīve tanau vāpi nṛpo 'thoḥ kujabhāskarau /
dhīsthau gurvidukavayo bhūmau ratryage budhairnṛpaḥ //
1.55.d:
आर्केजीवे तनौ वापि नृपो ऽथोः कुजभास्करौ ।
धीस्थौ गुर्विदुकवयो भूमौ रत्र्यगे बुधैर्नृपः ॥
1.55.m: Or when the Sun and Jupiter are in the ascendant, a king is born; likewise when Mars and the Sun / are in the fifth house, and Jupiter, the Moon, and Venus are on the earth [fourth house], or with Mercury in the ninth, a king is born.

1.55.s:
mṛgāsyalagnagaiḥ saurejābjarkṣaharayaḥ sayāḥ /
kavikṣau tulayuramasthau vai bhūpaḥ kīrtimānbhavent //
1.55.d:
मृगास्यलग्नगैः सौरेजाब्जर्क्षहरयः सयाः ।
कविक्षौ तुलयुरमस्थौ वै भूपः कीर्तिमान्भवेन्त् ॥
1.55.m: When Saturn and Jupiter are in the ascendant in Capricorn, and the Moon, the Sun, and Mars / are in Libra and other signs, a king surely becomes illustrious.

1.55.s:
yasya kasyāpi tanayaḥ proktairyogairnṛpo bhavet /
vakṣyamāṇairnṛpasuto jñeyo bhūyo munīśvara //
1.55.d:
यस्य कस्यापि तनयः प्रोक्तैर्योगैर्नृपो भवेत् ।
वक्ष्यमाणैर्नृपसुतो ज्ञेयो भूयो मुनीश्वर ॥
1.55.m: The son of anyone at all becomes a king through the combinations described above. / Through those to be spoken hereafter, the son of a king is to be known as becoming one even more, O best of sages.

1.55.s:
svocce trikoṇabhagatestryādyairbalayutairnṛpaḥ /
siṃher'ke meṣalagne 'je mṛge bhaume ghaṭe 'ṣṭame //
1.55.d:
स्वोच्चे त्रिकोणभगतेस्त्र्याद्यैर्बलयुतैर्नृपः ।
सिंहेर्ऽके मेषलग्ने ऽजे मृगे भौमे घटे ऽष्टमे ॥
1.55.m: When three or more planets endowed with strength are in their exaltation or trine signs, a king is born; / or when the Sun is in Leo, the ascendant is Aries, Mars is in Capricorn, and Saturn is in Aquarius in the eighth house.

1.55.s:
cāpe dharānāthaḥsyādatha svarkṣage bhṛgau /
pātālage dharmage 'bje śubhadṛṣṭe yute mune //
1.55.d:
चापे धरानाथःस्यादथ स्वर्क्षगे भृगौ ।
पातालगे धर्मगे ऽब्जे शुभदृष्टे युते मुने ॥
1.55.m: In Sagittarius, he becomes a lord of the earth. Moreover, when Venus is in its own sign, / the Moon in the fourth or ninth house, aspected by or conjoined with a benefic, O sage,

1.55.s:
trilagnabhavagaiḥśeṣairdharādhīśaḥ prajāyate /
saumye vīryayuteṃ'gasthe balāḍhyeśubhage śubhe //
1.55.d:
त्रिलग्नभवगैःशेषैर्धराधीशः प्रजायते ।
सौम्ये वीर्ययुतेंऽगस्थे बलाढ्येशुभगे शुभे ॥
1.55.m: and the remaining [planets] are in the third, first, and eleventh houses, a sovereign of the earth is born. / When Mercury, endowed with strength, is in the ascendant, and a benefic is in a benefic [house] endowed with strength,

1.55.s:
dharmārthopacayasthaiścaśeṣairdharmayutonṛpaḥ /
meṣūraṇāyatanugāḥ śaśisūryajasūrayaḥ //
1.55.d:
धर्मार्थोपचयस्थैश्चशेषैर्धर्मयुतोनृपः ।
मेषूरणायतनुगाः शशिसूर्यजसूरयः ॥
1.55.m: and the remaining [planets] are situated in the ninth, second, and upacaya houses, a virtuous king [is born]. / When the Moon, the son of the Sun (Saturn), and Jupiter are in the tenth, eleventh, and ascendant [respectively],

1.55.s:
jñārau dhaneśitaravā hibuke bhūpatistadā /
vṛṣeṃ'ge 'bjodhanāristho jīvārkī lāṃbhagāḥ pare //
1.55.d:
ज्ञारौ धनेशितरवा हिबुके भूपतिस्तदा ।
वृषेंऽगे ऽब्जोधनारिस्थो जीवार्की लांभगाः परे ॥
1.55.m: Mercury and Mars in the second, and the Sun in the fourth, then [one becomes] a ruler of the earth. / When the Moon is in the ascendant Taurus, Jupiter and Saturn in the second and sixth, and the others in the eleventh;

1.55.s:
sukhe guruḥ kheravīndūyamo lagne bhave karai /
lagne vakrāsitau candrejyasitārkabudhāḥ kramāt //
1.55.d:
सुखे गुरुः खेरवीन्दूयमो लग्ने भवे करै ।
लग्ने वक्रासितौ चन्द्रेज्यसितार्कबुधाः क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: [or] Jupiter in the fourth, the Sun and Moon in the tenth, and Saturn in the ascendant, [a king] is born with hands [bearing royal marks]. / When Mars and Saturn are in the ascendant, and the Moon, Jupiter, Venus, the Sun, and Mercury are respectively

1.55.s:
sukhāstu śubhakhāptisthānareśaṃ janayantyapi /
karmalagnagaraveṭasya daśāyāṃ rājyasaṃgatiḥ //
1.55.d:
सुखास्तु शुभखाप्तिस्थानरेशं जनयन्त्यपि ।
कर्मलग्नगरवेटस्य दशायां राज्यसंगतिः ॥
1.55.m: in the fourth [house], benefic, tenth, and eleventh houses, they indeed generate a king. / In the planetary period of the planet occupying the tenth house or the ascendant, attainment of kingship occurs;

1.55.s:
prabalasya daśāyāṃ vā śatrunīcā digārtidāḥ /
āsannakendradvayagairvargadākhyaḥ sakalagrahaiḥ //
1.55.d:
प्रबलस्य दशायां वा शत्रुनीचा दिगार्तिदाः ।
आसन्नकेन्द्रद्वयगैर्वर्गदाख्यः सकलग्रहैः ॥
1.55.m: or in the planetary period of a strong [planet]; [planets] in enemy or depression signs, etc., cause distress. / When all planets are situated in two adjacent angles, it is called the Vargada [yoga];

1.55.s:
tanvastagaiśca sakaṭaṃ vihago rājyabandhugaiḥ /
śṛṅgāṭakaṃ dhigaugasthairlagnāyasthairhalaṃ matam //
1.55.d:
तन्वस्तगैश्च सकटं विहगो राज्यबन्धुगैः ।
शृङ्गाटकं धिगौगस्थैर्लग्नायस्थैर्हलं मतम् ॥
1.55.m: and when occupying the ascendant and descendant, it is Sakaṭa; Vihaga when [planets] occupy the tenth and fourth houses; / Śṛṅgāṭaka when they occupy the ninth, ascendant, and fifth; Hala is considered [to occur] when occupying the ascendant and eleventh houses;

1.55.s:
varjjoṅgesthe satsvasatsu turyakhasthairyavonyathā /
vimiśraiḥ kamalaṃ prāhurvāyākaṇṭakabāhyagaiḥ //
1.55.d:
वर्ज्जोङ्गेस्थे सत्स्वसत्सु तुर्यखस्थैर्यवोन्यथा ।
विमिश्रैः कमलं प्राहुर्वायाकण्टकबाह्यगैः ॥
1.55.m: when benefics occupy the ascendant and malefics occupy the fourth and tenth, it is Vajra, and otherwise Yava; / when mixed, they call it Kamala; when outside the angles, [they call it Vāpī];

1.55.s:
lagnāccaturbhugairyūpaḥśarastūryāccaturbhugaiḥ /
dyūnādvedakṣagaiḥ śaktirṃ da'khādicaturbhagaiḥ //
1.55.d:
लग्नाच्चतुर्भुगैर्यूपःशरस्तूर्याच्चतुर्भुगैः ।
द्यूनाद्वेदक्षगैः शक्तिर्ं दऽखादिचतुर्भगैः ॥
1.55.m: occupying four houses continuously from the ascendant is Yūpa; Śara is from four houses from the fourth; / Śakti is from four houses from the seventh; Daṇḍa is from four houses beginning with the tenth;

1.55.s:
lagnātkramātsaptabhagairnokākūṭastu nuryataḥ /
chatramastātsvabhādyāyonyasmādarddhendunāmakaḥ //
1.55.d:
लग्नात्क्रमात्सप्तभगैर्नोकाकूटस्तु नुर्यतः ।
छत्रमस्तात्स्वभाद्यायोन्यस्मादर्द्धेन्दुनामकः ॥
1.55.m: occupying seven houses continuously from the ascendant is Naukā, but Kūṭa is from the fourth; / Chatra is from the seventh; from any other sign beginning with the second, it is called Ardhendu;

1.55.s:
lagnādekāntaragataiścakramarthātsaritpatiḥ /
ṣahyusthāneṣu vīṇādyāḥ samasaptarkṣagaiḥ //
1.55.d:
लग्नादेकान्तरगतैश्चक्रमर्थात्सरित्पतिः ।
षह्युस्थानेषु वीणाद्याः समसप्तर्क्षगैः ॥
1.55.m: occupying alternate houses from the ascendant is Cakra; [from the second], Samudra; / in the houses of the signs, Vīṇā and the others [are formed] by [planets] occupying seven signs:

1.55.s:
vīṇādāmapāśakedārabhūśūlayugagolakāḥ /
grahaiḥścarabhagai rājayogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
1.55.d:
वीणादामपाशकेदारभूशूलयुगगोलकाः ।
ग्रहैःश्चरभगै राजयोगः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
1.55.m: Vīṇā, Dāma, Pāśa, Kedāra, Śūla, Yuga, and Gola. / By planets situated in movable signs, a rājayoga is proclaimed;

1.55.s:
sthirasthairyamusalaṃ nāma dviśarīṇatairnalaḥ /
bhālā kendrasthitaiḥ saumyaiḥ pāpaiḥsarpa udāhṛtaḥ //
1.55.d:
स्थिरस्थैर्यमुसलं नाम द्विशरीणतैर्नलः ।
भाला केन्द्रस्थितैः सौम्यैः पापैःसर्प उदाहृतः ॥
1.55.m: by those in fixed signs, Musala by name; by those in dual signs, Nala; / when benefics occupy angles, it is Mālā; when malefics [occupy them], Sarpa is declared.

1.55.s:
īryyuradhvarucī rajjvāṃ musale dhanamānayuk /
vyaṅgā sthirā lonalajo monīsragjohijordditaḥ //
1.55.d:
ईर्य्युरध्वरुची रज्ज्वां मुसले धनमानयुक् ।
व्यङ्गा स्थिरा लोनलजो मोनीस्रग्जोहिजोर्द्दितः ॥
1.55.m: One born in Rajju is jealous and fond of travel; in Musala, endowed with wealth and honour; / in Nala, defective in limb, firm, and clever; in Sraj, honoured; in Sarpa, afflicted;

1.55.s:
vīṇodbhavotinipuṇāgītanṛtyarucirbhṛśam /
dātā samṛddho dāmāsthaḥ pāśajo dhanaśīlayuk //
1.55.d:
वीणोद्भवोतिनिपुणागीतनृत्यरुचिर्भृशम् ।
दाता समृद्धो दामास्थः पाशजो धनशीलयुक् ॥
1.55.m: one born under Vīṇā is very skilled, extremely fond of song and dance; / born in Dāma, generous and prosperous; born in Pāśa, endowed with wealth and good conduct;

1.55.s:
kedārotthaḥ kṛṣikaraḥ śūle śūrokṣato dhanaḥ /
yugaṃ pāṣaṇḍayurgole vidhano malinastathā //
1.55.d:
केदारोत्थः कृषिकरः शूले शूरोक्षतो धनः ।
युगं पाषण्डयुर्गोले विधनो मलिनस्तथा ॥
1.55.m: arisen in Kedāra, an agriculturist; in Śūla, a brave warrior, wounded, without wealth; / in Yuga, a heretic; likewise in Gola, destitute and filthy;

1.55.s:
bhūpavandyapadaścakre samudre nṛpabhogayuk /
subhagāṅgorddhacaṃpātsukhīśūraśca cāmaraḥ //
1.55.d:
भूपवन्द्यपदश्चक्रे समुद्रे नृपभोगयुक् ।
सुभगाङ्गोर्द्धचंपात्सुखीशूरश्च चामरः ॥
1.55.m: in Cakra, one whose feet are worshipped by kings; in Samudra, endowed with royal enjoyments; / in Ardhendu, having handsome limbs, happy, valorous, and like a fly-whisk [bearer];

1.55.s:
mitro pakārakṛcchatre kūṭe cānṛtabandharāṭ /
taujaḥ sakīrtiḥ sukhabhāk mānavo bhavati dhruvam //
1.55.d:
मित्रो पकारकृच्छत्रे कूटे चानृतबन्धराट् ।
तौजः सकीर्तिः सुखभाक् मानवो भवति ध्रुवम् ॥
1.55.m: in Chatra, a benefactor of friends; in Kūṭa, a liar and deceitful king; / in it a man certainly becomes vigorous, renowned, and endowed with happiness;

1.55.s:
tyāgī yajvātmavān yūthe hiṃsro guhyādhipaḥ śaraiḥ /
śaktau nīco 'laso niḥsvo daṇḍe priyaviyogabhāk //
1.55.d:
त्यागी यज्वात्मवान् यूथे हिंस्रो गुह्याधिपः शरैः ।
