शक्तौ नीचो ऽलसो निःस्वो दण्डे प्रियवियोगभाक् ॥
1.55.m: in Yūpa, self-controlled, a sacrificer, generous; in Śara, cruel, a lord of secrets; / in Śakti, base, lazy, penniless; in Daṇḍa, experiencing separation from loved ones.

1.55.s:
vyarkaiḥ svāntyobhayagataiḥ kheṭaiḥ syātsunaphaānaphaā /
durudharā caiva vidhau jñeyaḥ kemudrumo 'nyathā //
1.55.d:
व्यर्कैः स्वान्त्योभयगतैः खेटैः स्यात्सुनफआनफआ ।
दुरुधरा चैव विधौ ज्ञेयः केमुद्रुमो ऽन्यथा ॥
1.55.m: By planets other than the Sun occupying the second, twelfth, or both [houses] from the Moon, / Sunaphā, Anaphā, and Durudharā occur; otherwise, it is to be known as Kemadruma.

1.55.s:
svopārjitārthabhugdātā sunaphaāyāṃ dhanī sukhī /
nīrogaḥ śīlavān khyātaḥ suveṣaścānaphaābhavaḥ //
1.55.d:
स्वोपार्जितार्थभुग्दाता सुनफआयां धनी सुखी ।
नीरोगः शीलवान् ख्यातः सुवेषश्चानफआभवः ॥
1.55.m: One born in Sunaphā enjoys self-earned wealth, is generous, wealthy, and happy; / born in Anaphā, he is free from disease, virtuous, famous, and well-dressed;

1.55.s:
bhogī sukhī dhanīdānītyāgī durudhurodbhavaḥ /
kemudrume 'timalino duḥkhī nīco 'tha nirdhanaḥ //
1.55.d:
भोगी सुखी धनीदानीत्यागी दुरुधुरोद्भवः ।
केमुद्रुमे ऽतिमलिनो दुःखी नीचो ऽथ निर्धनः ॥
1.55.m: one born in Durudharā is an enjoyer, happy, wealthy, charitable, and generous; / in Kemadruma, exceedingly dirty, miserable, base, and destitute.

1.55.s:
yantryāśmakāraṃśājoko bhaumapuṣkarurte dhvagaḥ sujñaḥ /
sukīrtirnipuṇaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ dhaninaṃ tathā //
1.55.d:
यन्त्र्याश्मकारंशाजोको भौमपुष्करुर्ते ध्वगः सुज्ञः ।
सुकीर्तिर्निपुणं विद्वांसं धनिनं तथा ॥
1.55.m: [The Moon combined with Mars makes one] a maker of machines and weapons; [with Mercury], a traveller, wise, / renowned, skilled, learned, and also wealthy;

1.55.s:
senyonyakāryanirataṃ sāsphujicchasrajīvinam /
samando dhātukuśalaṃ tathā bhāḍaṃvidaṃ mune //
1.55.d:
सेन्योन्यकार्यनिरतं सास्फुजिच्छस्रजीविनम् ।
समन्दो धातुकुशलं तथा भाडंविदं मुने ॥
1.55.m: with Jupiter, devoted to others' affairs; with Venus, living by weapons; / with Saturn, skilled in metallurgy and an expert in vessels, O sage;

1.55.s:
kūṭasnyāśavapaṇyāṭhaṃ nasāsṛgindgaḥ prasūdviṣam /
kuryātsajñorthanipuṇaṃ namraṃ satkīrtisaṃyutam //
1.55.d:
कूटस्न्याशवपण्याठं नसासृगिन्द्गः प्रसूद्विषम् ।
कुर्यात्सज्ञोर्थनिपुणं नम्रं सत्कीर्तिसंयुतम् ॥
1.55.m: [Mars combined with the Moon makes one dealing in] forged goods and deceitful merchandise, or an enemy of one's mother; / with Mercury, it makes one skilled in wealth, humble, and endowed with good fame;

1.55.s:
sajyo 'sthiravayaṃ vaṃśyaṃ vikrāntaṃ ca samarthinam /
sasitosukavettāraṃ sārkiponabhavaṃ mune //
1.55.d:
सज्यो ऽस्थिरवयं वंश्यं विक्रान्तं च समर्थिनम् ।
ससितोसुकवेत्तारं सार्किपोनभवं मुने ॥
1.55.m: with Jupiter, of unsteady age, of noble lineage, valorous, and desirous of wealth; / with Venus, knowing poetry; with Saturn, barren, O sage;

1.55.s:
āre sajñe vāhuyodhī purādhyakṣaḥ sagīṣpatau /
saśukre dyūtakrarheyo nṛtī dyūti samandake //
1.55.d:
आरे सज्ञे वाहुयोधी पुराध्यक्षः सगीष्पतौ ।
सशुक्रे द्यूतक्रर्हेयो नृती द्यूति समन्दके ॥
1.55.m: when Mars is with Mercury, a wrestler; with Jupiter, head of a city; / with Venus, an adroit gambler; with Saturn, a dancer and gambler;

1.55.s:
sejyejñe nṛtyagītāḍhyo māyādakṣaḥ /
sabhārgavesamande lubdhakaḥ krūro naro bhavati nārada //
1.55.d:
सेज्येज्ञे नृत्यगीताढ्यो मायादक्षः ।
सभार्गवेसमन्दे लुब्धकः क्रूरो नरो भवति नारद ॥
1.55.m: when Mercury is with Jupiter, rich in dance and song, skilled in illusions; / with Venus and Saturn, a man becomes a hunter and cruel, O Nārada;

1.55.s:
saśukre vākpatau vidvānsāsite 'nnaghaṭaṅkaraḥ /
kavau sa mandamandākṣā va vaniśrayavittavān //
1.55.d:
सशुक्रे वाक्पतौ विद्वान्सासिते ऽन्नघटङ्करः ।
कवौ स मन्दमन्दाक्षा व वनिश्रयवित्तवान् ॥
1.55.m: when Jupiter is with Venus, learned; with Saturn, a cook of food; / when Venus is with Saturn, one is shy and possesses wealth gained through women.

1.55.s:
ekasthaiścaturādyaistu khavārthaiḥ khacaraiḥ pṛthak /
kujajñejyājaśukrārkisūryaḥ parivrajennaraḥ //
1.55.d:
एकस्थैश्चतुराद्यैस्तु खवार्थैः खचरैः पृथक् ।
कुजज्ञेज्याजशुक्रार्किसूर्यः परिव्रजेन्नरः ॥
1.55.m: By four or more planets situated in a single house, / a person takes renunciation under Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, or the Sun respectively,

1.55.s:
śākyājīvakavṛddhārthica rakākhaphalāśanaḥ /
tatsvāmibhiḥ paridajitaiḥ pravrajyāpracyutirbhavet //
1.55.d:
शाक्याजीवकवृद्धार्थिच रकाखफलाशनः ।
तत्स्वामिभिः परिदजितैः प्रव्रज्याप्रच्युतिर्भवेत् ॥
1.55.m: as a Buddhist, Ājīvika, elder, wandering mendicant, or eater of fruits. / If their lords are defeated [in planetary war], a fall from renunciation occurs.

1.55.s:
adīkṣitālpastagataiḥ sabalaistatsthabhaktayaḥ /
janmaponyairyadyadṛṣṭo mandaṃ paśyati nārada //
1.55.d:
अदीक्षिताल्पस्तगतैः सबलैस्तत्स्थभक्तयः ।
जन्मपोन्यैर्यद्यदृष्टो मन्दं पश्यति नारद ॥
1.55.m: If uninitiated or weak planets occupy it, one has devotion to those deities. / If the lord of the birth sign, not aspected by others, aspects Saturn, O Nārada,

1.55.s:
mando vā janmapaṃ naṣṭaṃ tathā ca mandakāgaṇe /
bhaumārkāṃśe sauradṛṣṭe candre vā dīkṣito bhavet //
1.55.d:
मन्दो वा जन्मपं नष्टं तथा च मन्दकागणे ।
भौमार्कांशे सौरदृष्टे चन्द्रे वा दीक्षितो भवेत् ॥
1.55.m: or if Saturn aspects the birth lord when devoid of strength, and likewise in the division of Saturn, / or if the Moon is in the navāṃśa of Mars or the Sun and aspected by Saturn, one becomes an ascetic.

1.55.s:
surūpo bhūṣitago 'śinyāṃ dakṣaḥ satyavacā yame /
bahūbhugpadāragnau sthiradhīḥ priyavāktathā //
1.55.d:
सुरूपो भूषितगो ऽशिन्यां दक्षः सत्यवचा यमे ।
बहूभुग्पदारग्नौ स्थिरधीः प्रियवाक्तथा ॥
1.55.m: In Aśvinī, handsome, fond of ornaments; in Yama (Bharaṇī), clever and truthful; / in Agni (Kṛttikā), a heavy eater, steady-minded, and of pleasant speech;

1.55.s:
brāhmo dhanīmṛge bhogī raudre hiṃstraḥ śaṭho 'ghakṛt /
dānto rogī śubho 'dityāṃ puṣyaryajanmā kaviḥ sukhī //
1.55.d:
ब्राह्मो धनीमृगे भोगी रौद्रे हिंस्त्रः शठो ऽघकृत् ।
दान्तो रोगी शुभो ऽदित्यां पुष्यर्यजन्मा कविः सुखी ॥
1.55.m: in the Brāhma [constellation] (Rohiṇī), wealthy; in Mṛgaśiras, an enjoyer; in Raudra (Ārdrā), cruel, deceitful, and sinful; / in Aditi (Punarvasu), self-controlled, sickly, and auspicious; born in Puṣya, a poet and happy;

1.55.s:
dhūrtaḥ śaṭhaḥ kṛtaghno 'hau pāpaḥ sarvāśano bhavet /
patre bhogī dhanī bhakto dātā priyavacā bhage //
1.55.d:
धूर्तः शठः कृतघ्नो ऽहौ पापः सर्वाशनो भवेत् ।
पत्रे भोगी धनी भक्तो दाता प्रियवचा भगे ॥
1.55.m: in the serpent constellation (Āśleṣā), cunning, treacherous, ungrateful, evil, and omnivorous; / in the leaf constellation (Maghā), an enjoyer, wealthy, and devoted; in Bhaga (Pūrvaphālgunī), generous and pleasant-spoken;

1.55.s:
dhanī bhogīnaroryamarkṣe steno dhṛṣṭo ghṛṇī kare /
citrāṃbaraḥ sudṛktvāṣṭre na ca dharmadayāparaḥ //
1.55.d:
धनी भोगीनरोर्यमर्क्षे स्तेनो धृष्टो घृणी करे ।
चित्रांबरः सुदृक्त्वाष्ट्रे न च धर्मदयापरः ॥
1.55.m: in Aryaman's constellation (Uttaraphālgunī), wealthy and enjoying; in Hasta, a thief, insolent, and compassionate; / in Citrā, wearing varied garments, having good eyes, but not devoted to virtue and pity;

1.55.s:
dvīśe lubdhaḥ paṭuḥ krodhī maḍhaiyo āṭhanovideśagaḥ /
śākre dharmaparastuṣṭo mūle mānī dhanī sukhī //
1.55.d:
द्वीशे लुब्धः पटुः क्रोधी मढैयो आठनोविदेशगः ।
शाक्रे धर्मपरस्तुष्टो मूले मानी धनी सुखी ॥
1.55.m: in Dvīśa (Viśākhā), greedy, clever, wrathful, arrogant, and travelling abroad; / in Śakra (Jyeṣṭhā), devoted to virtue and contented; in Mūla, proud, wealthy, and happy;

1.55.s:
āpye mānī dṛṣṭo vaiśve namraśca dhārmikaḥ /
karṇe dhanī sukhī khyāto dātā śūro dhanī vasau //
1.55.d:
आप्ये मानी दृष्टो वैश्वे नम्रश्च धार्मिकः ।
कर्णे धनी सुखी ख्यातो दाता शूरो धनी वसौ ॥
1.55.m: in Āpya (Pūrvāṣāḍhā), proud and bold; in Vaiśva (Uttarāṣāḍhā), humble and righteous; / in Karṇa (Śravaṇa), wealthy, happy, and famous; in Vasu (Śraviṣṭhā/Dhaniṣṭhā), generous, heroic, and wealthy;

1.55.s:
śeta'rihṝntā vyasanī srījito jāhibhedinī /
budhne vaktā sukhī kāntaḥ pauṣṇe śūro dhanī śuciḥ //
1.55.d:
शेतऽरिहॄन्ता व्यसनी स्रीजितो जाहिभेदिनी ।
बुध्ने वक्ता सुखी कान्तः पौष्णे शूरो धनी शुचिः ॥
1.55.m: in Śatabhiṣaj, a conqueror of enemies, fond of vices, dominated by women, and divisive; / in Budhna (Uttarabhadrapadā), an orator, happy, and charming; in Pauṣṇa (Revatī), heroic, wealthy, and pure.

1.55.s:
kāmī śūraḥ kṛtajño 'je kāntastyāgī kṣamī vṛṣe /
yugme srīdyūtaśāsrajñaḥ sraiṇo hrasvaḥ svabhe vidhau //
1.55.d:
कामी शूरः कृतज्ञो ऽजे कान्तस्त्यागी क्षमी वृषे ।
युग्मे स्रीद्यूतशास्रज्ञः स्रैणो ह्रस्वः स्वभे विधौ ॥
1.55.m: In Aries, lustful, heroic, and grateful; in Taurus, charming, generous, and forbearing; / in Gemini, skilled in women, gambling, and weapons; in Cancer (the Moon's sign), fond of women and short of stature;

1.55.s:
srīdviṭ krodhī harau mānī vikrāntaḥ sthiradhīḥ sukhī /
dharmī ślakṣṇaḥ sudhīḥ ṣaṣṭe prājñaḥ prāṃśurdhanī ghaṭe //
1.55.d:
स्रीद्विट् क्रोधी हरौ मानी विक्रान्तः स्थिरधीः सुखी ।
धर्मी श्लक्ष्णः सुधीः षष्टे प्राज्ञः प्रांशुर्धनी घटे ॥
1.55.m: in Leo, hostile to women, wrathful, proud, valorous, firm-minded, and happy; / in the sixth (Virgo), righteous, gentle, and clever; in Libra, wise, tall, and wealthy;

1.55.s:
rogī pūjyaḥ kṣatī kārairpye kaviḥ śilpījyabhe dhanī /
mṛge 'laso 'ṭanaḥ svakṣaḥ paradārārthahṛddhaṭe //
1.55.d:
रोगी पूज्यः क्षती कारैर्प्ये कविः शिल्पीज्यभे धनी ।
मृगे ऽलसो ऽटनः स्वक्षः परदारार्थहृद्धटे ॥
1.55.m: in Scorpio, sickly, venerable, and scarred; in Sagittarius, a poet, craftsman, and wealthy; / in Capricorn, lazy, wandering, with handsome eyes; in Aquarius, stealing others' wives and wealth.

1.55.s:
sabalebhaibhayevāpisa valejeśilaphalam /
anyathā viparītaṃ tatpalaṃmevaṃ pare 'pi na /
khyātaḥ srīdviṭ dhanī tīkṣṇojñaḥ kaviḥ śaiṇḍiko dhanī /
pūjyo lubdho 'dhanasakho meṣādau bhāskare janau //
1.55.d:
सबलेभैभयेवापिस वलेजेशिलफलम् ।
अन्यथा विपरीतं तत्पलंमेवं परे ऽपि न ।
ख्यातः स्रीद्विट् धनी तीक्ष्णोज्ञः कविः शैण्डिको धनी ।
पूज्यो लुब्धो ऽधनसखो मेषादौ भास्करे जनौ ॥
1.55.m: When the signs or their lords are strong, the full fruit is obtained; / otherwise, that fruit is opposite, and so on for others as well. / Renowned, hostile to women, wealthy, fierce, learned, poetic, a distiller, wealthy, / revered, greedy, without wealth, or a companion, when the Sun is in Aries and the other signs at birth.

1.55.s:
niḥsvor'kabhe bhūmiputre bhūmiputre dhanī cāndre svabhedanaḥ /
baudhe kṛtajño jaive tu khyātaḥ śaukre 'nyadārikaḥ //
1.55.d:
निःस्वोर्ऽकभे भूमिपुत्रे भूमिपुत्रे धनी चान्द्रे स्वभेदनः ।
बौधे कृतज्ञो जैवे तु ख्यातः शौक्रे ऽन्यदारिकः ॥
1.55.m: When Mars is in the Sun's sign, one is destitute; in the Moon's, wealthy and destructive of his own kin; / in Mercury's, grateful; in Jupiter's, renowned; in Venus's, an adulterer.

1.55.s:
mṛge bahvātmajadhanaḥ kuṃbhe duḥkhyanṛtī khalaḥ /
srīdveṣyaḥ svajanadveṣīniyaratyaḥ sadhīyanaḥ //
1.55.d:
मृगे बह्वात्मजधनः कुंभे दुःख्यनृती खलः ।
स्रीद्वेष्यः स्वजनद्वेषीनियरत्यः सधीयनः ॥
1.55.m: In Capricorn, he has many children and wealth; in Aquarius, he is miserable, untruthful, wicked, / hated by women, hostile to relatives, intent on misdeeds, and foolish.

1.55.s:
samānārthaḥ saputrasrīsarṇaḥ sūryādibhe budhe /
senānīḥ stryarthaputrāḍhyaḥ dakṣamaiśyaḥ paricchadī //
1.55.d:
समानार्थः सपुत्रस्रीसर्णः सूर्यादिभे बुधे ।
सेनानीः स्त्र्यर्थपुत्राढ्यः दक्षमैश्यः परिच्छदी ॥
1.55.m: When Mercury is in the signs beginning with the Sun, [one has] mediocre wealth, children and wives, and debts; / an army commander, rich in women, wealth, and sons, clever, wealthy, possessed of retinue;

1.55.s:
maṇḍaleśaḥ sārthasukhaḥ sarṇasvāmyarkabhādgurau /
stryāptārtho mandaśokāḍhyo bandhudveṣī dhanāghavān //
1.55.d:
मण्डलेशः सार्थसुखः सर्णस्वाम्यर्कभाद्गुरौ ।
स्त्र्याप्तार्थो मन्दशोकाढ्यो बन्धुद्वेषी धनाघवान् ॥
1.55.m: a ruler of a province, endowed with caravan-trade and happiness, indebted, or a lord. When Jupiter is in the signs from the Sun: / having wealth gained from women, rich in mild grief, hating relatives, wealthy and sinful;

1.55.s:
sārthaḥ prājñaḥ samaḥ khyātiḥ srīji'torkādibhe mṛgau /
vyaṅgajārtho khaprasūko vidhimitro sukhatrayaḥ //
1.55.d:
सार्थः प्राज्ञः समः ख्यातिः स्रीजिऽतोर्कादिभे मृगौ ।
व्यङ्गजार्थो खप्रसूको विधिमित्रो सुखत्रयः ॥
1.55.m: prosperous, wise, impartial, famous, submissive to women. When [Venus] is in the signs from the Sun: / having wealth from crippled persons, childless, friendly to the wise, endowed with threefold happiness;

1.55.s:
satputrastrīdhano rājā grāme śokādibherkaje /
bhūpajñaguṇipaurāsvādṛṣṭebjejesṛgādibhiḥ //
1.55.d:
सत्पुत्रस्त्रीधनो राजा ग्रामे शोकादिभेर्कजे ।
भूपज्ञगुणिपौरास्वादृष्टेब्जेजेसृगादिभिः ॥
1.55.m: having good sons, wives, and wealth, a king, grieved in a village. When Saturn is in the signs [from the Sun]: / seen by Mars and so forth, [one becomes] a king, scholar, virtuous, town-headman, or consumer;

1.55.s:
niḥ svastena nṛpāḥ prajñapreṣyāmavinṛyugmage /
dhātvājīvī nṛpajñābhītantuvāyādhanāḥ svabhe //
1.55.d:
निः स्वस्तेन नृपाः प्रज्ञप्रेष्यामविनृयुग्मगे ।
धात्वाजीवी नृपज्ञाभीतन्तुवायाधनाः स्वभे ॥
1.55.m: in Gemini, destitute, a thief, kings, scholars, servants, or diseased; / in Cancer, living by metallurgy, a king, scholar, fearful, a weaver, or poor;

1.55.s:
yuyutsukavisūrījyadhātujīvidṛgāmayāḥ /
jyotirjñāḍhyejyanu khalu nṛpejñādikarharau //
1.55.d:
युयुत्सुकविसूरीज्यधातुजीविदृगामयाः ।
ज्योतिर्ज्ञाढ्येज्यनु खलु नृपेज्ञादिकर्हरौ ॥
1.55.m: desiring to fight, a poet, wise, an astrologer, living by minerals, or eye-diseased; / in Leo, rich in astrologers and scholars, an adviser, indeed a king, scholar, and so forth;

1.55.s:
ṣaṣṭe śubhairnṛpacamūpanaipuṇyavatitāśayāḥ /
jūke bhūpasvarṇakāravaṇijaḥ śeṣadṛgyute //
1.55.d:
षष्टे शुभैर्नृपचमूपनैपुण्यवतिताशयाः ।
जूके भूपस्वर्णकारवणिजः शेषदृग्युते ॥
1.55.m: in the sixth [Virgo], seen by benefics, commanders of the king's army, skillful, or noble-minded; / in Libra, kings, goldsmiths, or merchants; when aspected by the others,

1.55.s:
dvipaitṛkābdhidhvajino vyaṅgā svakṣitipā alau /
jñātikṣmājanayāścāye sadbhirdarmī śaṭhastathā //
1.55.d:
द्विपैतृकाब्धिध्वजिनो व्यङ्गा स्वक्षितिपा अलौ ।
ज्ञातिक्ष्माजनयाश्चाये सद्भिर्दर्मी शठस्तथा ॥
1.55.m: having two fathers, ocean-going, banner-bearing, crippled, or independent kings; in Scorpio, / having relatives, lands, and wealth; aspected by the good, righteous; likewise a rogue;

1.55.s:
bhūpamaṇḍitasakhejyāmṛge bhūyānyadārikau /
kuṃbhe śeṣaiśca hāsyajñanṛpajñāḥ sadbhirantyabhe //
1.55.d:
भूपमण्डितसखेज्यामृगे भूयान्यदारिकौ ।
कुंभे शेषैश्च हास्यज्ञनृपज्ञाः सद्भिरन्त्यभे ॥
1.55.m: in Sagittarius, kings, adorned, friendly, or revered; in Capricorn, rich or an adulterer; / in Aquarius, aspected by the rest, comics or kings' scholars; aspected by benefics in the last sign [Pisces],

1.55.s:
hāreśarkṣadalasthaistu dṛṣṭo yuktaḥ śaśī śubhaḥ /
tryaṃśe tatpatimitrarkṣagateryuktekṣitastathā //
1.55.d:
हारेशर्क्षदलस्थैस्तु दृष्टो युक्तः शशी शुभः ।
त्र्यंशे तत्पतिमित्रर्क्षगतेर्युक्तेक्षितस्तथा ॥
1.55.m: the Moon situated in the half of the lord's sign, aspected or conjoined [by them], is auspicious; / likewise in the drekkāṇa, situated in a friendly sign of that lord, conjoined or aspected.

1.55.s:
dvādaśāṃśe phalaṃ proktaṃ navāṃśe 'pyatha kīrtyate /
ārakṣeko vadharucirniyuddhakuśalor'thavān //
1.55.d:
द्वादशांशे फलं प्रोक्तं नवांशे ऽप्यथ कीर्त्यते ।
आरक्षेको वधरुचिर्नियुद्धकुशलोर्ऽथवान् ॥
1.55.m: The effect in the dvādaśāṃśa has been stated; now it is proclaimed for the navāṃśa as well: / one is a guard, fond of killing, skilled in wrestling, wealthy,

1.55.s:
kalahaḥ kṣitijāṃsthe śaukre mūrkho 'nyadāradaḥ /
kaviḥ sukhī budhāṃśe tu naṭacaurajñaśilpinaḥ //
1.55.d:
कलहः क्षितिजांस्थे शौक्रे मूर्खो ऽन्यदारदः ।
कविः सुखी बुधांशे तु नटचौरज्ञशिल्पिनः ॥
1.55.m: and quarrelsome when [the Moon is] in Mars's navāṃśa; in Venus's navāṃśa, a fool, an adulterer, / a poet, and happy; in Mercury's navāṃśa, actors, thieves, scholars, and artisans;

1.55.s:
svāṃśe tvalpatanuḥ sakhastapasvī lobhatatparaḥ /
krodhī nidhīśo mātyo vā nṛpo hiṃsro suto hareḥ //
1.55.d:
स्वांशे त्वल्पतनुः सखस्तपस्वी लोभतत्परः ।
क्रोधी निधीशो मात्यो वा नृपो हिंस्रो सुतो हरेः ॥
1.55.m: in its own navāṃśa [Cancer], slender-bodied, a friend, an ascetic, intent on greed, / wrathful, a lord of treasures, or a minister, a king, violent, a son of Hari;

1.55.s:
jīvāṃśe hāsyavidyodhā balī mantrī ca dhārmikaḥ /
alpāpatyo duḥkhito kho duṣṭastrīsauribhāgage //
1.55.d:
जीवांशे हास्यविद्योधा बली मन्त्री च धार्मिकः ।
अल्पापत्यो दुःखितो खो दुष्टस्त्रीसौरिभागगे ॥
1.55.m: in Jupiter's navāṃśa, humorous, learned, heroic, strong, a counselor, and righteous; / in Saturn's navāṃśa, having few children, miserable, foolish, having a wicked wife.

1.55.s:
bhānārvidvādidṛṣṭe nu tadvadeva phalaṃ vadet /
vargottame khe parabhe pala muktaṃ śubhaṃ kramāt //
1.55.d:
भानार्विद्वादिदृष्टे नु तद्वदेव फलं वदेत् ।
वर्गोत्तमे खे परभे पल मुक्तं शुभं क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: When aspected by the Sun, Mars, Mercury, and so forth, one should declare the effect just so. / In a vargottama, in an empty, and in another's sign, the auspicious result is declared in order:

1.55.s:
puṣṭaṃ madhyaṃ laghu jñeyaṃ yadi cāṃśapatirbalī /
rāśīkṣaṇaphalaṃ ruddhvā dadātyaṃśapalaṃ spuṭam //
1.55.d:
पुष्टं मध्यं लघु ज्ञेयं यदि चांशपतिर्बली ।
राशीक्षणफलं रुद्ध्वा ददात्यंशपलं स्पुटम् ॥
1.55.m: it is to be known as abundant, middling, and slight. And if the lord of the navāṃśa is strong, / blocking the result of the sign's aspect, it clearly gives the result of the navāṃśa.

1.55.s:
śūrastabdho vikaladṛgnighṛṇor'ke tanusthite /
meṣe dhanī taimirakaḥ siṃhe rātryandha eva ca //
1.55.d:
शूरस्तब्धो विकलदृग्निघृणोर्ऽके तनुस्थिते ।
मेषे धनी तैमिरकः सिंहे रात्र्यन्ध एव च ॥
1.55.m: When the Sun is in the ascendant, one is brave, rigid, defective in sight, and pitiless; / in Aries, wealthy and afflicted with eye disease; and in Leo, truly night-blind;

1.55.s:
nīcodhosvaḥ karkager'ke udbudākṣastanusthite /
dvitīyer'ke bahudhano nṛpadaṇḍyo mukhāmayī //
1.55.d:
नीचोधोस्वः कर्कगेर्ऽके उद्बुदाक्षस्तनुस्थिते ।
द्वितीयेर्ऽके बहुधनो नृपदण्ड्यो मुखामयी ॥
1.55.m: in Cancer, low, degraded, and poor; when the Sun is in the ascendant, he has swollen eyes. / When the Sun is in the second, he has much wealth, is punished by the king, and has mouth diseases;

1.55.s:
trige budho vikramī ca vimukhaḥ pīḍito bhuvi /
dhanāpatyoktito dhīsthe balī śatrujitorige //
1.55.d:
त्रिगे बुधो विक्रमी च विमुखः पीडितो भुवि ।
धनापत्योक्तितो धीस्थे बली शत्रुजितोरिगे ॥
1.55.m: in the third, intelligent, valorous, averse [to evil], and afflicted on earth; / in the fifth, through wealth, sons, and speech; in the sixth, strong and victorious over enemies;

1.55.s:
strī jito dyūnasaṃsthe ca nidhanelpātmajolpadṛk /
sutārthasukhabhā bhāraye daśame śrutaśauryavāt //
1.55.d:
स्त्री जितो द्यूनसंस्थे च निधनेल्पात्मजोल्पदृक् ।
सुतार्थसुखभा भारये दशमे श्रुतशौर्यवात् ॥
1.55.m: in the seventh, subjugated by women; in the eighth, having few sons and poor sight; / in the ninth, endowed with sons, wealth, and happiness; in the tenth, endowed with sacred learning and valor;

1.55.s:
lābhe bahudhano mānī patito kho 'vyaye ravau /.
mūkodho badhiraḥ preṣyo jege khāñcājage dhanī //
1.55.d:
लाभे बहुधनो मानी पतितो खो ऽव्यये रवौ ॥
मूकोधो बधिरः प्रेष्यो जेगे खाञ्चाजगे धनी ॥
1.55.m: in the eleventh, possessed of much wealth and pride; when the Sun is in the twelfth, fallen and wretched. / [For the Moon:] dumb, blind, deaf, a servant in [the first sign]; in Aries, wealthy;

1.55.s:
buṭurvā dhanavānadhe hiṃsro vikramage bhavet /
sādhubhāvaḥ sukhagate dhīsthe kanyāprajolasaḥ //
1.55.d:
बुटुर्वा धनवानधे हिंस्रो विक्रमगे भवेत् ।
साधुभावः सुखगते धीस्थे कन्याप्रजोलसः ॥
1.55.m: or a youth, wealthy in the second; in the third, violent; / in the fourth, of virtuous disposition; in the fifth, having female offspring and lazy;

1.55.s:
alpāgnikāmastīkṣṇorauīṣyustatrimadojñarave /
vyādhipūḍānvito mṛtyau bhānurddhanage mitradhanānvitaḥ //
1.55.d:
अल्पाग्निकामस्तीक्ष्णोरौईष्युस्तत्रिमदोज्ञरवे ।
व्याधिपूडान्वितो मृत्यौ भानुर्द्धनगे मित्रधनान्वितः ॥
1.55.m: in the sixth, having little digestive fire, lustful, harsh, and envious; in the seventh, arrogant and foolish; / in the eighth, afflicted with disease and suffering; in the ninth, endowed with friends and wealth;

1.55.s:
dharmadhīdhanayugrājye khyātadhīdhanayugbhavet /
kṣudrāeṃ'gahīno vyayage candre proktaṃ phalaṃ budhaiḥ //
1.55.d:
धर्मधीधनयुग्राज्ये ख्यातधीधनयुग्भवेत् ।
क्षुद्राएंऽगहीनो व्ययगे चन्द्रे प्रोक्तं फलं बुधैः ॥
1.55.m: in the tenth, endowed with righteousness, intellect, and wealth; in the kingdom, famous, wise, and wealthy; / in the twelfth, mean-spirited and defective in limbs: thus is the result proclaimed by the wise for the Moon.

1.55.s:
lagne kuje kṣatatanurddhanage tu kadannabhuk /
dharmapāpasamācāro 'nyatra sūryasamo mataḥ //
1.55.d:
लग्ने कुजे क्षततनुर्द्धनगे तु कदन्नभुक् ।
धर्मपापसमाचारो ऽन्यत्र सूर्यसमो मतः ॥
1.55.m: When Mars is in the ascendant, one has wounds on his body; in the second, he eats bad food; / he engages in righteous and sinful deeds; elsewhere he is considered equal to the Sun.

1.55.s:
vidvān dhanī ca pravaraḥ paṇḍitaḥ sacivoriyuk /
dharmajño vistṛtaguṇo gādhojñeyarator'kavat //
1.55.d:
विद्वान् धनी च प्रवरः पण्डितः सचिवोरियुक् ।
धर्मज्ञो विस्तृतगुणो गाधोज्ञेयरतोर्ऽकवत् ॥
1.55.m: Learned, wealthy, eminent, a scholar, a minister, endowed with enemies, / knowing righteousness, having extensive virtues, profound, devoted to learning, like the Sun [is Mercury].

1.55.s:
vidvānsa vācyaḥ kṛpaṇī sukhākṣo ripugṛddhimān /
nīcastapasvī caṣṇavanī lobhīduṣṭastanorguro //
1.55.d:
विद्वान्स वाच्यः कृपणी सुखाक्षो रिपुगृद्धिमान् ।
नीचस्तपस्वी चष्णवनी लोभीदुष्टस्तनोर्गुरो ॥
1.55.m: When Jupiter is in the ascendant, one should be called learned, stingy, having pleasing eyes, coveting enemies' [wealth], / base, an ascetic, an eater, greedy, and wicked.

1.55.s:
smarī mukhī vilagnasthe kalahī suratotsukaḥ /
sukhitastanapasye ca bhṛgau jīvavadanyataḥ //
1.55.d:
स्मरी मुखी विलग्नस्थे कलही सुरतोत्सुकः ।
सुखितस्तनपस्ये च भृगौ जीववदन्यतः ॥
1.55.m: When Venus is in the ascendant, one is passionate, prominent, quarrelsome, and eager for coitus; / happy, in the ninth; elsewhere, like Jupiter.

1.55.s:
niḥśvo rogī kāmavaśo malinaḥ śaiśavārtiyuk /
alaso lagnage mande dharmātsvoñcagate nṛpaḥ //
1.55.d:
निःश्वो रोगी कामवशो मलिनः शैशवार्तियुक् ।
अलसो लग्नगे मन्दे धर्मात्स्वोञ्चगते नृपः ॥
1.55.m: When Saturn is in the ascendant, one is destitute, diseased, subject to lust, filthy, afflicted from childhood, / and lazy; through virtue, in its own or exaltation sign, he is a king,

1.55.s:
grāmādhipaḥ sa vidvāṃśca cārvaṅgo 'nyatra sūryavat /
pūrṇamuccetha pādonaphalaṃ mūlatrikoṇage //
1.55.d:
ग्रामाधिपः स विद्वांश्च चार्वङ्गो ऽन्यत्र सूर्यवत् ।
पूर्णमुच्चेथ पादोनफलं मूलत्रिकोणगे ॥
1.55.m: a village headman, learned, and fair-limbed; elsewhere, like the Sun. / In exaltation, the result is full; in mūlatrikoṇa, one quarter less;

1.55.s:
śubhagrahedalaṃ svarkṣe mitrabheṃ'ghrimitaṃ phalam /
śatrubhe 'lpaṃ tathā nīcāstaṅgate phalaśūnyatā //
1.55.d:
शुभग्रहेदलं स्वर्क्षे मित्रभेंऽघ्रिमितं फलम् ।
शत्रुभे ऽल्पं तथा नीचास्तङ्गते फलशून्यता ॥
1.55.m: for a benefic planet in its own sign, half; in a friendly sign, the result is measured as one quarter; / in an inimical sign, slight; and in debilitation or setting, there is complete absence of results.

1.55.s:
khabharākādike kheṭe kulatulyaḥ kulādhikaḥ /
bandhupūjyo 'thadhanavānsukhī bhogī nṛpaḥ kramāt //
1.55.d:
खभराकादिके खेटे कुलतुल्यः कुलाधिकः ।
बन्धुपूज्यो ऽथधनवान्सुखी भोगी नृपः क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: When a planet occupies one, two, or more [favorable positions], one is equal to his family, superior to his family, / honored by kin, then wealthy, happy, enjoying pleasures, and a king, respectively.

1.55.s:
parivittasuhṛdvandhupoṣyāgaṇabalādhipau /
nṛpaśca mitrabhāstheṣu kheṭe vrekādiṣu kramāt //
1.55.d:
परिवित्तसुहृद्वन्धुपोष्यागणबलाधिपौ ।
नृपश्च मित्रभास्थेषु खेटे व्रेकादिषु क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: When planets are in friendly signs, one is, respectively, / one with many relatives, friends, kin, dependents, a commander of troops, and a king.

1.55.s:
viṣamarkṣer'kahorāyāṃ sasthite śubhabheṣu ca /
khyāto mahodyamī cātitejā dhīmāndhanī balī //
1.55.d:
विषमर्क्षेर्ऽकहोरायां सस्थिते शुभभेषु च ।
ख्यातो महोद्यमी चातितेजा धीमान्धनी बली ॥
1.55.m: When benefics are situated in an odd sign and in the Sun's horā, / a man becomes renowned, highly energetic, very radiant, wise, wealthy, and strong.

1.55.s:
śubheṣu candrahorāyāṃ sthiteṣu samarāśiṣu /
kāntimārddavasaubhāgyabhogadhīmānbhavennaraḥ //
1.55.d:
शुभेषु चन्द्रहोरायां स्थितेषु समराशिषु ।
कान्तिमार्द्दवसौभाग्यभोगधीमान्भवेन्नरः ॥
1.55.m: When benefics are situated in even signs and in the Moon's horā, / a man will be endowed with beauty, gentleness, good fortune, enjoyment, and intelligence.

1.55.s:
sūryahorāgataḥ pāpaḥ samabheṣu tu madhyamāḥ /
viṣamarkṣeṣu bhāskaryā saumyā noktaphalapradāḥ //
1.55.d:
सूर्यहोरागतः पापः समभेषु तु मध्यमाः ।
विषमर्क्षेषु भास्कर्या सौम्या नोक्तफलप्रदाः ॥
1.55.m: A malefic in the Sun's horā in even signs yields middling results; / benefics in odd signs in the Sun's [horā] do not bestow the stated result.

1.55.s:
svamitratryaṃśagaścandraḥ surūpaṃ guṇinaṃ naram /
karotyannagatastadvattattulyaguṇarūpiṇam //
1.55.d:
स्वमित्रत्र्यंशगश्चन्द्रः सुरूपं गुणिनं नरम् ।
करोत्यन्नगतस्तद्वत्तत्तुल्यगुणरूपिणम् ॥
1.55.m: The Moon situated in its own or a friend's drekkāṇa makes a man handsome and virtuous; / situated in another's, it makes him possess virtues and form equal to that [planet].

1.55.s:
vyālāyudhe catuṣpādāṃ'jeṣu ca tryaṃśake ca /
tīkṣṇe 'tihiṃsraśca bhavedgurutalpagatoṭanaḥ //
1.55.d:
व्यालायुधे चतुष्पादांऽजेषु च त्र्यंशके च ।
तीक्ष्णे ऽतिहिंस्रश्च भवेद्गुरुतल्पगतोटनः ॥
1.55.m: In a serpent, weapon, or quadruped drekkāṇa, / one becomes sharp, exceedingly violent, a violator of the guru's bed, and a wanderer;

1.55.s:
steno bhoktā sadhanadhīrnṛpaḥ klībaśca śatruhā /
viṣṭikṛddāsavṛttiśca pāpo hiṃsno 'matirbhavet //
1.55.d:
स्तेनो भोक्ता सधनधीर्नृपः क्लीबश्च शत्रुहा ।
विष्टिकृद्दासवृत्तिश्च पापो हिंस्नो ऽमतिर्भवेत् ॥
1.55.m: a thief, an enjoyer, endowed with wealth and intellect, a king, a eunuch, a slayer of enemies, / doing forced labor, living by slavery, sinful, violent, and devoid of intellect.

1.55.s:
meṣādikottamāṃśeṣu dvādaśāṃśeṣu rāśivat /
jāyābalavibhūṣāḍhyaḥ sattvayukto 'tisāhasī //
1.55.d:
मेषादिकोत्तमांशेषु द्वादशांशेषु राशिवत् ।
जायाबलविभूषाढ्यः सत्त्वयुक्तो ऽतिसाहसी ॥
1.55.m: In the navāṃśas of Aries and the others, [and] in the dvādaśāṃśas, [the results are] as for the signs. / Endowed with strength of wife and ornaments, possessing sattva, exceedingly daring,

1.55.s:
tejasvī ca naraḥ khāye triṃśāṃse sṛjisaṃsthite /
āmayī vā svabhāryāyāṃ viṣamaḥ pāradārikaḥ //
1.55.d:
तेजस्वी च नरः खाये त्रिंशांसे सृजिसंस्थिते ।
आमयी वा स्वभार्यायां विषमः पारदारिकः ॥
1.55.m: and radiant is a man in the triṃśāṃśa of Saturn situated in Aries; / or sickly, harsh towards his own wife, and an adulterer;

1.55.s:
duḥkhī paricchadayuto malinaścārkaje svake /
sukhadhīdhanakīrtyālastejasvī lokapūjitaḥ //
1.55.d:
दुःखी परिच्छदयुतो मलिनश्चार्कजे स्वके ।
सुखधीधनकीर्त्यालस्तेजस्वी लोकपूजितः ॥
1.55.m: miserable, accompanied by retinue, and filthy in Saturn's own [triṃśāṃśa]. / Endowed with happiness, intellect, wealth, and fame, radiant, honored by the world,

1.55.s:
nīraguhyabhavānbhogī jīve khatriṃśabhāgage /
medhākalākāvyaśilpavivādakapaṭāñcitaḥ //
1.55.d:
नीरगुह्यभवान्भोगी जीवे खत्रिंशभागगे ।
मेधाकलाकाव्यशिल्पविवादकपटाञ्चितः ॥
1.55.m: free from secret diseases, and enjoying pleasures [is he] when Jupiter is in Saturn's triṃśāṃśa. / Endowed with intelligence, arts, poetry, crafts, dispute, and deceit,

1.55.s:
śāstrārthasāhasayuto budhe svatriṃśabhāgage /
bahvapatsukhāraugyarogarūpārthasaṃyutaḥ //
1.55.d:
शास्त्रार्थसाहसयुतो बुधे स्वत्रिंशभागगे ।
बह्वपत्सुखारौग्यरोगरूपार्थसंयुतः ॥
1.55.m: accompanied by daring in the meaning of the scriptures, when Mercury is in his own triṃśāṃśa. / Endowed with many children, happiness, health, disease, beauty, and wealth,

1.55.s:
lalitāṅgo viprakīṇandriyaḥ syādbhārgave svake /
śūrastabdhau ca viṣamavadhakau sadguṇānvitau //
1.55.d:
ललिताङ्गो विप्रकीणन्द्रियः स्याद्भार्गवे स्वके ।
शूरस्तब्धौ च विषमवधकौ सद्गुणान्वितौ ॥
1.55.m: with graceful limbs, whose senses are scattered, would he be in Venus's own [triṃśāṃśa]. / Brave and stiff, harsh and murderous, endowed with good qualities,

1.55.s: sukhejño cāru ceṣṭāṅgau candrārkkaucetkujādigau mūlatrikoṇasvarkṣocce kaṇṭhasthāstu ca ye grahāḥ //
1.55.d: सुखेज्ञो चारु चेष्टाङ्गौ चन्द्रार्क्कौचेत्कुजादिगौ मूलत्रिकोणस्वर्क्षोच्चे कण्ठस्थास्तु च ये ग्रहाः ॥
1.55.m: happy, knowing, with beautiful gestures and limbs, if the Moon and Sun are in [the signs of] Mars and the rest. / Planets which are in their m乗latrikoṇa, own sign, or exaltation, and situated in the kendras,

1.55.s:
anyonyakārakāste syuḥ karmagastu viśeṣataḥ /
śubhaṃ vargottame janma vesisthāne vasadgṛhaiḥ //
1.55.d:
अन्योन्यकारकास्ते स्युः कर्मगस्तु विशेषतः ।
शुभं वर्गोत्तमे जन्म वेसिस्थाने वसद्गृहैः ॥
1.55.m: they become mutual factors (kārakas), especially one in the tenth house. / Birth is auspicious in vargottama, or through planets occupying the veśi position.

1.55.s:
aśūnyeṣu ca kendreṣu kārakākhyagṛheṣu ca /
gurujanmeśalagneśāḥ kendrasthā madhyasaukhyādāḥ //
1.55.d:
अशून्येषु च केन्द्रेषु कारकाख्यगृहेषु च ।
गुरुजन्मेशलग्नेशाः केन्द्रस्था मध्यसौख्यादाः ॥
1.55.m: And when the kendras are not empty, and in the signs called kāraka. / Jupiter, the lord of the birth sign, and the lord of the ascendant situated in kendras grant moderate happiness.

1.55.s:
pṛṣṭobhavakodaparkṣasthitāstvantyāntarāduṣu /
praveśe bhāskarakujau bhṛgvījyo madhyagau tathā //
1.55.d:
पृष्टोभवकोदपर्क्षस्थितास्त्वन्त्यान्तरादुषु ।
प्रवेशे भास्करकुजौ भृग्वीज्यो मध्यगौ तथा ॥
1.55.m: Planets situated in signs that rise from the back, front, and both [give results] at the end, middle, and beginning respectively. / At the entrance, the Sun and Mars [give results]; Venus and Jupiter in the middle likewise;

1.55.s:
candrārkī phala dāvantye sadā jñaḥ phaladāyakaḥ /
lagnātputre kalatre vābjācchubheśayutekṣite //
1.55.d:
चन्द्रार्की फल दावन्त्ये सदा ज्ञः फलदायकः ।
लग्नात्पुत्रे कलत्रे वाब्जाच्छुभेशयुतेक्षिते ॥
1.55.m: the Moon and Saturn give results at the end; Mercury always gives results. / In the fifth or seventh from the ascendant or the Moon, when joined or aspected by the lord of benefics,

1.55.s:
syāttayoḥ saṃpadaḥ svatvamanyathāthāṅgatodayaḥ /
ravau bhīner'kajaḥ srīghnaḥ putrasthastu tathā kujaḥ //
1.55.d:
स्यात्तयोः संपदः स्वत्वमन्यथाथाङ्गतोदयः ।
रवौ भीनेर्ऽकजः स्रीघ्नः पुत्रस्थस्तु तथा कुजः ॥
1.55.m: there is wealth and personal property for both; otherwise, [results come] from the ascendant. / When the Sun is in the ascendant, Saturn kills the wife; Mars situated in the fifth likewise.

1.55.s:
simāturyāṣṭagaiḥ krūrairyadvā krūrāntare sitaḥ /
sadgrahāyutadṛṣṭaścedagnipātānmṛtiḥ striyāḥ //
1.55.d:
सिमातुर्याष्टगैः क्रूरैर्यद्वा क्रूरान्तरे सितः ।
सद्ग्रहायुतदृष्टश्चेदग्निपातान्मृतिः स्त्रियाः ॥
1.55.m: When malefic planets are in the twelfth, fourth, or eighth house, or if Venus is between malefics, / if not conjoined or aspected by benefic planets, the wife's death occurs through fire or falling.

1.55.s:
lagnadya pāṇigatayoḥ śaśiravyoḥ saha striyā /
ekena yasya janmāhuratha saptamasaṃsthayoḥ //
1.55.d:
लग्नद्य पाणिगतयोः शशिरव्योः सह स्त्रिया ।
एकेन यस्य जन्माहुरथ सप्तमसंस्थयोः ॥
1.55.m: When the Moon and Sun are in the ascendant and the seventh, with a woman / by one [planet] they say a person's birth occurs; then, if they are in the seventh,

1.55.s:
navadhīgatayorvāpi vikalasrīsitārkayoḥ /
koṇodaye 'stāṃ tyasandhau bhṛgau bandhyāpaterjaniḥ //
1.55.d:
नवधीगतयोर्वापि विकलस्रीसितार्कयोः ।
कोणोदये ऽस्तां त्यसन्धौ भृगौ बन्ध्यापतेर्जनिः ॥
1.55.m: or if Venus and the Sun are in the ninth or fifth, the wife is impaired. / When Venus is in the ascendant of a trine, or at the junction of the seventh and twelfth, the birth is of one whose wife is barren.

1.55.s:
sutabhaṃ cenna saumyāḍhyamathāntyāstodayarkṣagaiḥ /
pāpe dhīsthe vidhau kṣīṇajanmā sutakalatriṇaḥ //
1.55.d:
सुतभं चेन्न सौम्याढ्यमथान्त्यास्तोदयर्क्षगैः ।
पापे धीस्थे विधौ क्षीणजन्मा सुतकलत्रिणः ॥
1.55.m: If the house of children is not endowed with benefics, then with malefics in the twelfth, seventh, or the rising sign, / and the waning Moon in the fifth, birth is of one who has [illness in] children and wife.

1.55.s:
śanau khage 'ste saśukre tadṛṣṭe pāradārikaḥ /
tau cetseṃdusriyā sārddhaṃ puṃścalo jāyate naraḥ //
1.55.d:
शनौ खगे ऽस्ते सशुक्रे तदृष्टे पारदारिकः ।
तौ चेत्सेंदुस्रिया सार्द्धं पुंश्चलो जायते नरः ॥
1.55.m: When Saturn is in the tenth, or in the seventh with Venus or aspected by him, he is an adulterer; / if those two are with the Moon, a man becomes promiscuous along with his wife.

1.55.s:
bhūgvabjayorastagayornaro bhāryā suto 'pi vā /
nṛsriyo stu śubhairdṛṣṭau tau dvau pariṇatāṅgakau //
1.55.d:
भूग्वब्जयोरस्तगयोर्नरो भार्या सुतो ऽपि वा ।
नृस्रियो स्तु शुभैर्दृष्टौ तौ द्वौ परिणताङ्गकौ ॥
1.55.m: When Venus and the Moon are in the seventh house, a man, or his wife, or his son / have aged bodies; but if they are aspected by benefics, both of the couple [flourish].

1.55.s:
ravāstāṃbugairinduśukrapāpairvaṃśavināśakaḥ /
śilpī tryeśe budhayute kendrasaṃsthārkivīkṣite //
1.55.d:
रवास्तांबुगैरिन्दुशुक्रपापैर्वंशविनाशकः ।
शिल्पी त्र्येशे बुधयुते केन्द्रसंस्थार्किवीक्षिते ॥
1.55.m: When the Moon, Venus, and malefics are in the Sun, seventh, and fourth, he is a destroyer of his lineage. / One is an artisan when the lord of the third is joined with Mercury and aspected by Saturn in a kendra.

1.55.s:
dāsyāṃ jātaḥ sauribhāge riḥphage bhṛgunandane /
nīcer'kendorastagayordṛṣṭayoḥ sūryajena vā //
1.55.d:
दास्यां जातः सौरिभागे रिःफगे भृगुनन्दने ।
नीचेर्ऽकेन्दोरस्तगयोर्दृष्टयोः सूर्यजेन वा ॥
1.55.m: He is born of a female slave when Venus is in the navāṃśa of Saturn in the twelfth house, / or when the Sun and Moon are debilitated, set, or aspected by Saturn.

1.55.s:
pāpadṛṣṭau śanikujāvastagau vātarukpradau /
karkālyaṃ śagate kendre pāpayukte tu guhyaruk //
1.55.d:
पापदृष्टौ शनिकुजावस्तगौ वातरुक्प्रदौ ।
कर्काल्यं शगते केन्द्रे पापयुक्ते तु गुह्यरुक् ॥
1.55.m: Saturn and Mars aspected by malefics and set grant diseases of wind. / When a kendra is in a navāṃśa of Cancer or Scorpio and joined by malefics, there is secret disease.

1.55.s:
pāpātaragateṃ'gebje ravau dyūne tu kuṣṭayuk /
candre khe 'stāṅgate bhaume vikalo veśiger'kaje //
1.55.d:
पापातरगतेंऽगेब्जे रवौ द्यूने तु कुष्टयुक् ।
चन्द्रे खे ऽस्ताङ्गते भौमे विकलो वेशिगेर्ऽकजे ॥
1.55.m: When the ascendant or Moon is between malefics and the Sun is in the seventh, he is afflicted with leprosy. / When the Moon is in the tenth, Mars in the seventh or the ascendant, and Saturn in the veśi house, he is crippled.

1.55.s:
mitho bhāṃśagayoḥ śūlī ravīndvoryutayoḥ kṛśaḥ /
nidhanāridhanāntyasthā ravīndvārayamā yadā //
1.55.d:
मिथो भांशगयोः शूली रवीन्द्वोर्युतयोः कृशः ।
निधनारिधनान्त्यस्था रवीन्द्वारयमा यदा ॥
1.55.m: When [the Sun and Moon] are in each other's signs or navāṃśas, he has colic; when the Sun and Moon are conjoined, he is emaciated. / When the Sun, Moon, Mars, and Saturn are in the eighth, sixth, second, or twelfth house,

1.55.s:
caladgraheṇa doṣeṇa kurvantyanayanaṃ naram /
saumyā dṛṣṭā na vāyatridhīgatāḥ pāpakhecarāḥ //
1.55.d:
चलद्ग्रहेण दोषेण कुर्वन्त्यनयनं नरम् ।
सौम्या दृष्टा न वायत्रिधीगताः पापखेचराः ॥
1.55.m: they make a man blind through the affliction of a wandering planet. / Malefic planets in the eleventh, third, or fifth, not aspected by benefics,

1.55.s:
karṇopaghātakā dyūne radavaikṛtyakārakāḥ /
lagne gurau dyune mande vātarogādito bhavet //
1.55.d:
कर्णोपघातका द्यूने रदवैकृत्यकारकाः ।
लग्ने गुरौ द्युने मन्दे वातरोगादितो भवेत् ॥
1.55.m: cause injury to the ears; in the seventh, they cause deformity of teeth. / With Jupiter in the ascendant and Saturn in the seventh, it happens through wind disease and the like.

1.55.s:
sukhe 'ste vā kuje jīve lagne vārkiyutodaye /
kujena vātmaje dyūne saṃjñeṃ'tye 'bje ca sonmadaḥ //
1.55.d:
सुखे ऽस्ते वा कुजे जीवे लग्ने वार्कियुतोदये ।
कुजेन वात्मजे द्यूने संज्ञेंऽत्ये ऽब्जे च सोन्मदः ॥
1.55.m: When Mars is in the fourth or seventh, or Jupiter in the ascendant, or with Saturn in the ascendant, / or with Mars in the fifth, or in the seventh, or the Moon in the twelfth, he becomes insane.

1.55.s:
dhīdharmārthāntyagaiḥ pāpairbhasamasyānnibandhanam /
sarpaśṛṅkhalayā śāṭhyairdṛkkairbalyaśubhekṣitaiḥ //
1.55.d:
धीधर्मार्थान्त्यगैः पापैर्भसमस्यान्निबन्धनम् ।
सर्पशृङ्खलया शाठ्यैर्दृक्कैर्बल्यशुभेक्षितैः ॥
1.55.m: With malefics in the fifth, ninth, second, or twelfth, imprisonment of that sign occurs, / by snake, chain, or deceit, through decanates aspected by strong malefics.

1.55.s:
samande 'bje vakradṛṣṭe pasmārī durvacāḥ kṣayī /
ravimandakujaiḥ ravasthaiḥ saumyadṛṣṭaiḥ samaṇḍalaiḥ //
1.55.d:
समन्दे ऽब्जे वक्रदृष्टे पस्मारी दुर्वचाः क्षयी ।
रविमन्दकुजैः रवस्थैः सौम्यदृष्टैः समण्डलैः ॥
1.55.m: When the Moon is with Saturn and aspected by Mars, one is epileptic, foul-mouthed, and consumptive. / When the Sun, Saturn, and Mars are in the Sun's position and aspected by benefics in disks,

1.55.s:
bhṛtakāḥ pūrvamuditairvaramadhyādhamā narāḥ /
puñjanau tu phalaṃ puṇyasrīṇāṃ yogyaṃ vadecca tat //
1.55.d:
भृतकाः पूर्वमुदितैर्वरमध्याधमा नराः ।
पुञ्जनौ तु फलं पुण्यस्रीणां योग्यं वदेच्च तत् ॥
1.55.m: men become servants—best, middling, or lowest—according to the earlier statements. / But in the birth of a man, one should state the result; that which is suitable for virtuous women [should be stated] for them.

1.55.s:
tatsvāmiṣvakhilaṃ kāryaṃ tadbhartṛmaraṇaṃ mṛtau /
lagnendugaṃ vapuścaiva yādayūpapītadyune //
1.55.d:
तत्स्वामिष्वखिलं कार्यं तद्भर्तृमरणं मृतौ ।
लग्नेन्दुगं वपुश्चैव यादयूपपीतद्युने ॥
1.55.m: All that must be applied to their husbands; the husband's death is from the eighth house; / the body is from the ascendant and the Moon; the yādā is from the seventh house.

1.55.s:
yugmeṣu lagnaśaśinorvanitā prakṛtisthitā /
sacchīlabhūṣaṇayutā śubhasaṃdṛṣṭayostayoḥ //
1.55.d:
युग्मेषु लग्नशशिनोर्वनिता प्रकृतिस्थिता ।
सच्छीलभूषणयुता शुभसंदृष्टयोस्तयोः ॥
1.55.m: When the ascendant and Moon are in even signs, a woman remains in her natural state; / endowed with good conduct and ornaments, if those two are aspected by benefics.

1.55.s:
puruṣākṛti śīlāḍhyā tayorojasthayormatā /
atha pāpā guṇonāśca pāpavīkṣitathostayoḥ //
1.55.d:
पुरुषाकृति शीलाढ्या तयोरोजस्थयोर्मता ।
अथ पापा गुणोनाश्च पापवीक्षितथोस्तयोः ॥
1.55.m: When those two are in odd signs, she is considered endowed with male form and character; / then, she is wicked and devoid of virtues when those two are aspected by malefics.

1.55.s:
kujārkījyajñaśukrāṇāṃ kujarkṣe kramaśo 'ṅganā /
bālyaduṣṭā tathā dāsī sādhvī māyāvatī tvarā //
1.55.d:
कुजार्कीज्यज्ञशुक्राणां कुजर्क्षे क्रमशो ऽङ्गना ।
बाल्यदुष्टा तथा दासी साध्वी मायावती त्वरा ॥
1.55.m: In a sign of Mars, in the triṃśāṃśas of Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus respectively, a woman is: / wicked in childhood, a servant, virtuous, deceitful, and rash;

1.55.s:
dṛṣṭā vākṛtiśīlā syāttayorojasthayormatā /
atha pāpā guṇonāśca pāpavīkṣitayostayoḥ //
1.55.d:
दृष्टा वाकृतिशीला स्यात्तयोरोजस्थयोर्मता ।
अथ पापा गुणोनाश्च पापवीक्षितयोस्तयोः ॥
1.55.m: her appearance and character are considered according to their aspects when they are in odd signs; / then, she is wicked and devoid of virtues when those two are aspected by malefics.

1.55.s:
duṣṇavāk punarbhūḥ saguṇā vijñā khyātā sphujidgrṛhe /
baudhe samā yā klīvā ca satī guṇavatī calā //
1.55.d:
दुष्णवाक् पुनर्भूः सगुणा विज्ञा ख्याता स्फुजिद्ग्रृहे ।
बौधे समा या क्लीवा च सती गुणवती चला ॥
1.55.m: evil-speaking, remarried, virtuous, wise, and famous in the house of Venus; / in Mercury's [sign]: modest, impotent, faithful, virtuous, and fickle;

1.55.s:
dvandvabhe svairiṇīśadhnī guṇāḍhyā śilpikādhamā /
vācāṭā kulaṭā siṃhe rāgī pundhīragamyatā //
1.55.d:
द्वन्द्वभे स्वैरिणीशध्नी गुणाढ्या शिल्पिकाधमा ।
वाचाटा कुलटा सिंहे रागी पुन्धीरगम्यता ॥
1.55.m: in a dual sign: unchaste, husband-killing, endowed with virtues, artisan, and base; / in Leo: talkative, unchaste, passionate, manly in intellect, and unapproachable;

1.55.s:
jaive guṇāḍhyālparatirguṇajñā jñāninī satī /
dāsī nīcaratā sādhvī mānde duṣṭā napatyakā //
1.55.d:
जैवे गुणाढ्याल्परतिर्गुणज्ञा ज्ञानिनी सती ।
दासी नीचरता साध्वी मान्दे दुष्टा नपत्यका ॥
1.55.m: in Jupiter's [sign]: rich in virtues, having little sexual desire, knowing virtues, wise, and chaste; / in Saturn's: a servant, taking pleasure in base men, virtuous, wicked, and barren.

1.55.s:
lagnenduyuktaisriṃśāṃśaiḥ phalametadvalānugam /
dṛggaiḥ mithoṃśe śukrārkī śaukre cedvā ghaṭāṃśake //
1.55.d:
लग्नेन्दुयुक्तैस्रिंशांशैः फलमेतद्वलानुगम् ।
दृग्गैः मिथोंशे शुक्रार्की शौक्रे चेद्वा घटांशके ॥
1.55.m: This result follows the strength [of planets] through the triṃśāṃśas joined with the ascendant and Moon. / By aspects: when Venus and Saturn are in each other's navāṃśa, or in Venus's or Aquarius's navāṃśa,

1.55.s:
strībhiḥ strī maithunaṃ yāti madanānaladīpitā /
śūnye kāpuruṣo dyūne bale klīvo na sadṛśi //
1.55.d:
स्त्रीभिः स्त्री मैथुनं याति मदनानलदीपिता ।
शून्ये कापुरुषो द्यूने बले क्लीवो न सदृशि ॥
1.55.m: inflamed by the fire of passion, a woman engages in sexual union with women. / When the seventh house is empty, [her husband is] a coward; when weak, impotent, not suitable;

1.55.s:
budhārkyoścarabhe nityaṃ paradeśaparāyaṇaḥ /
tatsṛṣṭā madage sūrye strībālavidhavā kuje //
1.55.d:
बुधार्क्योश्चरभे नित्यं परदेशपरायणः ।
तत्सृष्टा मदगे सूर्ये स्त्रीबालविधवा कुजे ॥
1.55.m: in a movable sign of Mercury or Saturn, he is always devoted to foreign lands. / When the Sun is in the seventh house, she is deserted by him; when Mars [is there], she becomes a widow while a girl.

1.55.s:
pāpadṛṣṭe śanau dyūne kanyaivāpadyate jarām /
āgneyairvidhavāstasthaiḥ punarbhūmiśrakairbhaghavet //
1.55.d:
पापदृष्टे शनौ द्यूने कन्यैवापद्यते जराम् ।
आग्नेयैर्विधवास्तस्थैः पुनर्भूमिश्रकैर्भघवेत् ॥
1.55.m: When Saturn is in the seventh aspected by a malefic, she grows old as a virgin. / When fiery planets are in the seventh, she becomes a widow; with mixed [planets], a remarried woman.

1.55.s:
krūre hīnabale 'stasthe patityaktā na sadṛśi /
mithoṃśagaiḥ sitārau tu kuruto 'nyaratāṃ striyam //
1.55.d:
क्रूरे हीनबले ऽस्तस्थे पतित्यक्ता न सदृशि ।
मिथोंशगैः सितारौ तु कुरुतो ऽन्यरतां स्त्रियम् ॥
1.55.m: When a malefic weak in strength is in the seventh, she is abandoned by her husband, not matched. / Venus and Mars in mutual navāṃśas make a woman fond of others;

1.55.s:
śītaraśmiryadā dyūne tadā bharturanusayā /
saurārarkṣe lagnagate seṃduśukre tu vandhakī //
1.55.d:
शीतरश्मिर्यदा द्यूने तदा भर्तुरनुसया ।
सौरारर्क्षे लग्नगते सेंदुशुक्रे तु वन्धकी ॥
1.55.m: when the Moon is in the seventh house, then [she is] obedient to her husband. / But when Saturn or Mars's sign is in the ascendant with the Moon and Venus, she is an adulteress,

1.55.s:
mātrā sārddhamasaddṛṣṭe tathā kaujeṃśake 'stage /
mandadṛṣṭe vyādhiyoniḥ sadgrahāṃśe patipriyā //
1.55.d:
मात्रा सार्द्धमसद्दृष्टे तथा कौजेंशके ऽस्तगे ।
मन्ददृष्टे व्याधियोनिः सद्ग्रहांशे पतिप्रिया ॥
1.55.m: together with her mother, if aspected by malefics; likewise, when a navāṃśa of Mars is set / and aspected by Saturn, she has a diseased vagina; in a navāṃśa of a benefic, she is dear to her husband.

1.55.s:
mandarkṣe vāṃśake dyūne vṛddhau mūrkhaḥ patiḥ striyāḥ /
strīlolaḥ krodhanaḥ kauje baudhe vidvāṃśca naipuṇaḥ //
1.55.d:
मन्दर्क्षे वांशके द्यूने वृद्धौ मूर्खः पतिः स्त्रियाः ।
स्त्रीलोलः क्रोधनः कौजे बौधे विद्वांश्च नैपुणः ॥
1.55.m: When Saturn's sign or navāṃśa is in the seventh, a woman's husband is old and foolish; / in Mars's, fond of women and wrathful; in Mercury's, learned and skillful;

1.55.s:
jitendriyo gṛṇījaive cāndre kāmī mṛdustathā /
śaukre saubhāgyayukkāntaḥ saureti mṛdukarmakṛt //
1.55.d:
जितेन्द्रियो गृणीजैवे चान्द्रे कामी मृदुस्तथा ।
शौक्रे सौभाग्ययुक्कान्तः सौरेति मृदुकर्मकृत् ॥
1.55.m: in Jupiter's, with controlled senses and a householder; in the Moon's, lustful and gentle; / in Venus's, fortunate and handsome; in Saturn's, doing very gentle work.

1.55.s:
śukrābjayorlagnagayoḥ sukhinīrṣyāsamanvitā /
jñedvoḥ kalāsu nipuṇā sukhitā ca guṇānvitā //
śukrajñayostu śubhagā kalājñā rucirāṅganā /
anekasaukhyārthaguṇālagne saumyatraye sthite //
1.55.d:
शुक्राब्जयोर्लग्नगयोः सुखिनीर्ष्यासमन्विता ।
ज्ञेद्वोः कलासु निपुणा सुखिता च गुणान्विता ॥
शुक्रज्ञयोस्तु शुभगा कलाज्ञा रुचिराङ्गना ।
अनेकसौख्यार्थगुणालग्ने सौम्यत्रये स्थिते ॥
1.55.m:
When Venus and the Moon are in the ascendant, she is happy and full of jealousy; / when Mercury and the Moon [are there], skillful in the arts, happy, and endowed with virtues.

When Venus and Mercury [are in the ascendant, she is] fortunate, skilled in the arts, and a beautiful woman; / and when the triad of benefics is in the ascendant, she possesses manifold comforts, wealth, and good qualities.

1.55.s:
krūre 'ṣṭame 'ṣṭameśāṃśe yasya syāttadvayaḥ same /
vaidhavyaṃ ca mṛtistasyā svayaṃsatsvarthageṣu tu //
1.55.d:
क्रूरे ऽष्टमे ऽष्टमेशांशे यस्य स्यात्तद्वयः समे ।
वैधव्यं च मृतिस्तस्या स्वयंसत्स्वर्थगेषु तु ॥
1.55.m: When a malefic is in the eighth house or in the navāṃśa of the eighth lord, then at an age equal to that [lord], / widowhood and death occur for her; but when benefics occupy the second house, [she predeceases her husband].

1.55.s:
alpāpatyatvamabje 'syāḥ kanyāliharigoṣu tu /
saure madhyabale candraśukrajñairbalavarjitaiḥ //
1.55.d:
अल्पापत्यत्वमब्जे ऽस्याः कन्यालिहरिगोषु तु ।
सौरे मध्यबले चन्द्रशुक्रज्ञैर्बलवर्जितैः ॥
1.55.m: She has few children if the Moon is in Virgo, Scorpio, Leo, or Taurus; / when Saturn has middling strength, while the Moon, Venus, and Mercury are devoid of strength,

1.55.s:
śeṣaiḥ savīryairojarkṣe lagne kurūpiṇī bhavet /
jīvārakaviśaumyeṣu baliṣu samabhe tanau //
1.55.d:
शेषैः सवीर्यैरोजर्क्षे लग्ने कुरूपिणी भवेत् ।
जीवारकविशौम्येषु बलिषु समभे तनौ ॥
1.55.m: and the remaining planets are strong in an odd sign in the ascendant, she becomes ugly. / When Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, and Mercury are strong in an even sign in the ascendant,

1.55.s:
vikhyātānaikaśāstrajñā vanitā brahmavādinī /
pāpe 'ste navamasthasya pravrajyāmeti bhāminī //
1.55.d:
विख्यातानैकशास्त्रज्ञा वनिता ब्रह्मवादिनी ।
पापे ऽस्ते नवमस्थस्य प्रव्रज्यामेति भामिनी ॥
1.55.m: the woman is famous, knowledgeable in manifold treatises, and an expounder of Brahman. / When a malefic is in the seventh house, she embraces the ascetic life of the planet in the ninth house.

1.55.s:
udvāhe varaṇe praśne sarvametadvicintayet /
mṛtyusthānaṃ paśyatāṃ syādvalinā dhātukopataḥ //
1.55.d:
उद्वाहे वरणे प्रश्ने सर्वमेतद्विचिन्तयेत् ।
मृत्युस्थानं पश्यतां स्याद्वलिना धातुकोपतः ॥
1.55.m: One should examine all of this in marriage, in choosing [a bride], and in horary queries. / Death occurs through the perturbation of the bodily humor belonging to the planet aspecting or situated in the house of death according to strength.

1.55.s:
nṛṇāṃ mṛtyuhitaṃ yuktaṃ bhagātrosthopathabhūribhiḥ /
savīryairbahujo 'gnyakṣatajvararugudbhavaḥ //
1.55.d:
नृणां मृत्युहितं युक्तं भगात्रोस्थोपथभूरिभिः ।
सवीर्यैर्बहुजो ऽग्न्यक्षतज्वररुगुद्भवः ॥
1.55.m: Death of men is brought about by the limb or body parts [indicated by the sign]; / when many [planets] are endowed with strength, it arises from fire, wounds, or feverish disease;

1.55.s:
tṛṭkṣudbhavaścāṣṭamasthaiḥ sūryādyaiśca varādiṣu /
parasvādhvapradeśeṣu mṛtyuḥ sūryamahījayoḥ //
1.55.d:
तृट्क्षुद्भवश्चाष्टमस्थैः सूर्याद्यैश्च वरादिषु ।
परस्वाध्वप्रदेशेषु मृत्युः सूर्यमहीजयोः ॥
1.55.m: and it arises from thirst and hunger through the Sun and others in the eighth house. In the case of the Sun and Mars, / death occurs in places belonging to others, on roads, or in regions [abroad];

1.55.s:
svabandhusthitayoḥ puṃsaḥ śailāgnābhirutasya ca /
bandhvastakarmagairmandabhūjaiḥ prahau mṛtiḥ //
1.55.d:
स्वबन्धुस्थितयोः पुंसः शैलाग्नाभिरुतस्य च ।
बन्ध्वस्तकर्मगैर्मन्दभूजैः प्रहौ मृतिः ॥
1.55.m: for a man when they are situated in his own fourth house, [death is] caused by a mountain, fire, or falling. / When Saturn and Mars occupy the fourth, seventh, and tenth houses, death occurs in an abyss.

1.55.s:
striyāṃ himoṣaaṇakarayoḥ svajanātpāpadṛktayoḥ /
toyamṛto ravīdṛtusyātāṃyā dyubhayodaye //
1.55.d:
स्त्रियां हिमोषअणकरयोः स्वजनात्पापदृक्तयोः ।
तोयमृतो रवीदृतुस्यातांया द्युभयोदये ॥
1.55.m: For a woman, when the Moon and the Sun are aspected by malefics, [death is caused] by her own kinsmen; / when the Sun and Moon are in dual ascendants, death is through water.

1.55.s:
śastrāgnijośubhāntasthe candre bhaumagṛhagasthite /
mṛtyuścātha mṛge candre karke mande jalodarāt //
1.55.d:
शस्त्राग्निजोशुभान्तस्थे चन्द्रे भौमगृहगस्थिते ।
मृत्युश्चाथ मृगे चन्द्रे कर्के मन्दे जलोदरात् ॥
1.55.m: When the Moon is situated between malefics in a house of Mars, death arises from weapons or fire; / and when the Moon is in Capricorn and Saturn is in Cancer, [death is] from dropsy.

1.55.s:
striyāmindau raktaśauthātsaure vājvagnipātajaḥ /
putradharmasthasyorvandhātpāpayoḥ sadadṛṣṭayoḥ //
1.55.d:
स्त्रियामिन्दौ रक्तशौथात्सौरे वाज्वग्निपातजः ।
पुत्रधर्मस्थस्योर्वन्धात्पापयोः सददृष्टयोः ॥
1.55.m: For a woman, when the Moon [is so placed], it arises from blood disorders or swelling; when Saturn [is so placed], from fire or falling from a horse. / When malefics occupy the fifth or ninth house and are not aspected by benefics, [death is] from imprisonment;

1.55.s:
sathāsaśaṃyanigaḍairdṛkairmṛtyau tu bandhanaiḥ /
striyāṃ sapāpe 'bje dyūne site meṣe ravau tanau //
1.55.d:
सथासशंयनिगडैर्दृकैर्मृत्यौ तु बन्धनैः ।
स्त्रियां सपापे ऽब्जे द्यूने सिते मेषे रवौ तनौ ॥
1.55.m: and when aspects indicate bonds, death occurs in captivity. / In a woman's chart, when the Moon with a malefic is in the seventh house, Venus is in Aries, and the Sun is in the ascendant,

1.55.s:
maraṇaṃ strīkṛte gehe hyatha turye kuje ravau /
yame kheṃ'gatrikoṇarstheḥ kṣīṇacandrāṃśubhaiḥ sakṛt //
1.55.d:
मरणं स्त्रीकृते गेहे ह्यथ तुर्ये कुजे रवौ ।
यमे खेंऽगत्रिकोणर्स्थेः क्षीणचन्द्रांशुभैः सकृत् ॥
1.55.m: death occurs at home on account of a woman. Now, when Mars and the Sun are in the fourth house, / Saturn in the tenth, and waning Moon and benefics are in the ascendant or trines,

1.55.s:
turyer'ke khe kujekṣīṇa candradṛṣṭe samiddhataḥ /
randhrakhāṅgajalaiḥ kṣīṇendvārārkiravisaṃyutaiḥ //
1.55.d:
तुर्येर्ऽके खे कुजेक्षीण चन्द्रदृष्टे समिद्धतः ।
रन्ध्रखाङ्गजलैः क्षीणेन्द्वारार्किरविसंयुतैः ॥
1.55.m: or when the Sun is in the fourth house and Mars in the tenth is aspected by the waning Moon, [death] is caused by a club. / When the eighth, tenth, ascendant, and fourth houses are occupied by the waning Moon, Mars, Saturn, and the Sun,

1.55.s:
lakuṭenātha taireva khāṅkāṅgatanayasthitaiḥ /
dhūmānibandhanaiḥ kāryaḥ kudanairmaraṇaṃ bhavet //
1.55.d:
लकुटेनाथ तैरेव खाङ्काङ्गतनयस्थितैः ।
धूमानिबन्धनैः कार्यः कुदनैर्मरणं भवेत् ॥
1.55.m: death is caused by a cudgel; and by those same [planets] situated in the tenth, ninth, ascendant, and fifth houses, / death occurs through smoke, fire, binding, or bad days.

1.55.s:
bandhvastakhasthairbhauṃmārkarmadaiḥ śastrāgniṃrājabhiḥ /
sauredvāraiḥ svāṃburavasthaiḥ kṣatakremyaṅgayā tataḥ //
1.55.d:
बन्ध्वस्तखस्थैर्भौंमार्कर्मदैः शस्त्राग्निंराजभिः ।
सौरेद्वारैः स्वांबुरवस्थैः क्षतक्रेम्यङ्गया ततः ॥
1.55.m: When Mars, the Sun, and Saturn occupy the fourth, seventh, and tenth houses, [death is] through weapons, fire, or kings; / when Saturn occupies the second, fourth, or ascendant, it occurs through wounds, worms, or limbs;

1.55.s:
sver'ke turye kuje yānapātādatha kuje 'stage /
yantrosīdunataḥ kṣīṇacandrayukte mṛtirbhavet //
1.55.d:
स्वेर्ऽके तुर्ये कुजे यानपातादथ कुजे ऽस्तगे ।
यन्त्रोसीदुनतः क्षीणचन्द्रयुक्ते मृतिर्भवेत् ॥
1.55.m: when the Sun is in the second house and Mars in the fourth, [death is] from a fall from a vehicle; and when Mars sets, / [it is] caused by machinery or stones, and when conjoined with the waning Moon, death occurs.

1.55.s:
bhaumārkiśītakiraṇairjūkājaśanibhasthiteḥ /
kṣīṇendvarkakujaiḥ khāstāṃbusthairvārakare mṛtiḥ //
1.55.d:
भौमार्किशीतकिरणैर्जूकाजशनिभस्थितेः ।
क्षीणेन्द्वर्ककुजैः खास्तांबुस्थैर्वारकरे मृतिः ॥
1.55.m: When Mars, Saturn, and the Moon occupy Libra, Aries, and Capricorn, / or when the waning Moon, the Sun, and Mars occupy the tenth, seventh, and fourth houses, death is caused by a horse.

1.55.s:
balyāradṛṣṭe kṣīṇendau mande nidhaṃnasaṃsthite /
guhyarukkṛmiśastrāgnidārujo mṛtyuraṅgirāḥ //
1.55.d:
बल्यारदृष्टे क्षीणेन्दौ मन्दे निधंनसंस्थिते ।
गुह्यरुक्कृमिशस्त्राग्निदारुजो मृत्युरङ्गिराः ॥
1.55.m: When the waning Moon is aspected by powerful Mars and Saturn is placed in the eighth house, / death arises from disease of the private parts, worms, weapons, fire, or wood, [so says] Bṛhaspati.

1.55.s:
saurer'ke 'ste mṛto mande kṣīṇendau bhuvyasaṃyute /
lagnadhyāyāsta paḥkhārkabhaumacandraniśākaraiḥ //
1.55.d:
सौरेर्ऽके ऽस्ते मृतो मन्दे क्षीणेन्दौ भुव्यसंयुते ।
लग्नध्यायास्त पःखार्कभौमचन्द्रनिशाकरैः ॥
1.55.m: When Saturn is in the setting house and the Sun is [there], death occurs; when Saturn, the waning Moon, and Mars are conjoined, / or when the ascendant, fourth, ninth, eighth, Mars, and the Moon [are afflicted],

1.55.s:
śailaśṛṅgasvarugrapātaunurnidhanaṃ bhavet /
dṛkkonttare turddhāviṃśastatpatirmṛtyupopi vā //
1.55.d:
शैलशृङ्गस्वरुग्रपातौनुर्निधनं भवेत् ।
दृक्कोन्त्तरे तुर्द्धाविंशस्तत्पतिर्मृत्युपोपि वा ॥
1.55.m: death of the man occurs from a mountain peak or a terrible fall. / In the decanates, the twenty-second [decanate] or its lord, or the lord of death,

1.55.s:
svaguṇairnidha na kuryādbalavānyo dvayorbhavet /
lagnāṃśeśasadṛksthāne mṛtyuryogekṣaṇādibhiḥ //
1.55.d:
स्वगुणैर्निध न कुर्याद्बलवान्यो द्वयोर्भवेत् ।
लग्नांशेशसदृक्स्थाने मृत्युर्योगेक्षणादिभिः ॥
1.55.m: causes death according to its own qualities, whichever of the two is stronger. / Death occurs in a place similar to the lord of the ascendant's navāṃśa, through yogas and aspects.

1.55.s:
modāentenuditāṃśasya tulyo dvighnaḥ svapekṣite /
śubhekṣite tu triguṇaḥ kalpyamanyatsvabuddhitaḥ //
1.55.d:
मोदाएन्तेनुदितांशस्य तुल्यो द्विघ्नः स्वपेक्षिते ।
शुभेक्षिते तु त्रिगुणः कल्प्यमन्यत्स्वबुद्धितः ॥
1.55.m: It is equal to the elapsed portion of the rising degree; doubled when aspected by its own [lord], / and tripled when aspected by a benefic; other [details] are to be conceived by one's own intellect.

1.55.s:
vahnyaṃpabubhasmasakledaśoṣavyālairmṛtisthitaiḥ /
bindutaścintanīyaśca yathokto matyuraṅginaḥ //
1.55.d:
वह्न्यंपबुभस्मसक्लेदशोषव्यालैर्मृतिस्थितैः ।
बिन्दुतश्चिन्तनीयश्च यथोक्तो मत्युरङ्गिनः ॥
1.55.m: From the planets situated in the house of death—fire, water, earth, ashes, moisture, drying, or serpents— / and from the dots [in the aṣṭakavarga], the death of the embodied soul is to be considered as stated.

1.55.s:
guruḥ śaśāṅkaśukrau ca sūryabhaumau yamendujau /
devapitratiraktotha nārakānkuryuraṣṭame //
1.55.d:
गुरुः शशाङ्कशुक्रौ च सूर्यभौमौ यमेन्दुजौ ।
देवपित्रतिरक्तोथ नारकान्कुर्युरष्टमे ॥
1.55.m: Jupiter, the Moon and Venus, the Sun and Mars, Saturn and Mercury, / when in the eighth house, lead respectively to the gods, ancestors, wandering spirits, or the denizens of hell.

1.55.s:
ravīndubalavaśraṃśanāthācchreṣṭasamādhamāḥ /
tuṅgagaḥ sāṃdanūkenugatiḥ ṣaḍrandhradṛkkapaḥ //
1.55.d:
रवीन्दुबलवश्रंशनाथाच्छ्रेष्टसमाधमाः ।
तुङ्गगः सांदनूकेनुगतिः षड्रन्ध्रदृक्कपः ॥
1.55.m: According to the strength of the Sun and Moon, through the lord of the navāṃśa, the [states of existence] are superior, middling, or base. / One who is in exaltation [goes to heaven]; the lord of the decanate of the eighth or sixth house indicates the state.

1.55.s:
dyūnasthito gururvāpi ripukendravināśagaḥ /
svoccasthoṃ'ge vyaye saumyabhāge mokṣo balānyataḥ //
1.55.d:
द्यूनस्थितो गुरुर्वापि रिपुकेन्द्रविनाशगः ।
स्वोच्चस्थोंऽगे व्यये सौम्यभागे मोक्षो बलान्यतः ॥
1.55.m: Or when Jupiter is situated in the seventh, sixth, kendra, or eighth house, / or in its exaltation in the ascendant, and the twelfth house is in a benefic navāṃśa, liberation [occurs]; otherwise, [rebirth occurs] through other strengths.

1.55.s:
ādhāne janmā jñāne tu vṛkṣatāṃ lagnato vadet /
pūrvāparārddhairlagnasya saumye vācyapanejaniḥ //
1.55.d:
आधाने जन्मा ज्ञाने तु वृक्षतां लग्नतो वदेत् ।
पूर्वापरार्द्धैर्लग्नस्य सौम्ये वाच्यपनेजनिः ॥
1.55.m: When conception or birth is unknown, one should declare the [rising] tree from the ascendant; / in the former or latter halves of the ascendant, birth in a benefic or malefic [sign] is to be declared.

1.55.s:
lagnatrikoṇe dhījyatryaṃśairvikalpāvayavāḥ samāḥ /
grīṣmoger'ke parai ramyāpanatāṃpṛturarkabhāt //
1.55.d:
लग्नत्रिकोणे धीज्यत्र्यंशैर्विकल्पावयवाः समाः ।
ग्रीष्मोगेर्ऽके परै रम्यापनतांपृतुरर्कभात् ॥
1.55.m: In the ascendant and trines, the limbs are divided equally by the decanates of the fifth and ninth lords; / when the Sun is in the summer [season], the broadness [of the child] is declared through others from the Sun's sign.

1.55.s:
candrajñajīvāvṛtyasyāḥ śukrārārkibhiranyathā /
dṛkkairādyaiḥ pūrvamāsastithistatrānupātataḥ //
1.55.d:
चन्द्रज्ञजीवावृत्यस्याः शुक्रारार्किभिरन्यथा ।
दृक्कैराद्यैः पूर्वमासस्तिथिस्तत्रानुपाततः ॥
1.55.m: Through the period of the Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter, [it is known]; through Venus, Mars, and Saturn, it is otherwise. / Through the decanates, the first [half] gives the previous month, and the lunar day is [known] by proportion.

1.55.s:
vilomajanma bhāgaiśca velā rātridyusaṃjñake /
trikoṇottamavārthantilagnaṃ vā labhanābhane //
1.55.d:
विलोमजन्म भागैश्च वेला रात्रिद्युसंज्ञके ।
त्रिकोणोत्तमवार्थन्तिलग्नं वा लभनाभने ॥
1.55.m: By the degrees of reversed birth, the time of birth is designated as night or day; / or the ascendant is in a trine, highest sign, or second house, in the acquisition of wealth.

1.55.s:
yāvadūno vidhurlagnāttāvaccandrācca janmabhe /
goharī yugmavasubhe kriyajuke mṛgāṅgane //
1.55.d:
यावदूनो विधुर्लग्नात्तावच्चन्द्राच्च जन्मभे ।
गोहरी युग्मवसुभे क्रियजुके मृगाङ्गने ॥
1.55.m: As far as the Moon is behind the ascendant, so far from the Moon is the birth-sign: / in Taurus, Leo, Gemini, Capricorn, Aries, Libra, Capricorn, or Virgo,

1.55.s:
daśāṣṭasaptaviṣaye guṇyāḥ śeṣāḥ khasaṃkhyayā /
jīvabhaumakavijñāḥ syu rāghavādyāyarejñavat //
1.55.d:
दशाष्टसप्तविषये गुण्याः शेषाः खसंख्यया ।
जीवभौमकविज्ञाः स्यु राघवाद्यायरेज्ञवत् ॥
1.55.m: they are to be multiplied by ten, eight, seven, and five, and the remainder by zero. / Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury are like Rāma and others, according to knowledge.

1.55.s:
bhānāṃ nityo vidhiḥ kheṭavaśāvaddhargaṇāstathā /
saptarghnaṃ bhahṛtaṃ śeṣamṛkṣaṃ navadhanarṇataḥ //
1.55.d:
भानां नित्यो विधिः खेटवशावद्धर्गणास्तथा ।
सप्तर्घ्नं भहृतं शेषमृक्षं नवधनर्णतः ॥
1.55.m: The daily rule of the asterisms is thus dependent on the planets and the accumulated days; / multiplied by seven and divided by the asterisms, the remaining asterism is from the nine, positive or negative.

1.55.s:
dvighne samartumāsāḥ syuḥ pakṣatithyau gajāhate /
saptaghnaṃ honiśārkṣāṇīṣughneṅgāṃśeṣṭahorikā //
1.55.d:
द्विघ्ने समर्तुमासाः स्युः पक्षतिथ्यौ गजाहते ।
सप्तघ्नं होनिशार्क्षाणीषुघ्नेङ्गांशेष्टहोरिका ॥
1.55.m: When doubled, the seasons and months are equal; multiplied by eight, the fortnight and lunar day [are found]; / multiplied by seven, the day, night, and asterisms [are found]; multiplied by five, the desired horā in the parts of the body [is determined].

1.55.s:
pumānparaśudhṛkkṛṣṇo raktadṛgrakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ /
dṛṣṭartikapadāśvāsyā raktavastrā ghaṭākṛtiḥ //
1.55.d:
पुमान्परशुधृक्कृष्णो रक्तदृग्रक्षितुं क्षमः ।
दृष्टर्तिकपदाश्वास्या रक्तवस्त्रा घटाकृतिः ॥
1.55.m: [First decanate of Aries:] A dark man holding an axe, with red eyes, capable of protecting; / [second decanate:] a horse-faced woman in red garments, with pain in the feet, shaped like a pot;

1.55.s:
kapilo hyandhadṛkrūro raktavastraḥ kṣatavrataḥ /
kṣuttṛṣārtodugdhapaṭo lūnakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ //
1.55.d:
कपिलो ह्यन्धदृक्रूरो रक्तवस्त्रः क्षतव्रतः ।
क्षुत्तृषार्तोदुग्धपटो लूनकुञ्चितमूर्धजः ॥
1.55.m: [third decanate:] tawny, blind in vision, fierce, clad in red garments, broken in vows, / afflicted by hunger and thirst, with milk-white cloth, and severed, curled hair.

1.55.s:
malinaḥ kṣutparojāsyo dakṣaḥ kṛṣyādikarmaṇi /
dvipakāyaḥ sarabhayātpiṃpagalo vyākulāntaraḥ //
1.55.d:
मलिनः क्षुत्परोजास्यो दक्षः कृष्यादिकर्मणि ।
द्विपकायः सरभयात्पिंपगलो व्याकुलान्तरः ॥
1.55.m: [Taurus:] Dirty, very hungry, with the face of a goat, skilled in agriculture and other work; / with the body of an elephant, tawny through sudden fear, and agitated within;

1.55.s:
śaucikīrūpiṇī sādhvī hyaprajocchritapāṇikā /
udyāne kavacī dhanvī krīḍecchargaruḍānanaḥ //
1.55.d:
शौचिकीरूपिणी साध्वी ह्यप्रजोच्छ्रितपाणिका ।
उद्याने कवची धन्वी क्रीडेच्छर्गरुडाननः ॥
1.55.m: a chaste woman possessing beauty and purity, childless, with hands raised aloft. / [Gemini:] In a garden, an armored archer, playing with arrows, having the face of Garuḍa;

1.55.s:
nṛtyādividvaruṇavadbahuratnodhanurdharaḥ /
dvipāsyakaṇṭhaḥ kroḍāsyaḥ kānaneśaramāhikaḥ //
1.55.d:
नृत्यादिविद्वरुणवद्बहुरत्नोधनुर्धरः ।
द्विपास्यकण्ठः क्रोडास्यः काननेशरमाहिकः ॥
1.55.m: skilled in dancing and other arts, resembling Varuṇa, possessing many gems, bearing a bow; / with the neck and face of an elephant, boar-faced, an archer in the forest;

1.55.s:
ātavyaśākhāṃ pālāśī rauti mūrddhāhikarkaśā /
cipiṭāsyo hi saṃvīto nausthaḥ ratryarthaṃvrajañjale //
1.55.d:
आतव्यशाखां पालाशी रौति मूर्द्धाहिकर्कशा ।
चिपिटास्यो हि संवीतो नौस्थः रत्र्यर्थंव्रजञ्जले ॥
1.55.m: [Cancer:] Holding a branch of palāśa in the forest, shouting, rough-headed like a serpent; / flat-faced, covered, seated in a boat, traveling on water for the sake of gems;

1.55.s:
śvā naro jaṃbukaṃ gṛdhraṃ gṛhītvā rauti śālmalau /
dhanvī kṛṣṇājinī siṃhavāśvonnatamāturaḥ //
1.55.d:
श्वा नरो जंबुकं गृध्रं गृहीत्वा रौति शाल्मलौ ।
धन्वी कृष्णाजिनी सिंहवाश्वोन्नतमातुरः ॥
1.55.m: a man who, seizing a dog, a jackal, and a vulture, shouts at the base of a silk-cotton tree; / [Leo:] an archer clad in black antelope skin, loud like a lion or horse, tall and distressed;

1.55.s:
phalāmiṣaghnaḥ kūrjīnā bhallāsyaḥ kapiceṣṭitaḥ /
puṣpapūrṇacchaṭākanyāvidyellā malināṃvarā //
1.55.d:
फलामिषघ्नः कूर्जीना भल्लास्यः कपिचेष्टितः ।
पुष्पपूर्णच्छटाकन्याविद्येल्ला मलिनांवरा ॥
1.55.m: destroying fruits and meat, bearing a basket, bear-faced, acting like a monkey; / [Virgo:] a maiden with a basket filled with flowers, learned, clad in soiled clothes;

1.55.s:
dhanvī vyayāpakṛcchyāmo lipikṛdrāmaśonaraḥ /
gaurīdhautāṃśukātsuccākuṃbhadṛstāsurālaye //
1.55.d:
धन्वी व्ययापकृच्छ्यामो लिपिकृद्रामशोनरः ।
गौरीधौतांशुकात्सुच्चाकुंभदृस्तासुरालये ॥
1.55.m: an archer, dark from expenditure and toil, a scribe, a delightful man; / fair, with washed garments, pure, looking at a pot in a shrine of the gods;

1.55.s:
mānonmānpāpasotaulībhāṇḍamutpavicintakaḥ /
kṣuttṛṅyuto naraḥ kuṃbhīgṛdhnasya strīsutopagaḥ //
1.55.d:
मानोन्मान्पापसोतौलीभाण्डमुत्पविचिन्तकः ।
क्षुत्तृङ्युतो नरः कुंभीगृध्नस्य स्त्रीसुतोपगः ॥
1.55.m: [Libra:] A man holding a balance, considering weights and measures, intent on pots and goods; / a hungry and thirsty man, eager for a pot, approaching his wife and son;

1.55.s:
dhanvīkintaraceṣṭastuhaimavarmāmṛgānugaḥ /
siṃdhekūjaṃvrajantīstrīnānāsarpasita hikā //
1.55.d:
धन्वीकिन्तरचेष्टस्तुहैमवर्मामृगानुगः ।
सिंधेकूजंव्रजन्तीस्त्रीनानासर्पसित हिका ॥
1.55.m: an archer acting like a kinnara, with golden armor, pursuing a deer; / [Scorpio:] a woman going to the ocean with a water-pot, bitten by manifold serpents;

1.55.s:
saukhyaspṛhāhyāvṛttāṅgībhatrarthakacchapākṛtiḥ /
kūrmāsyo malaye siṃhaḥ śvakroṇḍamṛgabhīṣakaḥ //
1.55.d:
सौख्यस्पृहाह्यावृत्ताङ्गीभत्रर्थकच्छपाकृतिः ।
कूर्मास्यो मलये सिंहः श्वक्रोण्डमृगभीषकः ॥
1.55.m: Desiring pleasure, her limbs covered, shaped like a tortoise for the sake of her husband, / with a turtle's face in the Malaya mountains, a lion, terrifying to dogs, foxes, and deer;

1.55.s:
vāsyaḥ śvakāyo dhānuṣko raṅkṣastāpasayajñiye /
caṃpakābhāsane madhyā siṃdhuratravivarddhinī //
1.55.d:
वास्यः श्वकायो धानुष्को रङ्क्षस्तापसयज्ञिये ।
चंपकाभासने मध्या सिंधुरत्रविवर्द्धिनी ॥
1.55.m: having an axe, a dog's body, an archer, a beggar at the sacrifices of ascetics; / a middle woman on a seat resembling a campaka flower, swelling like the ocean here;

1.55.s:
kūrmāsane caṃpakābho daṇḍī kauśeyakāninī /
paramo 'tho gṛdhramukhaḥ snehamadyāśanaspṛhaḥ //
1.55.d:
कूर्मासने चंपकाभो दण्डी कौशेयकानिनी ।
परमो ऽथो गृध्रमुखः स्नेहमद्याशनस्पृहः ॥
1.55.m: resembling a campaka flower on a tortoise seat, holding a staff, clad in silk garments; / then the supreme one with a vulture's face, desiring to consume fats and liquor;

1.55.s:
dagdhānasthā lohadharā sabhūṣābhāñjakaccarā /
bhāṇḍī romaścavāḥ śyāmaḥ kirīṭī phalayantradhṛk //
1.55.d:
दग्धानस्था लोहधरा सभूषाभाञ्जकच्चरा ।
भाण्डी रोमश्चवाः श्यामः किरीटी फलयन्त्रधृक् ॥
1.55.m: standing in ashes, bearing iron, adorned with ornaments, destroying, wandering; / holding a vessel, hairy, dark, wearing a crown, holding a fruit-press;

1.55.s:
nausthodhvosaṃvibhūṣārntha nānāratnakarāeñcitaḥ /
nausthabdheḥ kūlamāyāntī sayūthāṃ campakānanā //
1.55.d:
नौस्थोध्वोसंविभूषार्न्थ नानारत्नकराएञ्चितः ।
नौस्थब्धेः कूलमायान्ती सयूथां चम्पकानना ॥
1.55.m: standing in a boat, adorned for the sake of ornament, hands decorated with various gems; / standing in a boat, coming to the shore of the ocean, having a multitude, with a campaka-like face;

1.55.s:
garte sarpāvṛto nagno rudaṃścaurānalārditaḥ /
etādṛśāṅkriyāṃśāḥ stu ṣatriṃśadudītāḥ kramāt //
1.55.d:
गर्ते सर्पावृतो नग्नो रुदंश्चौरानलार्दितः ।
एतादृशाङ्क्रियांशाः स्तु षत्रिंशदुदीताः क्रमात् ॥
1.55.m: naked in a pit, surrounded by snakes, weeping, afflicted by thieves and fire— / such decanates have been declared in order, thirty-six in number.

1.55.s:
etatsaṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ jātakaṃ munisattama /
nibodha saṃhitāskandhaṃ lokakṛtyupayoginam //
iti śrīnāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge dvitīyapāde bṛhadupākhyāne jātakanirūpaṇannāma pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.55.d:
एतत्संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं जातकं मुनिसत्तम ।
निबोध संहितास्कन्धं लोककृत्युपयोगिनम् ॥
इति श्रीनारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे द्वितीयपादे बृहदुपाख्याने जातकनिरूपणन्नाम पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
1.55.m:
Thus the branch of horoscopy has been spoken in brief, O best of sages; / now understand the Saṃhitā section, which is useful for the activities of the world.

Thus ends the fifty-fifth chapter, named 'Exposition of Horoscopy', in the Bṛhad-upākhyāna of the second quarter of the first part of the glorious Nāradīya Purāṇa.
